title: fix(chat): profile chip draws over the Send button on iOS 27
body:
On iOS 27 beta the profile chip in the composer's bottom row draws over the Send and Stop button instead of fading out before it. iOS 27 ships publicly in about a week, so this should land before it does.

## Context

The card-state toolbar row in `ChatComposerView.swift` is a masked horizontal scroller with the Stop/Send circle pinned outside it. [#362](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/362) kept the glass controls inside that clip. Three 1.6.0 reports on iOS 27 dev beta 8 show the profile chip escaping it. Not reproducible on iOS 26.5, glass on or off.

A reporter screenshot shows the chip drawn across the red Stop button with its chevron on top, so this is not limited to the Send state — it happens in every composer state.

## Current behavior

With the composer focused and the row wider than the screen, the profile chip — a SwiftUI `Menu` in `ComposerProfileSelectorMenu` — renders across the Send or Stop button and past it, with its chevron drawn on top. The mic and context ring after it clip correctly. Only the `Menu`-backed chip escapes.

## Expected behavior

Every control in the scroller fades out at the trailing edge before the Send button on iOS 26 and iOS 27. Nothing is ever drawn across Send or Stop.

## Suspected cause

Narrowed but not proven: on iOS 27 the SwiftUI `Menu` label appears to be hosted outside the scroller's clip and mask, exactly like glass was in [#362](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/362).

**Preferred fix:** render the profile chip through `ChatUIKitMenuButton`, like the model chip. This is a good bet but unverified on iOS 27.

**Fallback:** if `ChatUIKitMenuButton` also escapes there, drop the `Menu` entirely and open the profile picker as a sheet, the way the workspace chip already works.

## Acceptance criteria

- Reproduced on an iOS 27 simulator *before* the change.
- After the change, the profile chip clips and fades like the model chip when dragged under Send, in:
  - light and dark
  - idle and streaming
  - Reduce Transparency on and off
  - an accessibility Dynamic Type size
  - an RTL locale
- iOS 26.5 is unchanged.
- The plus button, model chip, and context ring keep the [#362](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/362) behavior.

## Validation plan

Validation needs an iOS 27 runtime. This Mac has Xcode 26.6 with only the iOS 26.5 simulator, so the fix cannot be proven here until the Xcode 27 beta and its iOS 27 simulator runtime are installed, or the build goes to Branch TestFlight on a device running the beta.

1. Install the Xcode 27 beta iOS 27 runtime.
2. Build a signed Debug.
3. Focus the composer in a chat on a multi-profile server.
4. Drag the toolbar row so the profile chip straddles Send.
5. Screenshot before and after.

## Non-goals

Redesigning the toolbar row, changing the Send button, or touching [#362](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/362)'s glass path.

title: fix(chat): composer snaps back to the caret after manually scrolling a long draft
body:
## Context
Re-scoped from the original report (preserved below). The text-selection half was fixed by #450 (landed after v1.6.0; ships in the next release). This issue now covers only the scroll snap-back. Reproduced by the maintainer on a current build.

## Current behavior
In the expanded composer, with a plain-text draft taller than the 160 pt cap (no chips, no quotes), drag up to view earlier text. When the finger lifts, the text view scrolls back to the caret at the bottom.

## Expected behavior
The composer stays where the user scrolled it until they type, move the caret, or the draft is changed from outside.

## Pointers (unconfirmed — confirm the cause before fixing)
- `ComposerTextView.updateUIView` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatComposerTextInputView.swift`) unconditionally assigns `semanticContentAttribute`, `textAlignment`, and `textColor` every pass. On a UITextView these rewrite attributes across the whole text storage and invalidate layout; a focused editable text view then scrolls its selection visible. Guard them to assign only on change.
- The same pass calls `reportHeight` → `sizeThatFits` every update.
- Find what triggers an update at scroll end (`textViewDidChangeSelection`, the deferred `publishSelection`, height reporting) and whether it is needed.

## Acceptance criteria
- Scrolling a long plain-text draft up and releasing leaves the offset where the user put it, including after deceleration.
- Typing or moving the caret still scrolls the caret into view.
- Growing from 1 line to the 160 pt cap still resizes correctly.
- No regression to #450 gestures, chips, quotes, IME marked text (#312), RTL (#259), or predictive text.
- A focused test covers whatever guard is added, where unit-testable (for example redundant `updateUIView` passes do not mutate text storage).

## Validation plan
Full XCTest suite. Manual on simulator and a device, signed Debug build:
- long plain draft: scroll up, release, hold 5 s;
- the same draft with a chip and a quote;
- RTL toggle on;
- Dynamic Type at the largest size;
- hardware keyboard arrow keys still follow the caret.

## Non-goals
Changing the 160 pt cap, composer layout, or chip rendering.

---

## Original report (by @aptonline)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a chat and enter enough text into the composer to span multiple lines and require scrolling.
2. Tap between words to reposition the cursor.
3. Double-tap a word to try to select it using the standard iOS text-selection controls.
4. Attempt to adjust the selection/cursor using the native iOS gestures and controls.
5. Scroll upwards within the composer to view or edit earlier text.

### Expected behavior

The composer should behave like a standard native iOS text field/editor:

- Tapping within the text should reliably position the insertion point at that location.
- Double-tapping a word should select it and display the standard iOS text-selection controls.
- Native iOS selection gestures and editing controls should work normally.
- When scrolling upwards through a long draft, the composer should remain at the position the user has scrolled to so earlier content can be reviewed or edited.

### Actual behavior

Native text interaction in the composer does not behave as expected:

- Tapping between words does not reliably allow the cursor to be positioned using normal iOS text\-editing behaviour.
- Double-tapping a word does not provide the expected native word-selection behaviour/controls.
- Standard iOS text-selection interaction appears to be unavailable or interfered with.
- When manually scrolling upwards in a long draft to view earlier content, the composer automatically scrolls back to the bottom, making it difficult or impossible to review and edit earlier text.

This makes editing longer prompts particularly difficult, as both native text selection and manual scrolling are affected.

1.6

IOS 27 public beta (latest)

Latest

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Trigger a conversation path where the agent calls `clarify` with a set of `options`.
2. Wait for the multi-choice card to render above the composer.
3. Tap any of the 4 offered choice buttons.
4. Observe that tapping does nothing — no selection, no submission.

**Expected**

Tapping an option selects it and submits the answer back to the agent.

**Actual**

Tapping is completely unresponsive. The user must type the chosen answer manually instead.

**Occurrence**

Reproduced on 2026-09-10 and again on 2026-09-11 — stable / reproducible on both days. Tap is attempted on every offered option without any response.

title: fix(chat): reduce scrolling lag in long conversations
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #32

## What changed

Long chats performed expensive text-selection rendering for completed responses far off screen. Collect selection glyphs only when a response intersects the vertical scroll viewport, while retaining its text metadata and collecting the entire visible response so selection still works in long answers.

The existing transcript layout, bottom anchoring, history loading, and folding behavior are preserved. The regression test checks deferred offscreen rendering, selection after scrolling, and unchanged transcript height.

## How it was tested

- Full XCTest suite through XcodeBuildMCP `test_sim` with `-parallel-testing-enabled NO`: **2,325 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped** on iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5.
- The focused regression test fails with eager glyph collection: all 264 text leaves render selection geometry. It passes with viewport gating and verifies selection at the top, bottom, and back at the top, including a response taller than the screen.
- A local 150-message Release simulator fixture reduced the worst scroll step from roughly **4–5 seconds to 167 ms**, with identical content height. This measures synthetic interaction latency, not device FPS.
- Signed Debug `build_run_sim` and Branch TestFlight archive/upload succeeded.
- Maintainer confirmed the manual checks pass on **iPhone 15 Pro Max / iOS 26.1.1**, using **Hermex Branch 1.7, build 202609092210**: status-bar navigation, down arrow while idle and streaming, bottom-follow streaming, older-message loading, turn folding, and text selection in long responses.

## Checklist

- [x] The full test suite passes locally
- [x] No Codable/model changes
- [x] No new third-party dependencies
- [x] No endpoint or wire-contract changes

Implemented with GPT-6 in the Codex harness.

title: epic(bots): map a minimal direct Hermes Bot Mode MVP
body:
## Destination

An implementation-ready map for a maintainer-tested Bot Mode MVP: connect to an existing Hermes bot, open its canonical chat, send and stream text, stop work, and recover the same conversation after disconnecting. Uzair implements after the decisions are settled; basic functionality must be tested before further investment.

## Notes

- Owner agreed to this boundary and manual server setup. Use an optional direct `hermes serve` connection associated with the selected Hermex server; one host at a time. Connection credentials belong in Keychain. Existing webui functionality remains on its current backend.
- This is a planning epic. Child issues resolve decisions, not authorization to implement. Do not mark implementation ready until the map is settled. No live-server changes, production data, app releases, or runtime experiments are authorized by charting this map.
- First implementation milestone is a protocol proof using a dedicated test bot on Uzair's existing headless Mac before production UI work. Specify that proof and its pass/fail criteria in this map; do not claim it has run.
- Working language: a Bot is an existing Hermes Profile presented with its canonical Bot Chat. Bot identity includes the owning connection and profile; a runtime session ID is not permanent bot identity.
- Use wayfinder; research for source facts; grilling and domain-modeling for product decisions; prototype and html-communication when selecting UI. Follow AGENTS.md, docs/agents/issue-tracker.md and docs/agents/multi-server-state-isolation.md. Keep research artifacts outside the worktree; record durable findings in the owning decision's resolution comment.
- Related requests: [Bot Mode support for Hermes profiles](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/299) and [Direct Hermes Agent Gateway API connections](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/177). This MVP does not promise the broader scope of either request.
- Initial research inspected upstream `a6102b8d809d6b32824757b547b60f9d22d6a88e`. Source evidence only; no running backend or iPhone validation. Research tickets own the verified contracts and limitations.
- Claim a child before working by assigning Uzair. Unassigned, open children with no open blocking dependencies are the available frontier. Research can run in parallel; other decision tickets require a live exchange with Uzair.

## Decisions so far

- [Verify connection and canonical chat contracts](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/465#issuecomment-5613260419): Source-verified direct-backend contracts and setup recommendations; runtime proof is still required.
- [Verify disconnect recovery and safe stop behavior](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/466#issuecomment-5613260689): No safe automatic resend; Stop affects the current session, and background continuity is conditional.

- [Settle MVP states and the first proof criteria](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/467#issuecomment-5613318217): Test on the existing headless Mac after Desktop bot setup; Desktop handles approvals, ordinary foreground recovery is required, and quiet-work/restart interruption may be explicit.

- [Choose the smallest connection and chat UI](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/468#issuecomment-5621219265): Approved B, a dedicated Bots inbox inspired by the Grok Bot reference; further visual refinement waits until functionality is confirmed.

- [Finalize the implementation order and MVP exit gate](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/469#issuecomment-5622128375): Conditional handoff settled; remote access and protocol proof gate UI work, text drafts stay isolated, offline Bot history is excluded, and current-conversation Stop has an accepted in-flight race.

## Not yet specified

None before implementation can begin with the mandatory gates. The final handoff defines how a failed proof returns an evidenced decision to this map.

## Out of scope

Offline Bot transcript storage; bot creation/editing/deletion; routines and scheduler setup; groups; bot mentions and cross-machine relay; guided onboarding; replacing the webui backend across Hermex; attachments and voice; push notifications, Live Activities, share-extension and App Intent entry points for Bots; avatar customization and visual polish. Existing app surfaces remain unaffected. Revisit these only in a later effort.

Use installed backend 0.21.1 at ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b and the existing inbox-triage test bot. No competing backend over Profile storage. No offline Bot transcript cache, Bot creation, phone approval controls, attachments, voice, Bot share/App Intent/Live Activity routing, release, TestFlight, git push or PR.



## Local implementation

Local commits: initial implementation `1d72754`, transcript correction `1163d75`, on `issue/471-bot-mode`. Both are now published on `origin/bot-mode` at Uzair’s explicit request. Follow-up simulator validation found and corrected Bot transcript scrolling and rendering defects. The worktree was clean before this work.

Direct Hermes auth/RPC live in `Networking/Bots`; canonical conversation ownership and UI live in `Features/Bots`. Draft storage has an explicit Bot context and durable unresolved-send marker. Navigation and Settings expose the approved entry points. Server removal/sign-out clear Bot data. Info.plist adds the local-network purpose string without changing ATS. New source belongs only to the main app and tests; existing extension targets build with the app.

Streaming coalesces events into inflight snapshots using the installed handler's `omit_messages` fast path, avoiding history DB reads. Open/recovery and state changes reconcile full saved history. Replay detects discontinuity without appending overlapping text. Send and Stop validate ownership again at actual socket dispatch. The transcript follows a stable trailing anchor, pauses following when reading history, and offers Latest. Coalesced snapshots render synchronously; the deferred streaming renderer caused a reproducible blank viewport. Existing Sessions rendering is unchanged.

## Validation completed

- Final XcodeBuildMCP `test_sim`: **2,352 passed, zero failed, two existing skips**.
- Rendering regression: actual BotChatView with in-memory transport, 300 saved lines and 12 successive growing inflight snapshots. Screenshot OCR reproduced the blank viewport before the renderer correction and passed afterward. Fixtures submit no live commands.
- Final signed Debug XcodeBuildMCP `build_run_sim`: build/install/launch succeeded on iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5. `codesign --verify --deep --strict` passed. Reopened inbox-triage at saved B line 1000, Connected / Ready; scrolling into history exposes Latest and Latest returns to the end. No further commands submitted.
- Diff checks pass. File-size checks remain warning-only for existing oversized files; new Bot files remain below 500 lines.
- Evidence and test/build artifacts remain outside the worktree under `/tmp/hermex-bot-implementation` and XcodeBuildMCP result bundles.

## Approved production-app simulator validation

Uzair explicitly approved the two-prompt, one-Stop procedure and use of the running logged-in iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5 simulator. Used only the existing backend, existing password account, and inbox-triage canonical chat. No host configuration changes or competing backend.

- Production authentication and roster loaded; designated chat was Connected / Ready. Before sends: one canonical Bot Chat, 44 saved messages, no 471-A or 471-B markers.
- A sent once and saved the full 300-line result. The viewport stayed in older history, so this did **not** establish live streaming or foreground recovery. No retry. Fixed following/Latest behavior; A line 300 then appeared at the latest edge.
- Unsent draft persisted across back navigation and full app termination/relaunch. Draft-only checks submitted nothing.
- B sent once. Working/Stop appeared, but growing text was blank. B completed before Stop could be confirmed. **No Stop was sent.** No replacement prompt. Reproduced and corrected the rendering defect locally as described above.
- Final read-only designated history: **48 messages, one A user prompt, one B user prompt, and complete terminal lines 300/1000**. Earlier 44 messages retained.

Both approved prompts are consumed. There is no currently running approved turn to stop. A fresh live test needs approval for its exact new prompts/Stop; do not reuse A/B or the earlier #470 markers.

## Remaining gates

Live visible streaming after the final correction, background/foreground recovery during a running turn, and Stop followed by refreshed idle are **not validated**. Earlier protocol-proof evidence and local rendering fixtures do not establish these production-app passes.

Physical iPhone LAN/Tailscale transport, ATS/local-network permission, lock/unlock, two configured servers/connections with identical Profile names, native accessibility/keyboard/appearance checks and unchanged webui behavior still need maintainer validation. New Bot copy is English; translations remain required before shipping in all app languages. **Integrated MVP completion remains open.**

No release, TestFlight upload or PR. The later branch-setup request explicitly authorized publishing the tested commits to `origin/bot-mode`.

- `Features/Bots/BotConnection.swift`: BotProfile projection and Keychain-backed connection identity.

## Scope and steps

`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/`, `HermesMobile/Networking/Bots/`, matching `HermesMobileTests/Bot*` fixtures, and `docs/agents/bots.md`; add focused sibling files and Xcode target membership as needed.

3. Wire presentation and explicit actions to Bot-owned state; preserve scope, cancellation and ambiguous-outcome rules. Run focused tests, then the full validation below.

## Validation

- Before UI implementation, follow AGENTS.md: create distinct static mocks via html-communication and wait for Uzair’s selection. The owner has deferred a general UI redesign; do not treat this issue as approval for one.
- Focused XCTest at the BotTransport/socket/URLProtocol or presentation seam, using expectations/scripted fixtures. Include two connections with identical Profile names, stale callbacks and missing/unknown server fields.
- Full suite: `xcodebuild test -project HermesMobile.xcodeproj -scheme HermesMobile -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -parallel-testing-enabled NO` → `TEST SUCCEEDED` before review/commit.
- Signed build/install/launch: `xcodebuildmcp simulator build-and-run` with selected isolated iPhone 17 defaults. Never install a CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build. All consuming extension targets must build.
- `git diff --check` → exit 0. Run `scripts/check-swift-file-sizes` when production Swift grows; warnings guide scope, not unrelated refactors.
- Native manual checks cover VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, light/dark, keyboard and the scenario below. Live prompts, resumes, Stop and any server mutation need an exact disposable test procedure approved by the owner. Existing #471 test prompts are consumed.

**Owner scenario:** Compare the same Profile in Desktop and Hermex; change an avatar in an authorized fixture/setup and refresh; check missing image, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver.

## Boundaries

- Reuse existing Sessions/Tasks/Settings/voice presentation where appropriate; do not duplicate scheduled Tasks, global server administration, Git, memory/skills browsing or provider/account management through a second backend.
- Bot profile-scoped functionality remains in scope even when a webui screen has a similar name. Route contextually only with proven connection/Profile mapping.

Hermes hosts multi-bot group rooms server-side, and the maintainer's host already has one ("Comms"). The phone cannot see them. This slice is read-only: list rooms, open one, read its log, follow work live, and see what is pending. Sending, Stop, approvals and retry are [#527](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/527); create, rename and disband are [#529](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/529); cached search is [#528](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/528).

## Expected behavior

- [ ] **Gate.** On inbox open call `groups.capabilities`. The Groups section exists only when `driver` is true and `methods` contains `groups.list`, `groups.state` and `groups.log`. Otherwise nothing about rooms appears anywhere. Never probe by mutation.
- [ ] **Inbox section.** A Groups section below the bots, refreshed with the roster on open and pull to refresh. Each row reuses the bot row layout with stacked member avatars (resolved from the roster by `profile`; an unknown profile gets the placeholder face), the room name, and the last activity time from `updated_at`. Rows are keyed by configured server, Bot connection UUID and `room_id`. Disbanded rooms are not listed.
- [ ] **Room screen.** Back, a glass pill with stacked avatars and the room name (the pill opens a read-only room profile: avatars, name, member rows that open each bot's profile; no overflow menu yet), and the transcript. No composer in this slice. Layout follows reference screenshots 3 and 4 on #485 minus the omitted affordances.
- [ ] **Transcript.** `message.user` on the right; `message.member` on the left with the member's display name above and avatar beside, rendered with the existing Bot Chat markdown body. Ordered by `seq`. `turn.failed`, `turn.cancelled`, `room.stop_requested` and `room.renamed` render as centered system lines; `room.activity`, `turn.settled`, `turn.deferred`, `authority.*` and unknown kinds render nothing but still advance the cursor.
- [ ] **Open and history.** `groups.state` for `latest_seq`, then `groups.log` from `max(0, latest_seq - 200)` forward until `has_more` is false. "Load earlier" at the top pages the previous 200-event window. In memory only; the log is dropped when the screen closes.
- [ ] **Follow.** While the screen is open and the app is foregrounded: `groups.state` every 2 s when `driver_status.working` or `blocked`, every 10 s when idle; page the log only when `latest_seq` advanced. Stop on background, on close and on a dropped socket (show the existing "live updates stopped" state; Reconnect goes through the existing close-then-open path). A poll with nothing new must not invalidate the transcript.
- [ ] **Status.** Under the transcript: "Working…" while `working`, "Waiting for you" while `blocked` (the card that answers it is #527; here the pending action shows the existing Desktop-attention state), nothing when idle. The server reports counts per status, not which member is working.
- [ ] **Edge states.** A room whose `authority.gateway_id` differs from the connection's `authority_gateway_id` shows a one-line "Managed by another Hermes" note. A `room_history_expired` error or 4114 drops the room from the list with a toast. Error 4123 tells the user to restart the Hermes gateway on their Mac.
- [ ] **Search.** Room names match in the existing search sheet and open the room. Message search waits for #528.
- [ ] `BotClient` allowlists exactly `groups.capabilities`, `groups.list`, `groups.state` and `groups.log` with typed parameter validation. Nothing mutating enters the allowlist in this slice.
- [ ] `docs/agents/bots.md` gains a Group rooms section: the gate, identity keys, replay and polling rules, event kinds rendered and ignored, and the boundary that the phone never orchestrates. Rewrite the old "no client polling loop" wording: reads are allowed, execution never moves to iOS.

## Validation

- Focused XCTests at the `BotClient` validation and a new room reducer seam, with scripted fixtures: the real `groups.capabilities` and "Comms" `groups.list` and `groups.state` responses from the maintainer's host with the install id replaced by a placeholder, plus synthesized `groups.log` pages. Cover: gate hidden when `driver` is false or a method is missing; duplicate `seq` ignored; window math for open and load-earlier; unknown event kind advances the cursor and renders nothing; a member missing `display_name`; two connections with a room of the same name stay separate; a poll after the screen closed mutates nothing; foreign authority shows the note.
- Full suite via `xcodebuild test -project HermesMobile.xcodeproj -scheme HermesMobile -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -parallel-testing-enabled NO` → `TEST SUCCEEDED`. Signed `build_run_sim`. `git diff --check`, `scripts/check-swift-file-sizes`.
- Live: read-only only. Open "Comms" on the maintainer's host over LAN and through the Cloudflare tunnel; background past the tunnel idle timeout and confirm the room re-reads on return with no duplicate rows. No room may be created, sent to or changed under this ticket.
- Manual simulator plan: VoiceOver reads room rows and member messages with the sender's name; Dynamic Type; Reduce Motion; light and dark; search finds the room by name.

## Boundaries

- The gateway is the driver. The phone reads while the room screen is open and foregrounded and never continues execution, retries or orchestrates.
- Never read or write the hidden `Group: <room_id>` member sessions in this slice.
- Unknown methods, capabilities and event kinds degrade honestly. No `groups.promote`, `groups.demote`, `groups.replicate`, `groups.replica_state` or `groups.peer.*`, ever.

## Problem

## Expected behavior

title: epic(push): Hermex push plugin, relay and iOS pairing for bot notifications and Live Activities
body:
Part of [#493](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/493). Rewritten 2026-09-10 from a decision ticket into the design and execution plan for Hermex-owned push; decisions settled the same day. **Effort:** XL across three components · **Risk:** HIGH. **Depends on:** [#476](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/476) (approval tap targets), [#488](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/488) (bot deep-link routing). Live Activity push updates additionally depend on [#489](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/489).

Uzair decided on 2026-09-10 to build a Hermex-owned equivalent of the Push (Cadu) plugin so Hermex users get push notifications and background Live Activity updates. This ticket records the reference design, what was verified, the one product decision still open, and the child slices to file once that decision lands. No plugin installation, relay provisioning, APNs configuration or test notification is authorized by this ticket.

## What the reference implementation does (verified by reading the installed plugin on the maintainer's host, 2026-09-10)

Push (Cadu) 1.3.0 is two small Python pieces plus a closed-source relay:

- **Platform plugin** (`plugin.yaml` `kind: platform`, `adapter.py`, `privacy.py`). `register(ctx)` calls `ctx.register_platform(name="push", …)` with a send-only adapter, a `standalone_sender_fn` so cron jobs can use `deliver: push` when cron runs outside the gateway, `cron_deliver_env_var`, `pii_safe=True` and a `platform_hint` telling the model to write one or two plain sentences. It then registers hooks: `pre_api_request` and `post_api_request` to capture the latest assistant text per session, and `on_session_end` as the per-turn boundary that fires the "reply" push. Approvals use `gateway_client_event` when the server has it, else `pre_approval_request`. It skips sessions whose platform already notifies natively (Telegram, Discord, Slack, and so on) and `cron_`/`kanban_` sessions.
- **Gateway hook** (`hooks/hermes-push/HOOK.yaml` on `agent:end`, `handler.py`) posting the same shape for turns that finish outside the plugin hook path.
- **Sealed previews** (`privacy.py`). A 32-byte AES-256-GCM key lives at `<hermes_home>/plugins/<plugin>/preview_key` (0600, created under a file lock, never rotated behind a paired device). The relay-facing payload carries only `kind`, `session_id`, coarse `source`, `is_subagent`, a `sealed` blob (nonce + ciphertext, AAD `cadu-preview-v1:sha256(install_key)`), an HMAC `event_id` for relay dedupe and an HMAC `thread_id`. Title, subtitle, body, profile and request id are inside the ciphertext. On any failure it sends a content-free "New activity" notification; it never falls back to plaintext.
- **Relay** (`https://…/installs/{install_key}/notify`, source repository returns 404, so it is closed). The install key is a 64-hex capability the app generates and the user pastes into `HERMES_PUSH_INSTALL_KEY`; the relay fans out to every device paired under that key and applies per-device filters (reply toggle, subagent mute).

Upstream facts at hermes-agent HEAD `2ddeba9` (2026-09-10): `VALID_HOOKS` includes `pre_api_request`, `post_api_request`, `on_session_end` but **not** `gateway_client_event` or `pre_approval_request`; unknown hook names are stored for forward compatibility, so approval pushes may silently never fire on some builds. `PluginContext.register_approval_transport(name, present_fn)` exists and is the supported way to be told about approvals. Dashboard plugins with a `dashboard/` directory and an `api` field get routes mounted at `/api/plugins/<name>/` behind dashboard auth (Kanban and Achievements do this); whether a `kind: platform` plugin can also declare one must be verified.

Hermex today: no `aps-environment` entitlement, no remote-notification registration, no Notification Service Extension, and `AgentLiveActivityManager` requests activities with `pushType: nil`. App groups exist on the app and share extension. The iOS side is greenfield.

## Design

Three components, two repositories. The plugin and relay do not belong in the app repo: the phone never owns server responsibilities.

Second reference, compared 2026-09-10: [buzzkit](https://github.com/buzzkit-dev/buzzkit) `apps/ping` ("Buzz"), a Cloudflare Worker coding agents POST to. Its delivery etiquette is adopted below (pure delivery policy, one-second activity coalescing with status changes always through, collapse ids, stale dates, versioned activity state, presence suppression). Two of its choices are deliberately not adopted: it has no encryption, every title and body is plaintext on its server, which conflicts with sealed previews; and it merges every session into one Live Activity derived on the server, which would need plaintext titles at the relay and does not fit Hermex's per-session activity. Its rule that the phone never answers the agent matches the approval-push decision here.

**1. `hermex-push` hermes-agent plugin** (new repo `uzairansaruzi/hermex-push`, folder `plugin/`)
- Platform name `hermex`, env `HERMEX_PUSH_RELAY_URL`, `HERMEX_PUSH_HOME_CHANNEL`. Distinct from Cadu so both can coexist on one host during development; verify exactly one reply push per turn when both are installed.
- Same hook set as the reference for turn completion. For approvals and questions, prefer `register_approval_transport` and fall back to the observer hooks only when present in `VALID_HOOKS`. Push kinds: `reply`, `approval`, `clarify`, `input` (sudo/secret), `turn_error`, `delivery` (cron and webhook), `system`.
- Sealed previews as in the reference, AAD `hermex-preview-v1:sha256(install_key)`, key at `<hermes_home>/plugins/hermex-push/preview_key`.
- **Server-first pairing, no key typing.** The plugin generates `install_key` on first run and exposes `GET /api/plugins/hermex-push/pairing` returning `{relay_url, install_key, preview_key}` behind dashboard auth. Hermex already holds that login, so pairing is one authenticated call from the Bot connection screen. If a platform plugin cannot mount dashboard routes, fall back to a `hermes hermex-push pair` CLI that prints a one-time QR the app scans. This must be verified first.
- Live Activity progress: emit coalesced tool-boundary events (`tool.start`/`tool.complete`, turn start/end) with the session id; the relay maps them to registered activity tokens.

**2. `hermex-relay`** (same repo, folder `relay/`; open source; single small service)
- `POST /installs/{key}/devices` `{device_token, bundle_id, environment, prefs}`; `DELETE /installs/{key}/devices/{device_token}`; `POST /installs/{key}/notify` (plugin); `PUT /installs/{key}/devices/{device_token}/activities/{session_id}` `{activity_token}` and matching `DELETE`.
- Stores devices under `sha256(install_key)`, never the key itself, never plaintext. Dedupes on `event_id` for ten minutes. Live Activity updates are coalesced to one per activity per second for routine progress; a status change (start, waiting, done, failed) always goes through at high priority, and a push-to-start waits a short grace window (about four seconds) for the device to report its activity id before another start is attempted. Every activity push sets a stale date (fifteen minutes) so a dead agent greys out instead of lying. The plugin payload carries an HMAC `collapse_id` next to `thread_id` so a session without a running Live Activity sends one banner that rewrites itself (`apns-collapse-id`) instead of stacking, and a session already carried by a Live Activity never also sends a banner. Per-device prefs: replies on/off, subagent mute, previews on/off, presence suppression (off by default).
- Holds one APNs auth key (`.p8`) whose topics cover `com.uzairansaruzi.hermesmobile` and `com.uzairansaruzi.hermesmobile.branch`. Development and Branch TestFlight use the APNs sandbox.
- Deployment target (decided 2026-09-17): a Cloudflare Worker with KV. Estimated cost under ten dollars a month; APNs is free.

**3. Hermex iOS**
- Push entitlement and `registerForRemoteNotifications` gated behind a completed pairing, never at launch.
- Pairing UI in `BotConnectionView`: one "Enable notifications" action that calls the plugin pairing route, stores install and preview keys in server-scoped Keychain with a Keychain access group readable by the new Notification Service Extension, then registers the device token with the relay. Reverse: "Disable" deletes the device at the relay and wipes both keys. Removing the connection does the same.
- Notification Service Extension decrypts `sealed` with the preview key and rewrites title, subtitle and body; without a key it leaves the content-free notification alone. Tap routing opens the bot conversation by profile and session id through [#488](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/488). An approval push only navigates; it never approves.
- Live Activities: `AgentLiveActivityManager` requests bot activities with `pushType: .token`, forwards `pushTokenUpdates` to the relay, and removes them on end. Push-to-start is out of scope for the first release.

## Decisions (settled 2026-09-10)

- **Hosting: decided.** The relay is open source and self-hostable, and Uzair runs one default relay for Hermex users. The default relay sees device tokens, notification kinds, hashed thread ids and ciphertext, nothing else. Slice 7 amends the "no Hermex relay" wording in CLAUDE.md, README.md and the App Store privacy answers to describe this exactly.
- **APNs key custody.** The `.p8` lives only in the relay's secret store; slice 2 documents rotation.
- **In-app install: required.** Users must be able to install and configure the plugin on their Hermes instance from inside Hermex, without a terminal. The dashboard already exposes what this needs, verified on the live 0.21.1 host and in `hermes_cli/web_routers/dashboard_ui.py`: `POST /api/dashboard/agent-plugins/install` `{identifier, enable, force, catalog_name, ref}`, `POST /api/dashboard/agent-plugins/{name}/enable|update`, `PUT /api/env` `{key, value, profile}` for `HERMEX_PUSH_RELAY_URL`, and `POST /api/gateway/restart`. Verified in upstream `hermes_cli/plugins_cmd.py` (`_resolve_git_url`): `identifier` accepts a catalog name, `owner/repo`, a GitHub URL, or a `.git` URL with a `.git/<subdir>` suffix for a plugin living in a repo subfolder, so `https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex-push.git/plugin` works without a catalog entry. The install action installs code on the user's server and restarts their gateway, so its copy states exactly that and it never runs implicitly.

## Child slices to file

1. `hermex-push` repo skeleton: plugin MVP (reply and approval pushes, sealed previews, pairing route) with pytest fixtures; verify platform-plugin dashboard routes or fall back to the QR CLI; pin the install identifier form the app will send.
2. Relay MVP: device registry, notify fan-out, dedupe, `collapse_id` and `thread_id` on every banner, sandbox APNs, deploy script, self-hosting README, key rotation notes. The delivery policy (notify or not, interruption level, collapse id, thread id) is one pure function with unit tests, separate from the code that sends.
3. Hermex: **Enable notifications** in the Bot connection screen installs and enables the plugin on the connected Hermes instance, sets `HERMEX_PUSH_RELAY_URL` (default relay prefilled, self-host override), restarts the gateway with consequence-stating confirmation, then pairs. Reverse: disable removes the device at the relay, disables the plugin, and clears keys. Unit tests against a `URLProtocol` mock of both the dashboard and the relay.
4. Hermex: entitlement, device registration and revocation, Keychain access group.
5. Hermex: Notification Service Extension decrypting sealed previews, plus tap routing through #488.
6. Live Activity push tokens and relay-driven updates. The start/update/end/wait decision is one pure function with unit tests (one-second coalescing, status changes always through, start grace window); every push sets a fifteen-minute stale date; the activity content state carries a schema version, keeps `status` a string rather than an enum, and the widget renders something sane for a version newer than it knows, because installed builds lag the relay.
7. Per-device preferences including presence suppression (off by default: while the user is actively driving the session from Hermex or the foregrounded app, only `approval`, `clarify`, `input` and `turn_error` buzz; `reply` and progress banners are held, the Live Activity still updates), cron `deliver: hermex`, plugin catalog entry, docs including the CLAUDE.md and README relay wording, Branch TestFlight validation.

## Validation for the eventual implementation

Every claim of background delivery is proven with the app suspended and then terminated on a physical iPhone, on LAN and through a Cloudflare tunnel. Plaintext must never leave the host: a relay-side capture of a notification shows ciphertext only. Both bundle IDs receive pushes from one relay. Disabling notifications removes the device within one request. Existing webui notification behavior does not regress.

Model and harness: Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Code (design); reference plugin read on the maintainer's host with permission, no secrets recorded.

## V1 scope and filed slices (settled 2026-09-17)

Push is in Bot V1 and runs as Track B of [#493](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/493), in parallel with the in-app work. Changes to the design above:

- **Relay hosting:** Cloudflare Worker with KV.
- **Webui sessions get push too** ([#561](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/561)). Every payload carries the session's coarse source from slice 1. Pairing still goes through the Hermes connection, so that row moves out from behind the Bot Mode beta toggle ([#557](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/557)); the Bots inbox stays gated. A tap opens the session on the server that owns the pairing and falls back to that server's session list. A paired server's local completion notification is turned off.
- **Tap routing** depends on [#554](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/554) (carved out of [#488](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/488)), not on all of #488.
- **Bundle IDs** are `com.uzairansar.hermesmobile` and `com.uzairansar.hermesmobile.branch`.

Slices, in order: [#555](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/555) · [#556](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/556) · [#557](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/557) · [#558](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/558) · [#559](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/559) · [#560](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/560) · [#561](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/561) · [#562](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/562). V1.1: [#566](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/566).

Recorded by Claude Fable 5.1 (Claude Code) with the owner on 2026-09-17.

title: design(bots): handle specialized Desktop requests safely
body:
**Planned at:** `1163d75`, 2026-09-10. The #472 presentation changes were uncommitted at planning time; re-read them after integration. **Effort:** L · **Risk:** HIGH.

**Depends on:** [#472](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/472) integrated into `bot-mode`, [#476](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/476), [#478](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/478).

Decision/specification only; do not implement until the owner selects the behavior.

Work from a short `issue/<n>-slug` branch based on the latest `bot-mode`; any later approved PR targets `bot-mode`, not `master`. Read AGENTS.md, docs/agents/bots.md and docs/agents/multi-server-state-isolation.md. No push, PR, merge, release, new dependency or live-host changes are authorized by this ticket.

## Context and current behavior

Beyond ordinary approvals/questions, a bot may request a secret, sudo password, MCP setup, terminal/window context or an interactive preview. A phone cannot assume it has the Desktop’s context or authority.

- `Features/Bots/BotConnection.swift`: BotProfile projection and Keychain-backed connection identity.
- `Features/Bots/BotsInboxView.swift`: roster fetch and presentation.
- `Features/Bots/BotConversation.swift`: explicit async ownership, durable draft ambiguity, canonical root/tip/runtime, snapshots/replay and Stop.
- `Networking/Bots/BotClient.swift`: isolated cookie session, single-use socket ticket, JSON-RPC, per-call deadline and a six-method allowlist.
- `docs/agents/bots.md`: current direct-Hermes contract and deliberate MVP limits. Existing webui services are a different contract.

Drift check: `git diff --stat 1163d75..HEAD -- HermesMobile/Features/Bots HermesMobile/Networking/Bots HermesMobileTests`. Expected prerequisite changes are not a blocker: reconcile them before coding. If behavior conflicts with this scope, update the plan rather than preserving stale assumptions.

## Contract evidence

The gateway declares these late-response methods and browser-controller methods. The response table includes text/result/password/value payloads, and some late answers remain admissible after the initial wait. Browser-controller registration requires an authenticated identity and authorized capabilities. These are not ordinary chat messages.

Verified against Hermes Agent 0.21.1 installed source at `ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b` on 2026-09-10. Unless explicitly described as live-verified above, method availability/shape comes from source, not an executed mutation. This is the direct password/cookie + WebSocket backend, not the webui API or the separate bearer-auth API server. Source registration does not guarantee a method is enabled for every deployment.

- `mcp.setup.respond`: [tui_gateway/methods_prompt.py:1089](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/tui_gateway/methods_prompt.py#L1089)

## Expected behavior and acceptance criteria

- [ ] Classify each request as supported on phone, hand off to Desktop, or unsupported, with truthful action wording and the affected machine visible.
- [ ] For any proposed secret/sudo input, specify ephemeral memory, no logs/drafts/clipboard persistence by default, exact request ownership and transport protection. Obtain the owner decision before implementation.
- [ ] Never answer terminal/window requests with data from the iPhone or another Mac as if it came from the server. Do not register a browser controller merely to dismiss a card.
- [ ] Specify how expired/canceled/answered-in-Desktop requests resolve, and how unsupported requests remain visible without blocking unrelated navigation.
- [ ] Produce an approved capability matrix and narrow implementation follow-ups; no credentials, live responses, shell execution or controller registration in this ticket.

## Scope and steps

`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/`, `HermesMobile/Networking/Bots/`, matching `HermesMobileTests/Bot*` fixtures, and `docs/agents/bots.md`; add focused sibling files and Xcode target membership as needed.



1. Inspect prerequisites and the current code; validate the cited upstream handlers without calling mutations.
2. Produce the behavior/contract artifact required by the acceptance criteria, with static mocks where visual choices are material.
3. Record supported methods, exact request/results, effects, dependencies and owner choices in this issue; split the selected implementation into narrow follow-ups.

## Validation

This ticket produces a decision, not app changes. Validate every cited handler against source, review fixtures and static mocks, and record the owner’s selection. No build/test ceremony is required until implementation. The resulting implementation tickets must require the following:

- Before UI implementation, follow AGENTS.md: create distinct static mocks via html-communication and wait for Uzair’s selection. The owner has deferred a general UI redesign; do not treat this issue as approval for one.
- Focused XCTest at the BotTransport/socket/URLProtocol or presentation seam, using expectations/scripted fixtures. Include two connections with identical Profile names, stale callbacks and missing/unknown server fields.
- Full suite: `xcodebuild test -project HermesMobile.xcodeproj -scheme HermesMobile -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' -parallel-testing-enabled NO` → `TEST SUCCEEDED` before review/commit.
- Signed build/install/launch: `xcodebuildmcp simulator build-and-run` with selected isolated iPhone 17 defaults. Never install a CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build. All consuming extension targets must build.
- `git diff --check` → exit 0. Run `scripts/check-swift-file-sizes` when production Swift grows; warnings guide scope, not unrelated refactors.
- Native manual checks cover VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, light/dark, keyboard and the scenario below. Live prompts, resumes, Stop and any server mutation need an exact disposable test procedure approved by the owner. Existing #471 test prompts are consumed.

**Owner scenario:** Review fixture requests covering every family and verify the proposed destination/consequence is understandable.

## Boundaries

- Reuse existing Sessions/Tasks/Settings/voice presentation where appropriate; do not duplicate scheduled Tasks, global server administration, Git, memory/skills browsing or provider/account management through a second backend.
- Bot profile-scoped functionality remains in scope even when a webui screen has a similar name. Route contextually only with proven connection/Profile mapping.
- No generic expose-every-RPC UI; no moving server execution/relay/orchestration responsibility onto iOS. Unknown methods/capabilities degrade honestly without weakening auth or probing by mutation.
- Canonical lookup can unarchive and resume can continue work. Never call them merely to inspect capabilities. Preserve root/tip/runtime identities and never automatically retry an ambiguous command.
- Stop and report if the required contract cannot be verified, a new dependency/host mutation is necessary, or an owner decision remains unresolved. A missing backend capability should become a concrete upstream gap, not an invented client fallback.

Model and harness: GPT-6, Codex.

- Signed build/install/launch: `xcodebuildmcp simulator build-and-run` with selected isolated iPhone 17 defaults. Never install a CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build. All consuming extension targets must build.
- `git diff --check` → exit 0. Run `scripts/check-swift-file-sizes` when production Swift grows; warnings guide scope, not unrelated refactors.
- Native manual checks cover VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, light/dark, keyboard and the scenario below. Live prompts, resumes, Stop and any server mutation need an exact disposable test procedure approved by the owner. Existing #471 test prompts are consumed.

**Owner scenario:** Review several static mocks and fixture cases for missing sprite, canceled generation and Desktop-side identity changes.

## Boundaries

- Reuse existing Sessions/Tasks/Settings/voice presentation where appropriate; do not duplicate scheduled Tasks, global server administration, Git, memory/skills browsing or provider/account management through a second backend.
- Bot profile-scoped functionality remains in scope even when a webui screen has a similar name. Route contextually only with proven connection/Profile mapping.
- No generic expose-every-RPC UI; no moving server execution/relay/orchestration responsibility onto iOS. Unknown methods/capabilities degrade honestly without weakening auth or probing by mutation.
- Canonical lookup can unarchive and resume can continue work. Never call them merely to inspect capabilities. Preserve root/tip/runtime identities and never automatically retry an ambiguous command.
- Stop and report if the required contract cannot be verified, a new dependency/host mutation is necessary, or an owner decision remains unresolved. A missing backend capability should become a concrete upstream gap, not an invented client fallback.

Model and harness: GPT-6, Codex.

title: epic(bots): complete the direct-Hermes Bot experience
body:
This is the ordered execution plan for [#299](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/299), building on [#471](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/471) and [#472](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/472). It expands the selected direct-Hermes Bot implementation; it does not replace the existing webui feature roadmap or the separate API-server proposal [#177](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/177).

## Outcome

A user can recognize their Desktop bots, follow real work, unblock requests, share context, direct specialists and return to the correct conversation from iOS system entry points. Bot state belongs to the chosen direct-Hermes connection; execution stays on the server.

Uzair requested comprehensive Bot capability coverage on 2026-09-10. Use every Bot-related capability that improves this experience, with an explicit disposition for all inspected endpoints. An endpoint is not itself a reason to add a screen or to bypass a server ownership restriction. The matrix below assigns implementation, a design/contract gate, existing shared functionality, or a reason for exclusion.

## Current state and integration

- #472 landed on `bot-mode` via [#495](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/495) on 2026-09-10 (squash merge). `master` is `befc89d`, one composer fix ahead of `bot-mode`. The enhancements below may now start, in the listed order.
- **Integration rule (settled 2026-09-10).** `bot-mode` is a short-lived integration branch. Sequence: [#495](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/495) merges into `bot-mode`; [#496](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/496) adds a default-off "Bot Mode (beta)" Settings toggle that hides every Bot entry point; then the maintainer merges `bot-mode` into `master` through one reviewed PR. From that point every subissue is one short `issue/<n>-slug` branch and one PR targeting `master`, and the flag stays off until the release PR that ships Bot Mode removes it. Bring `master` into `bot-mode` only through a reviewed merge; never rebase shared `bot-mode` history. Rationale: Bot Mode is the headline of the next release, but a hotfix release from `master` in the meantime must not carry unfinished Bot UI; the flag makes `master` hotfix-safe without paying a conflict round on a side branch for every composer change.
- #471 remains the integrated MVP/release validation gate: physical iPhone on LAN and through a Cloudflare tunnel (the maintainer's two setups; Tailscale stays a documented user scenario), streaming, backgrounding past the tunnel idle timeout with reconnect and replay, Stop, multi-server isolation, localization and accessibility. Simulator-on-LAN login and streaming passed on 2026-09-10 and proves none of the backgrounding cases.
- No merge into master, TestFlight, push, PR or live-host mutation is authorized by these tickets. Publication authorizes planning; implementation follows explicit selection and the repository workflow.

## Ordered subissues

**V1 scope settled 2026-09-17.** V1 is an App Store release with the Bot Mode (beta) toggle kept, so users opt in. The date is flexible; the bar is every main feature plus polished UI. The owner runs one physical-iPhone pass at the end ([#563](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/563)), which also closes [#471](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/471). Two tracks run in parallel because they touch different files; inside a track, work the listed order. Depends-on links in each issue are the actual prerequisites.

**Step 0.** [ ] [#538](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/538) — fix the red Bot presentation tests on iPhone 17e / iOS 27. A red suite blocks every slice.

**Track A — in the app**

1. [x] [#551](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/551) — `/` in the Bot composer: skills and the server command catalog, sent as text
2. [x] [#552](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/552) — `@` tags files alongside bot mentions in one panel · after [#551](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/551) (same files)
3. [x] [#487](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/487) — on-device dictation into the Bot composer · rewritten 2026-09-17; after [#552](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/552) (same files)
4. [x] [#553](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/553) — copy, select and Ask Hermex on bot messages · owns the transcript files, so it can run beside steps 1–3
5. [x] [#477](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/477) — delegated work, trimmed to list, tail and interrupt · can run beside steps 1–3
6. [x] [#554](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/554) — open a bot conversation from a deep link · carved out of [#488](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/488); can run beside steps 1–5
7. [x] [#489](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/489) — bot work in Live Activities · after [#554](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/554) and [#477](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/477)

**Track B — push ([#490](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/490)), starts at the same time as Track A**

1. [ ] [#555](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/555) — plugin MVP, sealed previews, pairing route · carries the session source from day one; holds the two fact checks
2. [ ] [#556](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/556) — relay on a Cloudflare Worker · beside [#555](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/555) once the payload shape is agreed
3. [ ] [#557](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/557) — one-tap Enable notifications; moves the Hermes connection row out from behind the beta toggle
4. [ ] [#558](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/558) — entitlement, device registration, Keychain access group · beside [#557](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/557); owner provisions the Apple side
5. [ ] [#559](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/559) — Notification Service Extension and tap routing · needs [#558](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/558) and [#554](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/554)
6. [ ] [#560](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/560) — bot Live Activities from push tokens · needs [#489](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/489)
7. [ ] [#561](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/561) — push for webui sessions, local duplicate retired · gated on [#555](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/555)'s fact check
8. [ ] [#562](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/562) — describe the relay honestly in CLAUDE.md, README and the privacy answers · release-blocking

**Release.** [ ] [#563](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/563) — the owner's UI punch list, the device pass, pins, labels, release.

**V1.1**

- [#488](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/488) — share and Shortcuts bot pickers (deep-link part moved to [#554](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/554))
- [#564](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/564) — quotes, streaming fade, link previews, context indicator

- [#566](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/566) — push preferences, presence suppression, cron delivery, webui Live Activity push
- Server speech-to-text and spoken replies (follow-up to [#487](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/487)); dropping the "beta" label; unifying the two composers.

**Done (in the order they landed)**

1. [x] [#496](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/496) — hide Bot Mode behind a default-off Settings toggle, then merge `bot-mode` into `master` · after #495 merges; the merge itself is the maintainer's action
2. [x] [#494](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/494) — pin the tested hermes-agent version and warn on untested servers · small
3. [x] [#473](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/473) — show Desktop avatars and Profile identity · cut to a small slice: static avatar plus display name
4. [x] [#475](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/475) — show tools, reasoning and work progress in chat · **gated on the #471 reconnect/replay proof on a physical iPhone through the Cloudflare tunnel**; this slice widens the replay path
5. [x] [#476](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/476) — answer approvals and questions from the phone · absorbs the former #491: unsupported request kinds show a Desktop-attention state and are never answered from the phone
6. [x] [#480](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/480) — steer active work and manage follow-up prompts · now depends on #475 and #476, not on model controls
7. [x] [#474](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/474) — keep the inbox live and honor Desktop organization
8. [x] [#478](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/478) — send attachments and open generated artifacts
9. [x] [#479](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/479) — add chat model controls and usage details
10. [x] [#481](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/481) — define safe history, branching and canonical chat recovery · decision / contract gate
11. [x] [#482](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/482) — edit a bot role, model and capabilities
12. [x] [#483](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/483) — create, duplicate and remove bots deliberately
13. [x] [#484](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/484) — verify explicit mentions and cross-bot delivery · decision / contract gate
14. [x] [#485](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/485) — verify the server-owned group chat contract · decided 2026-09-16: rooms are server-driven, the phone is a polling client; the decision comment holds the matrix and the design reference
15. [x] [#526](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/526) — advance the tested hermes-agent pin to 0.21.2 · small; runs before #486
16. [x] [#486](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/486) — show group rooms and follow their logs read-only · viewer slice, rewritten from the decision
17. [x] [#527](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/527) — send, stop, approve and retry inside a group room · participant slice; the only authorized live mutation is one disposable room
18. [x] [#529](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/529) — create, rename and disband group rooms from the phone · manager slice; disband is permanent
19. [x] [#528](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/528) — cache group room logs for search and faster opens · after #486, independent of #527

Closed 2026-09-10: [#491](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/491) folded into #476; [#492](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/492) out of scope.

## Scope: reuse what Hermex already has

- **Scheduled Tasks stay with webui, and there is no Bot-to-Tasks link.** Do not build a second cron CRUD UI, and do not add a bot details shortcut or filter into webui Tasks, Sessions or Settings. A webui server and a Hermes connection can be different hosts, equal Profile names are not identity proof, and building that proof is not worth it. This limitation is a consequence of the secondary-connection model and resolves itself if the Hermes connection later becomes a peer server type.
- Existing server settings, status/logs, provider/API-key management, skills marketplace, global memory, Git/workspace and ordinary webui session features retain their existing owners. Track parity in [#395](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/395), not here.
- Bot-specific Profile role/model/capability edits and Bot-related history remain in scope even if an existing screen has a similar name. Reuse presentation with explicit transport binding.
- Reuse the current voice/audio, attachment, notification and ActivityKit systems. Do not create parallel engines, caches or a universal backend abstraction merely to share UI.
- **Push is honest until #490 ships.** Foreground sockets are never described as notification delivery. Uzair decided on 2026-09-10 to build a Hermex-owned push plugin and relay; #490 holds the design. Until it lands, #489 shows stale/disconnected state on suspend rather than promising freshness.
- Basic static Desktop avatars ship first (#473). Generated and pet identities are out of scope (#492 closed); continuous idle animation remains out of scope.

## Verified evidence

Running Hermes Agent identified as 0.21.1 at planning time; on 2026-09-16 the host reported 0.21.2 at `3abeca16e66cad4875f7b40beb0eb54bc4a589d5` ([#526](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/526) advances the pin). Group rooms were verified read-only on 2026-09-16: the hosted-room driver is enabled, one room exists, and no room mutation was executed. Installed source commit `ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b` was inspected with no tracked changes in the relevant directories. Its live OpenAPI advertised 283 HTTP paths / 324 method-path operations; installed sources declare 206 RPC names and six WebSocket routes. Counts include generic infrastructure and do not imply 206 Bot UX features or runtime authorization for every method.

Authenticated read probes passed for status/health, Profile roster, model options, config schema, session listing, cron listing and messaging platforms. `/api/ws` login/ticket/roster/avatar calls passed. All four configured bots returned avatar PNGs through `profiles.get_asset`; roster rows included shared Bot metadata. No bot creation, resume, prompt, Stop, group mutation or notification delivery was executed for this review.

Inspected push plugin identifies itself as Push (Cadu) 1.3.0 with separate APNs relay pairing and encrypted previews. Its secrets and the maintainer’s address/login are omitted. That integration is not a generic Hermes push endpoint and cannot be adopted as Hermex pairing.

Primary contract sources: [Profile RPCs](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/tui_gateway/methods_profiles.py), [session RPCs](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/tui_gateway/methods_session.py), [requests](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/tui_gateway/methods_prompt.py), [worker RPCs](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/tui_gateway/methods_subagents.py), [groups](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/tui_gateway/methods_groups.py), [relay](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/tui_gateway/methods_bot_relay.py), [HTTP routers](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/hermes_cli/web_routers), [Desktop Bots](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b/apps/desktop/src/plugins/hermes-bots).

Revalidate volatile methods/fields against the installed source and a scoped server just before implementation. `gateway.capabilities` is not an exhaustive RPC discovery API. Never test a feature by sending a mutating probe. `session.list` canonical lookup may unarchive; `session.resume` may auto-continue.

## Bot-related HTTP coverage

| Routes | Owner / disposition |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/status`, `POST /auth/password-login`, `GET /api/auth/me`, `POST /api/auth/ws-ticket` | Existing #471 authentication. Preserve isolated cookie/ticket sessions. |
| `/api/profiles`, `/api/profiles/{name}`, `/soul`, `/description`, `/model`, `/desktop-overlay` | [#482](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/482), [#483](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/483); use verified Profile/RPC equivalent where appropriate. |
| `/api/profiles/{name}/describe-auto`, Profile import/export | [#483](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/483) accounts for generated setup and lifecycle; imported configuration must not silently duplicate credentials or canonical chats. |
| `/api/sessions`, `/api/sessions/search`, `/api/sessions/{id}/messages`, `/latest-descendant`, `/export` | [#481](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/481), scoped to Bot-related history; no duplicate global Sessions tab. |
| `/api/sessions/{id}` mutations, session import | [#481](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/481) defines canonical consequences first. No bulk delete/prune/owner-backfill through Bot UI. |
| `/api/chat/image-upload`, `/api/files/upload`, `/api/files/upload-stream`, `/api/files/download`, `/api/files/stream`, `/api/media`, relevant `/api/fs/*` reads | [#478](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/478). No arbitrary workspace writer or Git admin here. |
| `/api/model/options`, `/api/model/info`, `/api/config/schema`, `/api/config` | [#479](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/479), [#482](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/482); only bounded Bot/session/Profile settings, not raw server admin. |
| `/api/audio/transcribe`, `/api/audio/voice-config`, `/api/audio/speak`, `/api/audio/tts-lease` | [#487](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/487); server microphone/speaker ownership must be explicit. |
| `/api/skills/*`, `/api/tools/toolsets/*`, `/api/mcp/*` | Existing webui management; [#482](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/482) handles Bot-specific assignment/enablement and contextual entry only. |
| `/api/cron/*` | Reuse existing Tasks. No new scheduled-Task backend implementation in this epic. |
| `/api/health`, `/api/system/stats`, `/api/logs`, gateway/update/provider/env/credentials/local-model APIs | Existing settings/operations owners. No duplicate Bot admin UI or credential dumping. |
| `/api/plugins/kanban/*`, achievements, global analytics/memory/learning/Git/projects | Existing features/backlog; only Bot-attributed progress/notices and context link to the appropriate existing view. |

## WebSocket coverage

- `/api/ws`: existing Bot transport; extend only for accepted child features.
- `/api/audio/speak-stream`: [#487](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/487), after contract verification.
- `/api/console`, `/api/pty`: no terminal emulator in this epic; specialized requests are covered by [#476](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/476) (former #491, folded in: Desktop-attention only, never answered from the phone).
- `/api/pub`, `/api/events`: PTY publish/subscribe transport, not APNs or a universal Bot event feed. Do not add to the client just because they exist.

## Complete inspected RPC disposition

Every inspected RPC name appears below. title: chore(bots): pin the tested hermes-agent version and warn on untested servers
body:
Part of [#493](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/493). **Effort:** S · **Risk:** LOW. **Depends on:** [#472](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/472) integrated into `bot-mode`.

Work from a short `issue/<n>-slug` branch. Until `bot-mode` has merged into `master` (integration rule in #493), base on and target `bot-mode`; afterwards `master`. No push, PR, merge or release is authorized by this ticket.

## Problem

Hermex records the tested hermes-webui commit in `UPSTREAM_TESTED_SHA` and documents it in README.md and AGENTS.md. The direct-Hermes Bot connection has no equivalent. The epic cites installed hermes-agent 0.21.1 at `ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b`, upstream pushes daily, and users upgrade their servers on their own schedule. When the gateway contract moves, nothing tells the user or the maintainer that the app was never tested against their server.

## Expected behavior

- [ ] Add `HERMES_AGENT_TESTED_SHA` at the repo root, same one-line format as `UPSTREAM_TESTED_SHA`, seeded with `ee35a4624fa22237a90426f5e21d8b4f2ce3a49b` and a second line `0.21.1` for the release string `/api/status` reports as `version`.
- [ ] `BotClient.connect()` already reads `/api/status`. Surface the reported `version` on the Bot connection record and show a one-line, non-blocking "Untested Hermes version" note in `BotConnectionView` when it differs from the pinned release. Never block login on it; the contract is validated just in time, not by version string.
- [ ] Document the pin next to `UPSTREAM_TESTED_SHA` in README.md, AGENTS.md (Working with the server) and `docs/agents/bots.md`, including how to advance it: run the read-only Bot RPCs (`profiles.list`, `session.list`, `session.resume` on the disposable test bot) and the `/api/status`, `/api/auth/me`, `/api/auth/ws-ticket` routes against a live server, then edit the file and name the validating commit in the PR.
- [ ] Focused XCTest: the version comparison and the copy toggle, with a scripted `/api/status` fixture including a missing `version` field (tolerant decode, no note shown).

## Validation

Full XCTest suite, signed Debug build and install, `git diff --check`. Manual: connect to the live 0.21.1 host and confirm no note; edit the pin locally to a different release and confirm the note appears.

Model and harness: Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Code.

title: feat(bots): match the regular Hermex chat interface
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #472

## What changed

Bot chat had a separate minimal composer and transcript that did not look like the rest of Hermex. This PR makes it visually match regular session chat by reusing the existing presentation instead of restyling a second stack.

- Transcript rows use `MessageBubbleView` in a new text-only mode, so bubbles, typography and spacing match Sessions.
- The composer is `BotChatComposerView`, built on the shared `ChatComposerTextInputView`, with the glass surface and action-button appearance extracted from `MessageComposerView` into `ChatComposerPresentation.swift` so both surfaces share one definition.
- Bot state stays Bot-owned: `BotConversation`, drafts, Stop, disconnected and held-message states are unchanged in behavior and surface above the composer as before.
- Text-only scope preserved: no attachments, voice, runtime controls or approvals were added.

## How it was tested

- Full XCTest suite via XcodeBuildMCP `test_sim` on iPhone 17: `TEST SUCCEEDED`, 2356 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped.
- New `BotChatPresentationTests` render the composer and transcript states (ready, disconnected, held message, growing response) and check the visible output.
- Maintainer manual pass on the simulator against a LAN Hermes 0.21.1 host: login, roster, canonical chat, send and stream.
- `git diff --check` clean; `scripts/check-swift-file-sizes` adds no new warnings.

Before/after screenshots: not attached by the agent; the maintainer validated the surface on the simulator and can add captures if wanted for the record.

## Checklist

- [x] The full test suite passes locally
- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly (no model changes)
- [x] No new third-party dependencies
- [x] No invented API endpoints or JSON shapes (no networking changes)

title: chore(bots): hide Bot Mode behind a default-off Settings toggle, then merge bot-mode into master
body:
Part of [#493](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/493). **Effort:** S · **Risk:** LOW. **Depends on:** [#495](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/495) merged into `bot-mode`.

Work from a short `issue/<n>-slug` branch based on the latest `bot-mode`, PR targeting `bot-mode`. After this PR merges, the maintainer opens one reviewed PR merging `bot-mode` into `master`; that merge is the maintainer's action and is not authorized by this ticket.

## Problem

Bot Mode is the headline of the next release, but it will land on `master` slice by slice over weeks. `master` is the TestFlight candidate and the branch any hotfix release would ship from. Unfinished Bot UI must not reach the App Store through a hotfix, and a long-lived `bot-mode` branch costs a conflict round for every composer or chat change on `master`.

## Expected behavior

- [ ] One stored bool, `botModeEnabled`, default off, owned by the existing Settings screen (a "Bot Mode (beta)" row with one sentence saying the feature is unfinished). Use the existing `@AppStorage` settings pattern; no new store, no per-server scope (this is an app-wide preview gate, not user data).
- [ ] When off, the Sessions/Bots switch and the Bots inbox are not reachable from any entry point: session list, deep links, App Intents, share extension, Live Activity taps. Existing webui behavior is unchanged. When on, everything behaves as on `bot-mode` today.

title: test: trim the slowest XCTests so PR CI finishes sooner
body:
**Effort:** S · **Risk:** LOW. Work from a short `issue/<n>-slug` branch off `master`. No push, PR or merge is authorized by this ticket.

## Problem

PR CI (`Build and Test` in `.github/workflows/pr-ci.yml`) takes about 9m30s: 2m26s to build, 6m23s to run 2,367 tests on one simulator worker. #108 already measured the other levers and rejected them: two or three workers made the run slower or timed out through simulator contention, and SwiftPM caching saved about 30s. What remains is the shape of the suite itself. The "Report slowest tests" step on run [34550593519](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/actions/runs/34550593519) shows seven tests taking about 115s, close to a third of the test step:

| Test | Time |
|---|---:|
| `BotConversationTests.testLongInflightResponseRemainsVisibleAtLatestEdge` | 36.2s |
| `BotChatPresentationTests.testBotFixturesAcrossAppearanceKeyboardAndLargerText` | 34.0s |
| `TranscriptMediaPreviewViewModelTests.testExtensionlessRemoteAudioUsesAudioPreviewInsteadOfVideoFallback` | 16.4s |
| `ClarificationTests.testClarificationResponseFailureKeepsPromptAndPublishesActionError` | 10.1s |
| `CustomHeaderModelTests.testIsApplicableRejectsNonTokenHeaderNames` | 7.7s |
| `StreamingTextFadeTests.testFadeRendererAttachesThroughMarkdownUIAndAppliesStampOpacity` | 5.5s |
| `AuthManagerStateTests.testRemoveNonActiveServerClearsOnlyItsCookies` | 5.5s |

The two Bot tests host real SwiftUI windows and wait for `BotRenderFrameDriver` display-link commits per snapshot or fixture variant, so most of their time is frames, not assertions. The others are not render tests and have no obvious reason to take seconds; `AGENTS.md` says async tests wait on expectations and fixtures, never on timeouts, so a multi-second unit test usually means one is waiting for something to expire.

## Expected behavior

- [ ] For each test above, find what the time is spent on (frame waits, expired timeouts, real media encoding, retries) and remove the wait without dropping an assertion. Fewer rendered variants or fewer frames per variant is fine when the remaining ones still cover the behavior the test is named for; a test that only passes because a timeout elapses is fixed, not shortened.
- [ ] Every test listed runs in under 3s on the iPhone 17 simulator locally; the two Bot render tests may take up to 8s if they still need real frames.
- [ ] No test is deleted or skipped, and no coverage moves to a manual gate.
- [ ] Report before and after times per test, and the `Test without building` duration of the PR's CI run against run 34550593519, in the PR body.

## Validation

Full XCTest suite on iPhone 17 via XcodeBuildMCP `test_sim`, then read the "Report slowest tests" step of the PR's CI run. Do not change the worker count, caching or workflow structure; those are measured and closed in #108.
