title: fix(chat): explain the restart Hermes WebUI 409 and offer a fix prompt
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #955

## What changed

After a Hermes Agent update, hermes-webui refuses every send with HTTP 409 `{"type": "agent_runtime_stale", …}` until someone restarts it. The app showed the raw "Server returned HTTP 409: …" text, cut off at 200 characters.

- `APIError` decodes optional `type` and `agent_update_state` in their own payload, so another shape can't hide an error's other fields. A 409 with that type maps to `AgentRuntimeStale` (`.updated` for no or unknown state, `.updating` for `active`, `.incomplete`) and shows the app's own copy wherever `errorDescription` is shown. Git commit-message generation, which reads `serverMessage`, gets the same copy. Every other 409 behaves as before.
- `ChatViewModel.sendErrorRuntimeStale` exposes the kind for chat sends (Send, voice notes, and slash commands that send). A different `sendErrorMessage` clears it.
- The composer error banner gets a trailing **Copy fix prompt** text button in Retry's spot and style. It copies the issue's prompt, swaps to "Copied" with a checkmark with no animation, posts "Fix prompt copied" for VoiceOver, wraps like Retry for long translations, and stacks below the message at accessibility sizes. It is hidden for `active`.
- Debug only: `--stale-runtime-send` fails the first chat send of a launch with this 409 before any network call (DEVELOPMENT.md).
- 7 String Catalog keys with all 17 translations; the quoted server sentence stays in English.

Decision applied: https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/955#issuecomment-5961799697. Contract: pinned upstream `api/agent_runtime.py:147` (c296673e); the commit-message routes return it at `routes.py:26143` and `:26176`.

**Design:** pick A, trailing text button: https://i59lu7f6h93w.postplan.dev#issue-955

## How it was tested

- Red, against unchanged code: `testStaleAgentRuntimeConflictUsesRestartCopy` and `testStaleAgentRuntimeSendFailureExplainsRestartAndRollsBack` got "Server returned HTTP 409: Hermes Agent was updated…"; `testCommitSheetSuggestShowsRestartCopyForStaleAgentRuntime` got the raw server text; `testStaleAgentRuntimeSlashSendKeepsFixPrompt` got `nil` for the kind; `testOtherConflictsKeepServerCopy` (odd-shaped `type`) got "Server returned HTTP 409.".
- `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only` APIClientAuthAndErrorTests, ChatViewModelSendTests, BotChatPresentationTests, LocalizationCatalogTests: 300 passed, 2 failed, 2 skipped. The 2 failures are hosted Bot UI tests this change doesn't touch; they fail the same way on unchanged master on this simulator.
- After the review fixes: ChatViewModelSendTests, GitWorkspaceViewModelTests, SlashCommandExecutorTests: 285 passed; then APIClientAuthAndErrorTests, ChatViewModelSendTests, GitWorkspaceViewModelTests: 289 passed, 0 failed.
- `ci/check_string_catalog.py`: all 2161 keys covered. Signed Debug build with `--stale-runtime-send`: banner, Copy fix prompt, "Copied", and the pasteboard matched the issue's prompt byte for byte.

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator (Release/TestFlight cannot show this banner)

1. Launch the Debug build with `--stale-runtime-send`, open a chat, type a message and Send. Expect "Hermes was updated on your server. Restart Hermes WebUI there, then try again." with **Copy fix prompt**, no new bubble, and the draft still in the composer. Don't send again: the next send reaches the server.
2. Tap **Copy fix prompt**. Expect "Copied" with a checkmark and no animation (VoiceOver announces "Fix prompt copied"); pasting in Notes gives the issue's prompt.
3. On the narrowest iPhone simulator at the largest accessibility text size (AX5), repeat step 1. Expect the button below the message, fully visible, nothing clipped.
4. With the app language set to Russian, then German, repeat step 1 at the default text size and at AX5. Expect "Копировать запрос для исправления" / "Lösungs-Prompt kopieren" to wrap inside the banner without squeezing the message to a narrow column or running past the screen edges.

iPad Pro 11-inch (M5):
1. Repeat iPhone step 1 and 2. Expect the same banner and Copy fix prompt in the chat composer.

- [x] Local validation passes using `scripts/test-sim <assigned-simulator-udid>`; the selection and results are recorded above
- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly
- [x] No new third-party dependencies
- [x] No invented API endpoints or JSON shapes (verified against pinned upstream c296673e)

**Cost:** Medium. Needs the owner's hands for the upload approval, the full first-RC checklist on a physical iPhone, and App Review.

Prepare the Hermex 1.9 release candidate from `master`, following `TESTFLIGHT.md`.

title: chore(ci): build with Xcode 27.0 locally, on CI, and for release
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #931

## What changed

CI built with Xcode 26.6 while local work uses Xcode 27.0, so some failures (the ChatView type-check timeout, #917's regression) only showed up on CI, late.

- PR CI and the TestFlight release workflow now run on GitHub's `xcode-27` runner image with `DEVELOPER_DIR` pinned to Xcode 27.0 (27A266a), the same build as the maintainer's Mac.
- CI tests on the image's **iOS 27.0** iPhone 17 simulator. **iOS 26 is deliberately not covered on CI**: the image ships no iOS 26 runtime, and downloading one would add minutes to every run. This is the maintainer's call to keep CI time down, and it narrows #931's acceptance ("CI still runs the suite on an iOS 26.x simulator").
- Tests run with `-collect-test-diagnostics never`, as the local runner already does. On this image a failing run otherwise spent 10 minutes timing out a simulator sysdiagnose.

title: feat(hermes): send and stream a Hermes session in the main chat
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, a session opens in the regular chat screen. You can send, watch the reply stream, stop, steer, queue, and come back after backgrounding without duplicated text.
**Why it matters:** This is the first chat step of Hermex 2.0 (#713). Slices 1.2–1.5, #705's composer controls and the decision 11 checkpoint all build on it.
**Cost:** Large. Needs the owner's phone through the tunnel.

Part of #701 (slice 1.1) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #903 · **Unblocks:** #1011 (slice 1.2), #705 slice 5.1

## Problem and outcome

The main chat only works with webui:
- `ChatViewModel` builds a concrete `APIClient` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatViewModel.swift:647`) and calls it directly: send `performChatSend` (:2671), steer (:2987), goal (:2754).
- `ChatStreamCoordinator` is SSE plus `stream_id` (`ChatStreamCoordinator.swift:135`, :281, reconnect :451-591).
- A Hermes server shows only the Bots inbox (`HermesMobile/ContentView.swift:330-358`). Every chat entry point switches away to a webui server (`reachWebuiServer`, :217-229).

After this, `ChatView` can run a Hermes session on #903's `HermesConversation` engine. The engine owns attach, replay, gaps and never-resend; this slice adds the delta reducer and the turn state machine. A temporary "New Session" menu item opens it. Webui chat is unchanged.

## Contract

Evidence pinned to Hermex `209e0987` and hermes-agent `ca678285` (`HERMES_AGENT_TESTED_SHA`); `tg/` = `tui_gateway/`. Params are `extra=forbid`: an unknown key returns 4000.

**Profile.**
- `GET /api/profiles/active` returns `{active, current}` (`hermes_cli/web_routers/profiles.py:777-793`). Use `current`, the Profile this dashboard is scoped to.

**Attach and send.**
- `session.create` (`tg/methods_session.py:431`) returns the reduced shape `{session_id, stored_session_id, message_count, messages, info}` (:629-652). #903's `.new` accepts it.
- `session.resume` (:915): warm reattach `status` is `waiting|starting|working|idle` (`tg/server.py:2764`), plus `inflight`, `queued` and `open_requests` when non-empty.
- `prompt.submit {session_id: runtime, text, queued: true}` (`tg/methods_prompt.py:564`) replies `streaming` or `queued`, plus `user_row_id`. `queued:true` only matters while busy: it forces queue mode instead of the host's `busy_input_mode` (default interrupt, `tg/session_auto_continue.py:248`).
- A stale runtime returns 4001: resume the stored key.

**Steer, redirect, stop.**
- `session.steer` (`methods_session.py:2174-2203`) replies `queued` (accepted) or `rejected` (also when idle, new since 0.21.4). Errors: 4002 empty, 4010 can't steer.
- `session.redirect` (:2205) replies `redirected`, or `queued` while the agent is initializing, or `rejected`. Error 4010.
- `session.interrupt` (:2124) clears host-queued prompts, withdraws open requests, denies pending approvals and stops background delegations (`tg/session_lifecycle.py:590`). The turn ends with `message.complete {status:'interrupted'}` (`tg/prompt_turn.py:304`), then `session.info {running:false}` (:1096).

**Events.** Envelope `{type, session_id (runtime), payload, seq}` (`tg/server.py:648`); `seq` is stamped at :628.

| Event | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `message.start` | No payload. Turns can start without a client prompt (goal, leftover steer, auto-continue). |
| `message.delta {text}` | Reply text |
| `message.interim {text, already_streamed}` | Interim reply |
| `message.complete` | `status` is `complete`, `error` or `interrupted`; also `usage`, `persisted_turn`, `partial` |
| `reasoning.delta` | Reasoning |
| `thinking.delta` | Spinner/status text only |
| `reasoning.available` | Never rendered as reasoning |
| `tool.start` / `tool.complete` | Keyed by `tool_id`; `labels` and `inline_diff` are new since 0.21.4 |
| `session.title {session_id: stored key, title}` | A suggestion |
| `session.usage` | Usage update |
| `session.info` | `running`, `turn_started_at`, `model`, `cwd`, `yolo` |
| `error {message}` | Lone error ends the turn |

**Reconnect numbers** (unchanged since 0.21.4):
- Orphan grace 20 s and activity threshold 600 s (`tg/server.py:131`, :137).
- Replay ring 512 events / 4 MiB per runtime (`tg/event_replay.py:28-34`). It resets on a new `epoch`.

## Plan

- [ ] **Entry (temporary).** The inbox's + menu (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotsInboxView.swift:190-203`) gains "New Session":
  - Shown only when `home != nil` (a Hermes server), and only in a DEBUG build or Hermex Branch (bundle id ends `.branch`, `Config/BranchTestFlight.xcconfig`).
  - It pushes `ChatView` on `.new(profile)`, with the Profile from a new `HermesREST.profilesActive` case (`HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesREST.swift`).
  - #709's Sessions tab replaces it; leave a comment saying so.
- [ ] **Backend seam.**
  - Pull the surface `ChatViewModel` uses from `ChatStreamCoordinator` into a protocol: `activeStreamID`, `activeRunStartedAt`, `recoveryState`, `latestRunEnding`, start, cancel, suspend, `reconnectIfNeeded`, `networkPathDidChange`, `recoverStaleStreamIfNeeded`, and session-load reconcile.
  - The webui coordinator conforms unchanged.
  - Add `HermesChatTurnCoordinator` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/`). It owns a `HermesConversation` and maps its ordered, gap-checked frames onto the existing `ChatStreamCoordinatorDelegate` (`ChatStreamCoordinator.swift:66-111`, implemented at `ChatViewModel.swift:6032-6271`), so `ChatMessage` building, pacing and the snapshot store stay shared.
  - `ChatView.init` (`ChatView.swift:399-440`) and `ChatViewModel.init` (:615-693) take the backend. The direct client calls for send and steer go through it.
- [ ] **Send.** Attach through the engine, then `prompt.submit {runtime, text, queued:true}`. Send no `config.set` and no `session.cwd.set`. The model shown is the one `session.info` reports for the Profile's default.
- [ ] **Reducer.**

  | Event | Goes to |
  |---|---|
  | `message.start` | a new assistant row |
  | `message.delta` | `appendAssistantToken` (:5392), keeping today's pacing |
  | `message.interim` | `appendInterimAssistant` (:4958) |
  | `reasoning.delta` | `appendReasoning` (:5151) |
  | `thinking.delta` | the working status line |
  | `tool.start` / `tool.complete` | `appendToolCall` (:5196) / `completeToolCall` (:5225), by `tool_id` |
  | `session.title` | the title shown (`updateTitle` :5662), with no rename call |
  | `session.usage` | the context indicator |
  | `message.complete.status` | the run ending: complete, cancelled or failed |

  An unprompted `message.start` starts a turn.
- [ ] **Turn state and identity.**
  - On the Hermes path, the turn identity `(stored key, turn_started_at)` replaces `stream_id`.
  - Map the states onto today's `ActiveStreamRecoveryState` and `ChatActiveRunStatusKind` (`ChatViewModel.swift:200-207`, `HermesMobile/Config/AppTheme.swift:368-410`):

    | Turn state | Today's state |
    |---|---|
    | submitting | starting |
    | running | active |
    | detached | reconnecting, or waitingForNetwork (#869) |
    | reattaching | checking |
    | waitingForUser | added by 1.2 |

  - The #868 pill reads `turn_started_at`.
- [ ] **Reattach.** On the engine's rebuild signal, rebuild the transcript from the snapshot plus `inflight`, then continue with deltas. Never `session.close` on leaving; #902 closes the socket on background.
- [ ] **Busy send modes (#858)**, mapped through `BotPromptMode` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotPromptMode.swift:31-62`). Unknown acknowledgments keep the draft.

  | Mode | Call |
  |---|---|
  | Queue | `prompt.submit queued:true`. The host holds the queue; the composer shows a receipt only. |
  | Steer | `session.steer` |
  | Stop & send | `session.redirect` |

- [ ] **Stop.** `session.interrupt`. Idle comes only from `message.complete` plus `session.info {running:false}`. When a queued receipt or an open request exists, confirm first with a system dialog: "Stop this response? Queued messages are discarded and the pending approval is denied." Otherwise stop at once.
- [ ] **Hidden on a Hermes session** until their phase lands:
  - The model, reasoning and Profile selectors, and `ChatComposerConfigLoader` (`ChatViewModel.swift:907`): #705.
  - The workspace picker, Files and git (`ChatView.swift:537-613`, :919): #703.
  - Regenerate, edit, fork (`ChatMessageActions.swift:23-25`), plus retry, compress, rename and branch: #702.
  - `/goal`, `/btw`, `/background`: 1.4. The attachment + menu: 1.3.
- [ ] **Keys.** Drafts and recent transcripts use #903's per-target keys.
- [ ] **Docs.** `docs/agents/bots.md` (the engine gains a Sessions owner, plus the send-mode mapping) and `CONTEXT.md` ("turn identity").

## Decisions

Decided by Uzair, 2026-10-03:
1. **Entry.** A temporary "New Session" item in the Hermes inbox's + menu, DEBUG and Hermex Branch only. #709 replaces it. You can't reopen a session after leaving it; that is accepted until #702.
2. **Profile and model (boundary with #705).** Take the Profile from `/api/profiles/active` `current` and its default model. Send no model or reasoning changes, and store no remembered Profile. #705's 5.1 child adds the catalog, the Profile chip and the remembered pick, and is blocked by this issue.
3. **Queue uses the host's queue** (`queued:true`), as in Bots. Webui keeps its phone-side queue. Stop clears the host queue.
4. **Stop & send is `session.redirect`**, matching the Bots "Interrupt" choice.
5. **Stop confirms only when something would be lost**, using the copy above.
6. **Controls without a Hermes path are hidden**, per the list above.

Recommended (the implementer may rename along the code's seams):
7. **Seam.** A protocol over the coordinator, with a Hermes conformer feeding the existing delegate. Text is delta-driven; snapshots are used only on rebuild, unlike Bot Chat's snapshot-driven text (#903's boundary).
8. **Tests.** Webui tests stay untouched; webui is still supported. Hermes behavior gets new tests on the socket fixture.

## Acceptance

- [ ] On a Hermes server in DEBUG or Branch, "New Session" opens a chat on the `current` Profile. It is absent on webui servers and in Release.
- [ ] Send streams text, reasoning and tool rows, and the title suggestion appears.
- [ ] Stop shows "interrupted" and then idle. It confirms only with a queued message or an open request.
- [ ] Steer while running is accepted. A `rejected` steer keeps the draft and doesn't stop the run (#856).
- [ ] Queue while running holds the message on the host, and leaving the chat keeps it. Stop & send redirects.
- [ ] After backgrounding mid-turn and returning, the run continues with no duplicated text. A gap or a backwards `seq` rebuilds.
- [ ] A turn that starts without a prompt renders.
- [ ] The hidden controls are absent on Hermes, and the webui chat is unchanged.
- [ ] No prompt, steer, redirect or stop is ever resent.

## Tests

New `HermesChatTurnTests`, on #901's socket fixture (`BotSocketHost`, `HermesMobileTests/BotConversationTests.swift:1952`) and the recorded `Fixtures/HermesAgent/turn-frames.json` and `turn-tool-approval-frames.json`. These fail today:
- the delta reducer, interim, reasoning versus thinking, tools by `tool_id`
- an unprompted `message.start`, a lone `error`, an interrupted completion
- steer `queued` and `rejected`, redirect, a queued submit
- reattach with no duplicate, gap rebuild, backwards `seq`
- the Stop confirm policy
- the entry's visibility

Unchanged and passing: `StreamReconnectContractTests`, `ChatStreamCoordinatorTests`, `ChatViewModelSendTests`, `SteerMessageTests`, `ChatDraftStoreTests`, `ChatComposerSendGateTests`, and the #903 Bot suites.

Run: `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesConversationTests --only HermesMobileTests/StreamReconnectContractTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatStreamCoordinatorTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatViewModelSendTests --only HermesMobileTests/SteerMessageTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatComposerSendGateTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotConversationTests`

## Mocks

Not required. The chat UI is reused; the only new UI is a menu item and a system confirmation dialog.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes` first, then a physical iPhone (Hermex Branch) through the tunnel.

1. Hermes server, then + → New Session, then send a prompt that uses a tool. Expected: text, reasoning and the tool row stream in.
2. While it runs: Steer, then Queue, then Stop & send. Expected: the steer is accepted, a queue receipt appears, and the redirect takes over.
3. Queue a message, then Stop. Expected: the confirmation dialog, then idle.
4. Background mid-turn past the tunnel's idle timeout, then return. Expected: no duplicated text, and the turn finishes.
5. Switch to a webui server and open a chat. Expected: as before.

Delete the test sessions from Desktop afterwards.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** only the temporary menu item. Deep links, App Intents, share imports, push and Live Activity taps keep routing to webui until #706.
- **Targets:** main app and `HermesMobileTests`.
- **Servers:** switch webui ↔ Hermes; drafts stay with their server and target.
- **Reverse states:** Stop, leave and return, a rejected steer keeps the draft.
- **Connection modes:** LAN (`scripts/local-hermes`) and the tunnel past its idle timeout.
- **Native quality:** a VoiceOver label for the menu item. New strings ship in 17 languages (`docs/agents/i18n.md`).

## Preservation

- #508: never resend.
- #775: the handshake.
- #856: a refused steer doesn't stop the run.
- #857, #858, #868, #869: webui behavior unchanged; Hermes equivalents as above.
- #902: background closes the socket.
- #903: Bot Chat is unchanged.

## Blockers

#903, set as a GitHub dependency. It runs in the same batch, right before this.

## Outside reach

The phone pass creates sessions on the maintainer's host. Uzair runs it and deletes them.

title: feat(hermes): answer approvals, questions, sudo and secret prompts in a Hermes session
body:
**What the user gets:** When the agent in a Hermes session asks for an approval, a question, a sudo password or a secret, the phone shows it and the answer reaches the host. Open requests come back after a reconnect.
**Why it matters:** An agent parked on a question is stuck until someone answers. Answering from the phone is part of #701's acceptance and the decision 11 checkpoint.
**Cost:** Medium. Needs the owner's phone for one approval and one question through the tunnel.

Part of #701 (slice 1.2) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1010 (slice 1.1) · **Unblocks:** #1012 (slice 1.3)

## Problem and outcome

The Sessions request UI is webui-shaped:
- `ChatPendingActionCoordinator` fetches through `APIClient`. It uses two SSE monitors (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatPendingActionCoordinator.swift:300`, :402) and falls back to 1.5 s polling (:345, :449).
- `ApprovalRequestOverlay` hardcodes four choices (`ApprovalRequestOverlay.swift:103-112`) with `ApprovalScope.Host.webui`.
- `ClarificationRequestCard` takes a single question (`ClarificationPromptState`, `ChatViewModel.swift:166`).
- Sessions chat has no sudo or secret prompt at all.

Bots already handle every request kind on Hermes:
- `BotServerRequest` and `BotPendingRequest` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotPendingRequest.swift:13-81`, Foundation only).
- Answer dispatch with tap-captured guards (`BotConversation.swift:1346-1432`, :1483-1532).
- `open_requests` restore (:968-972) and withdrawal notes (`BotRequestWithdrawal`, `BotPendingRequest.swift:642-724`).

After this, a Hermes session in the main chat shows and answers every request kind through that model, in the Sessions overlay and cards.

## Contract

Evidence pinned to Hermex `209e0987` and hermes-agent `ca678285`; `tg/` = `tui_gateway/`.

**Frames.**
- A server request is `{jsonrpc, id:"srq-<12hex>", method, params:{session_id,…}}` (`tg/server_requests.py:61`). There is no `seq`.

**Approval.**
- Params: `{request_id, command, description, choices, allow_permanent?, allow_session?, smart_denied?, tool_name?}`.
- Host-computed choices (`tg/server.py:711`): `once`, then `session` unless smart-denied or disallowed, then `always` unless disallowed, then `deny`.
- `approval.respond {session_id, choice, request_id, profile}` (`tg/methods_prompt.py:1239`) returns `{resolved:int}`. `resolved:0` means it was already resolved.

**Clarify.**
- Single: `{question, choices, multi_select?}`, answered with `request.answer {id, result:{answer}}` (`methods_prompt.py:1162`) → `ok|expired`. An empty answer skips.
- Batch: `{questions:[{qid, question, choices, multi_select}]}`. Answer with `clarify.lock {request_id, question_id, answer}` (`methods_prompt.py:1141`) per `qid`; the last lock resolves the request. A bare `{answer}` to a batch is applied as cancel-all (`tg/server.py:1339`).

**Credentials.**
- `sudo {command}` (120 s) and `secret {env_var, prompt}` (300 s) are answered with `request.answer {id, result:{value}}`. An empty value skips.

**Withdrawal and restore.**
- `request.cancel {id, method, reason}` is a notification from the host, with reason `interrupted|timeout|resolved|shutdown`. It is not a method.
- `open_requests: [{id, method, params}]`, oldest first, arrives on a warm resume and in `session.events.since` (`tg/server_requests.py:276`).

**Yolo.**
- `config.set {session_id, key:"yolo", value, scope:"session"}` (`tg/methods_config_set.py:263`) emits `session.info.yolo`.

**Requests the phone can't handle.**
- `terminal.read`, `window.read`, `preview.*`, `tour`, `vault.*` and `display.install.sudo` (new since 0.21.4) are never answered (`docs/agents/bots.md` § requests): Desktop may answer them.

## Plan

- [ ] **Request model.**
  - On the Hermes backend, `ChatPendingActionCoordinator` takes requests from #903's engine and parses them with `BotServerRequest` and `BotPendingRequest`.
  - Answers use the engine's guarded dispatch. If #903 left it inside `BotConversation`, move it into the engine; Bot behavior stays identical.
- [ ] **Approval overlay.**
  - Render the host's choices only, with `ApprovalScope.Host.hermes`.
  - "Skip all this session" sends `config.set yolo on`, then `approval.respond once` for the card on screen.
  - `ApprovalBypassStatusPill` (`ApprovalRequestOverlay.swift:160`) reads `session.info.yolo`, and turning it off sends `config.set yolo off`.
- [ ] **Clarify card.** `ClarificationRequestCard` gains batch questions keyed by `qid`, sending `clarify.lock` per question and never a bare answer. Single questions use `request.answer`. Skip sends `''`.
- [ ] **Sudo and secret.** Reuse the Bot credential card section (`BotPendingRequestCard.swift:458-479`) in the Sessions request slot with the shared `PendingRequestSurfaces` styling. Values are never cached or logged.
- [ ] **Withdrawal.** `request.cancel` removes the matching card and leaves one caption line through `BotRequestWithdrawal`. It stays silent when this phone's Stop or redirect caused it.
- [ ] **Turn state.** While a request is open, the turn is `waitingForUser` in the run-status pill (`ChatActiveRunStatusKind`).
- [ ] **Restore.** After a reattach, replace the open requests from `open_requests`, deduped by `srq` id.
- [ ] **Docs.** `docs/agents/bots.md` § requests: Sessions shares the model.

## Decisions

Recommended, following the engine's existing rules:
1. **Reuse the Bot request models and answer dispatch.** Don't write a second parser.
2. **Never answer requests the phone can't handle.** The host may wait out their deadline. That is accepted, because a reply would steal the request from Desktop.
3. **Yolo** is a session-scoped `config.set` plus `approval.respond once` to release the open card. The pill can turn it off again.
4. **Sudo and secret reuse the Bot credential card** as it is, so no new design is needed.

## Acceptance

- [ ] An approval shows only the host's choices, and each choice reaches the host.
- [ ] Skip-all turns on yolo and releases the card; the pill turns it off.
- [ ] Single and batch questions are answered and skipped correctly. A batch never sends a bare `{answer}`.
- [ ] Sudo and secret cards answer and skip, and no value is persisted.
- [ ] Backgrounding with a card open and returning restores the card. A request answered on Desktop disappears quietly.
- [ ] The webui request UI is unchanged.

## Tests

New `HermesChatRequestTests`, on `BotSocketHost` with `Fixtures/HermesAgent/turn-tool-approval-frames.json`. These fail today:
- host choices only; `approval.respond` carries `request_id`; `resolved:0` handling
- batch `clarify.lock` per `qid`; single answer and skip
- credential values are not persisted
- `request.cancel` withdrawal and its note
- `open_requests` restore with dedupe
- yolo on, then off

Unchanged and passing: `ClarificationTests`, the approval cases in `ChatViewModelSendTests`, `BotPendingRequestTests`, `BotConversationTests`.

Run: `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatRequestTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests --only HermesMobileTests/ClarificationTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatViewModelSendTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotPendingRequestTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotConversationTests`

## Mocks

Not required. The approval overlay keeps its layout with host-supplied choices, and sudo and secret reuse the existing Bot card.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`, then a physical iPhone (Hermex Branch) through the tunnel.

1. Ask for a command that needs approval, then answer "once". Expected: the command runs.
2. Ask something that makes the agent ask a clarifying question, then answer it. Expected: the turn continues.
3. With a card open, background past the tunnel's idle timeout and return. Expected: the card is back and answerable.
4. Skip all this session, then turn it off from the pill.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the Hermes chat from 1.1. Push and Live Activity routing for requests is #706.
- **Targets:** main app and tests.
- **Reverse states:** yolo on and off; skip; withdrawal.
- **Native quality:** VoiceOver for host choices and batch questions; secure entry for credentials.

## Preservation

- #508: never retry an answer.
- #948: withdrawal notes.
- #943: vault prompts stay unanswerable in Sessions.
- Bot request behavior is unchanged.

## Blockers

#1010 (slice 1.1), set as a GitHub dependency.

## Outside reach

The phone pass creates sessions on the maintainer's host. Uzair runs it and deletes them.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code.

title: feat(hermes): attach images and documents in a Hermes session
body:
**What the user gets:** Photos and files attached in a Hermes session reach the agent. The transcript shows them as attachments, never as host paths or raw instruction lines.
**Why it matters:** Attachments are part of today's chat and #701's acceptance (an image and a PDF). Bots show raw host paths in user bubbles today; Sessions must not.
**Cost:** Medium. Simulator, plus the shared Branch TestFlight pass.

Part of #701 (slice 1.3) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1011 (slice 1.2) · **Unblocks:** #1013 (slice 1.4)

## Problem and outcome

Sessions attachments are webui-only:
- `ChatAttachmentCoordinator.performUpload` posts multipart to webui (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatAttachmentCoordinator.swift:185-261`, `APIClient+Upload.swift:4`).
- The text gets `[Attached files: …]` (`Models/UploadResponse.swift:155-170`).
- The transcript infers attachments from that marker (`Models/MessageAttachment.swift:136-161`), but only in `ChatMessage.init(from:)` (`Models/ChatMessage.swift:104`).

Bots already send attachments to Hermes:
- Images go through image-upload plus a vision-tool instruction line; documents through `file.attach` → `ref_text` (`BotConversation.attachmentPrompt` :1209-1240, `Networking/Bots/BotAttachmentUpload.swift:9-56`).
- Their user bubbles render raw text (`BotArtifactMessageView.swift:42-48`, `MessageBubbleView` `textOnly` :351), so the instruction line, host paths and `@file:` tokens show.

After this, a Hermes session attaches images and documents through the Bot path. The transcript turns the Hermes reference lines into attachment chips and never shows host paths.

## Contract

Evidence pinned to Hermex `209e0987` and hermes-agent `ca678285`.

- **`POST /api/chat/image-upload?profile=`** (`hermes_cli/web_routers/files.py:330`):
  - Body `{data_url, filename?}`; `image/*` only, checked by magic bytes; 25 MiB cap (413).
  - Reply `{ok, path, name, bytes, mime_type}`.
  - The upload alone doesn't attach anything to a turn. The prompt carries the instruction line `[The user attached an image: <name>]\n[Examine it with the vision_analyze tool using image_url: <path>]`, which is Hermes's own text-mode format (`tui_gateway/session_history.py:30`).
- **`file.attach {session_id, name, data_url, profile}`** (`tui_gateway/methods_prompt.py:900`):
  - Reply `{attached, name, path, ref_path, ref_text, uploaded}`.
  - `ref_text` is `@file:<workspace-relative path>`, quoted with backticks, `"` or `'` when the path has spaces or brackets.
  - No byte cap beyond the 384 MiB frame limit. Errors: 4015, 5028.
- Unchanged since 0.21.4.

## Plan

- [ ] **Upload.**
  - On the Hermes backend, `ChatAttachmentCoordinator` uploads through `BotAttachmentUpload`: images use `uploadImage` plus `imageReference`; other files use `file.attach` on the captured runtime.
  - Only Send and Queue carry attachments. Steer drops out while files are staged, and Stop & send stays text-only (the Bot rule, `docs/agents/bots.md` § attachments).
  - A partial failure or a cancel never submits a partial set and keeps the local draft. Apply #508's durable submission marker.
- [ ] **Limits.** On Hermes, use the Bot limits: 8 files, 25 MB each, 50 MB total (`BotAttachmentDraft.swift:19-20`). Images keep their JPEG or PNG conversion.
- [ ] **Keys.** Draft attachments use #903's per-target key.
- [ ] **Transcript rule.**
  - Add a Hermes rule beside `attachedFilesMarker` in `MessageAttachment` that recognises the image instruction pair and `@file:` tokens (plain and quoted). It turns them into `MessageAttachment` chips and strips them from displayed text.
  - The Hermes message adapter calls it explicitly, because the memberwise init doesn't infer (`ChatMessage.swift:104`).
  - Host paths never reach the display. Composer recall (`ComposerRecall.swift:34`) strips them too.
- [ ] **Composer.** Show the attachment + menu on Hermes sessions (hidden by 1.1).
- [ ] **Docs.** `docs/agents/bots.md` § attachments: Sessions shares the path and parses the reference lines.

## Decisions

Decided by Uzair, 2026-10-03:
1. **Images keep Bots' verified path** (upload plus the vision-tool instruction line), not `image.attach_bytes`. That call shares one next-prompt queue a parallel Desktop prompt could consume. Native inline vision can be a later issue.

Recommended:
2. **Bot limits apply on Hermes.**
3. **Bot Chat's raw user-bubble rendering is out of scope.** #903 keeps Bot behavior unchanged; reusing this rule there is #1017, blocked by this issue.

## Acceptance

- [ ] An image and a PDF attached in a Hermes session reach the agent, which describes both.
- [ ] The transcript shows chips and no host paths, live and after a reattach rebuild.
- [ ] Upload failure or cancel keeps the draft and sends nothing.
- [ ] Steer is unavailable while files are staged.
- [ ] Webui attachments are unchanged.

## Tests

New `HermesChatAttachmentTests` on `BotSocketHost`, with an HTTP fixture for image-upload. These fail today:
- the image-upload body and the instruction line in `prompt.submit`
- `file.attach` with `ref_text` passed verbatim
- partial failure, cancel
- the transcript rule round-trip for the instruction line and plain and quoted `@file:` tokens, with no host path in the displayed text
- recall stripping

Unchanged and passing: `ChatAttachmentCoordinatorTests`, `TranscriptMediaParserTests`, `BotAttachmentSendingTests`.

Run: `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatAttachmentTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatAttachmentCoordinatorTests --only HermesMobileTests/TranscriptMediaParserTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotAttachmentSendingTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests`

## Mocks

Not required. It reuses the existing attachment chips and composer strip.

## Manual test

Device: physical iPhone (Hermex Branch, batched with the run's other slices). The simulator against `scripts/local-hermes` comes first.

1. Attach a photo and ask what it shows. Expected: the agent describes it, and the bubble shows a chip.
2. Attach a PDF and ask for a summary. Expected: a summary, and a chip with no path.
3. Background and return. Expected: the chips are still there and no paths appear.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** composer +, paste and drop in the Hermes chat. The share extension into a Hermes session is #706.
- **Targets:** main app and tests. `MessageAttachment` and `ChatMessage` are main-app only; check membership if that changes.
- **Native quality:** VoiceOver labels on chips.

## Preservation

- #508: a lost acknowledgment keeps the text and files and never resends.
- The webui `[Attached files:]` rule is unchanged.

## Blockers

#1011 (slice 1.2), set as a GitHub dependency. The slices form one serial chain because each edits `ChatViewModel` and `ChatView`.

## Outside reach

None. Uploaded files stay host-owned, and the phone never deletes guessed paths.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code.

title: feat(hermes): /goal, /btw and background in a Hermes session
body:
**What the user gets:** In a Hermes session you can set and manage a goal, and ask a /btw side question even while the agent is working. The answer opens in a panel you can close. Background work posts its result when it's done.
**Why it matters:** These are today's chat features, and #701's acceptance needs them. A user asked for /btw mid-turn, which webui forbids but Hermes allows.
**Cost:** Medium. Mock gate for the btw panel; simulator, plus the shared Branch TestFlight pass.

Part of #701 (slice 1.4) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1012 (slice 1.3) · **Unblocks:** #1014 (slice 1.5)

## Problem and outcome

Today these features are webui-only:
- **Goal:** `ChatViewModel.submitGoal` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatViewModel.swift:2725`, blocked while running at :2741) attaches to a server-started stream (`attachGoalKickoffStream` :2792). The menu sends `/goal status|pause|resume|done|clear` (`ChatGoalControls.swift:21-28`).
- **btw:** blocked while a turn runs (`askBtwFromSlashCommand` :3129, guard :3147-3149). The answer lands in the transcript (`btwMessageText` :5946).
- **Background:** polls webui every 3 s (:4904) and appends result messages (`handleBackgroundResults` :4936).

Bots don't offer btw or background (`docs/agents/bots.md` § send modes). Goal is only a `session.control` pause or resume there (`BotChatSettings.swift:67-105`).

After this, all three work in a Hermes session: goal through the host's `/goal`, btw mid-turn in a closable panel, and background with a durable result or an honest "unavailable" line.

## Contract

Evidence pinned to Hermex `209e0987` and hermes-agent `ca678285`; `tg/` = `tui_gateway/`.

**Goal.**
- `command.dispatch {name:'goal', arg, session_id, profile}` (`tg/methods_tools.py:793`, :917).
- Every menu verb goes through `arg`: `status`, `pause`, `resume`, `clear`, and `done`/`stop` (aliases of clear), plus the goal text (`hermes_cli/goal_command.py:99-100`).
- The reply is `{type:'exec', output}` or `{type:'send', notice, message, display?}`. For `send`, the client must `prompt.submit` the `message`. Error 4004.

**Session control.**
- `session.control.read {session_id}` (`tg/methods_session_control.py:234`) returns `{control:{goal, loop, heartbeat, revision, updated_at}}`.
- `session.control.update` is an event the host sends, not a method.

**btw.**
- `prompt.btw {session_id, text}` (`tg/methods_prompt.py:1031`) returns `{task_id:'btw_…'}`. Later, `btw.complete {task_id, question, text}` arrives on the parent runtime.
- It has no running check: it answers from a snapshot of the conversation with tools off. Empty text returns 4012.

**Background.**
- `prompt.background {session_id, text}` (`methods_prompt.py:1014`) returns `{task_id:'bg_…'}`, then `background.complete {task_id, text}`. A failure arrives as `"error: …"` text.
- The side session `bg_<id>` is stored in the parent Profile's database. Its durable result is `GET /api/sessions/{bg_id}/messages?profile=` (`hermes_cli/web_routers/sessions.py:606`), which returns 404 when missing.

New typed calls are needed: `HermesCall.promptBtw`, `HermesCall.promptBackground` and a REST `sessionMessages` (`HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesCall.swift`, `HermesREST.swift`).

## Plan

- [ ] **Goal.**
  - On the Hermes backend, `GoalControlsMenu` and the `/goal` slash command send `command.dispatch goal` with the verb or the goal text. `exec` output shows as today's notice.
  - For `send`, `prompt.submit` the returned `message` once, with `queued:true`.
  - Goal state comes from `session.control.read`, refreshed on `session.control.update`.
  - Today's rule stands: Set Goal is disabled while a turn runs.
- [ ] **btw.**
  - `/btw` works while a turn runs; drop the webui-era guard on the Hermes path.
  - Submitting opens the btw panel (from the mock pick), which shows the question, then waiting, then the answer, matched to `btw.complete` by `task_id`. The panel closes, and the answer never enters the transcript.
  - One btw at a time.
  - After a reconnect, a replayed `btw.complete` fills the panel. If the replay was truncated or the epoch changed, the panel says the answer is unavailable.
- [ ] **Background.**
  - `/background` adds a transcript card that shows the task running and is replaced by the result on `background.complete`.
  - After an absence, the engine's replay delivers it. Otherwise read `GET /api/sessions/bg_<id>/messages`, and on a 404 or a missing result the card says the result is unavailable. It never spins forever.
- [ ] **Slash routing.** `executeServerSideSlashCommand` (`ChatViewModel.swift:2894-2934`) routes `/goal`, `/btw` and `/background` to the Hermes calls; they were hidden by 1.1.
- [ ] **Docs.** `docs/agents/bots.md` § send modes: Sessions offers btw and background; Bots still don't.

## Decisions

Decided by Uzair:
1. **btw mid-turn in a closable panel** (2026-09-26 comment on #701). Follow-up questions in the panel are out of scope.
2. **Background stays a transcript card** with an honest unavailable state (2026-10-03).

Recommended:
3. **Every goal verb goes through `command.dispatch`**, so Mark Done maps to the host's `done`; nothing is reimplemented on the phone.
4. **One btw at a time**, as today.
5. **Set Goal stays disabled while running**, for parity.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Set a goal: the returned message is submitted once and the goal state shows. Pause, Resume, Mark Done and Clear work.
- [ ] Ask `/btw` during a running turn: the answer appears in the panel, and the main turn finishes with no interruption and no duplicated text.
- [ ] A btw answer lost to a truncated replay shows "unavailable".
- [ ] `/background` during a turn: the result card appears, including after backgrounding the app, through the replay or the REST read.
- [ ] Webui goal, btw and background are unchanged.

## Tests

New `HermesChatSideTaskTests` on `BotSocketHost`. These fail today:
- goal `send` submits the message once, and `exec` shows output
- btw mid-turn leaves the main turn's deltas intact
- `task_id` matching; unknown task ids are ignored
- btw unavailable after truncation
- `background.complete` fills the card; the replay path; the REST fallback; 404 shows unavailable

Unchanged and passing: `APIClientAgentControlTests`, `SlashCommandExecutorTests`, `ChatViewModelSendTests`.

Run: `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatSideTaskTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests --only HermesMobileTests/SlashCommandExecutorTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientAgentControlTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatViewModelSendTests`

## Mocks

Required for the btw panel only:
- open during a running turn: waiting, then answered
- unavailable
- dismissed

Show each in light and dark, on iPhone and iPad, and at a large Dynamic Type size. Wait for a pick before building the panel. Goal and background reuse existing UI.

## Manual test

Device: physical iPhone (Hermex Branch, batched). The simulator against `scripts/local-hermes` comes first. Run one background task there to confirm the `bg_<id>` messages read; this is the plan's "confirm with one disposable run".

1. `/goal write three haiku`. Expected: the agent starts, and the goal shows as active. Pause, Resume, Mark Done.
2. Start a long turn, then `/btw what are you doing?`. Expected: the panel answers while the turn keeps streaming.
3. `/background summarize this chat`, then background the app for a minute and return. Expected: the result card.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** slash commands and the goal menu in the Hermes chat.
- **Targets:** main app and tests.
- **Reverse states:** goal pause, resume and clear; closing the btw panel.
- **Native quality:** the panel's VoiceOver, Reduce Motion for its presentation, and new strings in 17 languages.

## Preservation

- #508: the goal message is submitted exactly once.
- Webui btw, goal and background behavior is unchanged.

## Blockers

#1012 (slice 1.3), set as a GitHub dependency. The slices form one serial chain because each edits `ChatViewModel` and `ChatView`.

## Outside reach

None beyond the disposable run on `scripts/local-hermes`. The phone pass creates sessions on the maintainer's host; Uzair runs it and deletes them.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code.

title: feat(hermes): drive the Live Activity from a Hermes session
body:
**What the user gets:** A Hermes session's run shows on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island like a webui chat: working, waiting for an answer, then finished or stopped.
**Why it matters:** The Live Activity is how users follow a run without the app open. Without it, Hermes sessions feel second-class. It is the last piece of #701 before the decision 11 checkpoint.
**Cost:** Small. Simulator, plus the shared Branch TestFlight pass.

Part of #701 (slice 1.5) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1013 (slice 1.4) · **Unblocks:** the decision 11 checkpoint, #706 slice 6.2

## Problem and outcome

Every Live Activity call in Sessions chat sits inside the webui `ChatStreamCoordinator`, keyed by the webui session id:

| Call | Lines (`ChatStreamCoordinator.swift`) |
|---|---|
| start | :1264-1276 |
| updates | :815-861 |
| `markStale` | :309, :913, :1013 |
| end | :298, :870, :874, :880, :1030, :1088 |

Bot Chat drives its activity from its snapshot with key `bot:<connection>:<profile>` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotLiveActivityFeed.swift:36-43`, decisions at :100-111). A Hermes session in the main chat drives nothing.

After this, the Hermes turn coordinator from 1.1 starts, updates and ends the activity at the same points.

## Plan

- [ ] **Start.** `HermesChatTurnCoordinator` calls `AgentLiveActivityManaging` (`HermesMobile/LiveActivities/AgentLiveActivityManager.swift:108-136`) when a turn starts, including one with no prompt:
  - `sessionID` = `hermes:<profile>:<stored key>`
  - `streamID` = `turn_started_at`
  - `startedAt`, `sessionTitle`
  - Reattaching to the same turn adopts the existing activity instead of starting another.
- [ ] **Updates.**
  - `.token` and `.interimAssistant`, only when excerpts are on.
  - `.reasoning`, `.toolStarted`, `.toolCompleted`.
  - `.waitingForApproval` and `.waitingForClarification` from 1.2's `waitingForUser`.
  - `.sessionTitle` from `session.title`.
- [ ] **Stale and end.**
  - `markStale` when the socket detaches or the app backgrounds.
  - End by `message.complete.status`: complete → `.complete`, interrupted → `.cancelled`, error → `.failed`. A lone `error` → `.failed`.
- [ ] **Tap.** The tap target (`HermesMobile/LiveActivities/HermesDeepLink.swift:150-166`) must not build a webui session URL for a `hermes:` key. A tap opens the app as it is. Leftover activities after the app is killed age out by today's freshness rule. `ContentView`'s webui reconciliation keeps skipping Hermes servers (`ContentView.swift:81`).
- [ ] **No push.** Hermes servers have no pairing until #706.
- [ ] **Docs.** `docs/agents/bots.md` § Live Activity: the interim Sessions key, and what #706 changes.

## Decisions

Decided by Uzair, 2026-10-03:
1. **Interim identity** `hermes:<profile>:<stored key>`, with no push and no tap destination. #706 slice 6.2 brings the final identity (`<server>:<profile>:<lineage root>#<turn_started_at>`), `destinationURL`, push and cold-launch reconciliation.
2. **Attributes don't change here.** 6.2 changes them.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A Hermes turn starts one activity, and reattaching doesn't start a second.
- [ ] Tool and reasoning updates appear. An open approval or question shows waiting.
- [ ] Complete, Stop and error end it with the matching outcome.
- [ ] A tap opens the app without routing to a webui server.
- [ ] Webui and Bot Live Activities are unchanged.

## Tests

New `HermesChatLiveActivityTests` with a spy manager (the `LiveActivityTests` pattern) on `BotSocketHost`. These fail today:
- one start per turn identity; reattach adopts
- updates; waiting
- end mapping for complete, interrupted, error and a lone error
- the tap target for a `hermes:` key

Unchanged and passing: `LiveActivityTests`, `BotLiveActivityTests`.

Run: `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatLiveActivityTests --only HermesMobileTests/LiveActivityTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotLiveActivityTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests`

## Mocks

Not required. The existing activity layouts are reused.

## Manual test

Device: physical iPhone (Hermex Branch, batched). The simulator first.

1. Send a long prompt and lock the phone. Expected: the activity shows working, then tool progress.
2. Trigger an approval. Expected: the activity shows waiting. Answer it in the app.
3. Let it finish, then repeat with Stop. Expected: finished, then stopped.

## Surfaces

- **Live Activity widget:** unchanged layouts. `AgentRunActivityAttributes` is shared with `HermesLiveActivityWidget` and isn't edited.
- **Targets:** main app and tests.
- **Entry points:** a tap opens the app; routing is #706.
- **Native quality:** Reduce Motion is unchanged.

## Preservation

- #842: waiting status in stale Bot activities.
- #937: `HermesTurnOutcome`.
- Bot activity identity (`BotLiveActivityFeed.swift:100-111`) is unchanged.

## After this

The decision 11 checkpoint (#713) runs once this merges: chat streaming and reconnect on a physical phone through the tunnel, and the LAN half on `scripts/local-hermes`. The result is posted on #701.

## Blockers

#1013 (slice 1.4), set as a GitHub dependency.

## Outside reach

None.
