title: feat(hermes): pick the model and Profile in the Hermes composer
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, the chat composer's model and Profile chips work as they do on webui: pick any model the host offers for this chat, start a new chat in any Profile, and Hermex remembers that Profile for this server. **Why it matters:** #1010 (#701 slice 1.1) puts sessions chat on the Hermes gateway with the model, reasoning and Profile controls hidden. Every Hermes chat starts in the host's current Profile on its default model until this lands. **Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator only; no phone needed. Part of #705 (slice 5.1) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1010 · **Unblocks:** #1016 (#705 slice 5.2) ## Problem and outcome The webui composer gets its model list, its Profiles and the active Profile from webui routes: - `ChatComposerConfigLoader.resolveProfile` and `loadModelAndReasoning` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatComposerConfigLoader.swift:103-158`) read `/api/profiles` and `/api/models`. - A model pick goes to `/api/session/update` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatViewModel.swift:982-1035`). - A Profile pick POSTs `/api/profile/switch`, which changes the server's global active Profile (`ChatViewModel.swift:1231-1303`, `HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatView.swift:2564-2595`, and the "Start New Session?" alert at `:1035-1048`). None of these exist on a Hermes host. #1010 (#701 slice 1.1) works around that: - It takes the Profile from `/api/profiles/active` `current` and uses that Profile's default model. - It sends no model or reasoning change and stores no remembered Profile. - It hides the model, reasoning and Profile controls on Hermes chats. After this, on a Hermes server: - The model and Profile chips are back on Hermes chats. Reasoning stays hidden until 5.2. - The model chip lists what `model.options` returns for the chat's Profile. - A pick applies to this chat only. - The Profile chip lists the host's Profiles, and the selected Profile is client state remembered per server. It goes on every Profile-scoped call and is never written to the host. webui servers don't change. ## Contract Evidence is pinned to Hermex `209e0987` and hermes-agent `ca678285` (0.21.5). None of these methods changed since 0.21.4, except `profiles.list` (below). - **`model.options {profile, session_id?}`** (`tui_gateway/methods_complete.py:335-344`) answers `{providers: Row[], model, provider}`. - Each row has `slug, name, is_current, is_user_defined, models[], total_models, authenticated`, plus `capabilities: {model_id: {fast, reasoning, can_disable_reasoning?}}` (`inventory.py:317-360`). - With a `session_id`, it layers the live session's model over the Profile's config (`methods_complete_helpers.py:169-182`). Without one, `model`/`provider` are the Profile's default. - Never send `refresh: true`: it probes every custom endpoint and can write discovered models to the host's config (`model_switch_providers.py:27-67`). - **`config.set {key:'model', value:' --provider

--session', session_id, profile, confirm_expensive_model}`** (`methods_config_set.py:142-154`). - It needs a live runtime, else it answers 4001. - Only `--global` writes the Profile, and Hermex never sends it. - The reply carries `confirm_required` and `confirm_message` for an expensive model, and `deferred: true` when a turn is running (`:73-91`). - `HermesCall.configSet` and its admission already enforce `--session` (`HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesCall.swift:291-302`, `:356-360`). - **`profiles.list`** (already `HermesCall.profilesList`) gained the optional `previous_names: [String]` and `role: "setup" | null` between 0.21.4 and the pin. Both are optional fields in the decode. - **`GET /api/profiles/active`** answers `{active, current}` (`hermes_cli/web_routers/profiles.py:777-793`). - `current` is the Profile the dashboard runs as. It is what every REST route uses when `profile` is omitted (`web_server_profiles.py:31-34`). - Never call `POST /api/profiles/active`: it rewrites the host's sticky default for the CLI and gateways (`hermes_cli/profiles.py:1918-1930`). ## Plan - [ ] **Model catalog.** Move `BotModelCatalog` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotChatSettings.swift:5-46`) to a shared Hermes name beside the gateway code. Bot Chat and the Hermes composer both read it. Bot Chat's behavior and tests don't change. - The Hermes composer feeds the existing `modelCatalogGroups` and `ModelPickerSheet` from it. - Favorites, recents and the custom model entry work as they do on webui. - The catalog is read when the chat opens and again when the picker opens, which replaces `refreshModelCatalogForPickerOpen`'s webui path (`ChatViewModel.swift:928-939`). - [ ] **Model pick.** - In a chat with a runtime, send `config.set` model with `--session` at once. - In a new chat, hold the pick in the draft settings (`HermesMobile/Persistence/ChatDraftStore.swift:20-66`, under #903's target keys). - **Apply step (new here; #1010 sends no settings).** After `session.create` and before `prompt.submit`, send the held pick once with the new runtime. A failure leaves the message unsent in the composer, with the host's reason. 5.2 adds reasoning to this same step. - Lift the expensive-model confirm from `BotChatControls.apply` and `confirm` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotChatControls.swift:159-237`) rather than writing a second one. A held pick that needs confirming pauses the send with the dialog. Cancel leaves the message in the composer and sends nothing. - A `deferred: true` reply shows the pick as applying after the current response. - [ ] **Selected Profile, per server.** Add a small per-server preference, keyed like `KanbanBoardPreference` (`hermes.selectedProfile|`). Seed it from `/api/profiles/active` `current` when nothing is stored. Validate it against each fresh `profiles.list`, and drop a Profile that no longer exists silently, falling back to `current`. - It replaces #1010's per-chat read of `current`. #1010 stores nothing, so there's nothing to migrate. - Sign-out and server removal delete it (`AuthManager.clearLocalArtifacts`, `HermesMobile/Auth/AuthManager.swift:528`). - [ ] **Show the chips.** Lift #1010's Hermes-only hiding for the model chip and the Profile chip. The effort control stays hidden until 5.2. - [ ] **Profile chip.** On a Hermes server, `ComposerProfileSelectorMenu` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatComposerSelectorControls.swift:28-102`) lists `profiles.list`. The host's onboarding Profile (`role: "setup"`) is listed like any other. - In a new chat, a pick changes the selected Profile and reloads the catalog for it. - In an existing chat, the chip shows the session's Profile (`session.info.profile_name`). Picking another one offers to start a new chat in that Profile, as the "Start New Session?" alert does today, and never moves the session. - With one Profile, the chip is static, as `isSingleProfileMode` already renders it. - [ ] **The Profile is required.** Every new Hermes call this slice adds takes the Profile as a non-optional parameter, as the existing `HermesCall` cases do. - [ ] **`/model`.** On a Hermes server, `switchModelFromSlashCommand` (`ChatViewModel.swift:3216-3257`) resolves the name against the catalog and goes through the same pick path, confirm included. - [ ] **Docs.** - `docs/agents/multi-server-state-isolation.md` gets a row for the selected Profile. - `docs/agents/bots.md` notes that the catalog is shared. ## Decisions **Decided (Uzair, 2026-10-03):** 1. **One transport for reads.** Every catalog read is `model.options`, which Bot Chat already uses. `GET /api/model/options` and its 503 "Restart required" guard are not adopted. Never send `refresh: true`. 2. **Out of 5.1:** - `POST /api/model/set` and a separate Profile creation flow. On Hermes a Bot is a Profile: the Bot Profile editor already sets a Profile's default model (`profiles.configure`), and the Bot creator creates Profiles (`profiles.create`). - The custom endpoint on create (`POST /api/providers/custom-endpoints`). It can come later if asked. - Settings' "Default Profile" row stays hidden on Hermes. 3. **Profile selection** is the composer chip, remembered per server and seeded from `current`. Picking a Profile in an existing chat starts a new chat, never moves the session. The setup Profile is listed. 4. **Boundary with #701 (agreed in #701's split).** - #1010 takes the Profile from `current` and its default model, sends no model or reasoning change, stores no remembered Profile, and hides the model, reasoning and Profile controls on Hermes chats. - This issue adds the catalog, the Profile chip, the remembered pick, and the first model change on a Hermes chat, including the apply step before `prompt.submit`. - 5.2 adds reasoning. 5. **Bot Chat doesn't change.** Moving the catalog keeps every `BotChatControlsTests` assertion. Bot Chat's own model menu stays as it is. ## Acceptance - [ ] Hermes chats show the model and Profile chips. The effort control stays hidden. - [ ] On a Hermes server, the model chip lists the providers and models `model.options` returns for the chat's Profile, skipping unauthenticated providers and unavailable models, as Bot Chat does. - [ ] A pick in a running chat sends exactly one `config.set` with `--session`. A pick in a new chat is sent once, after creation and before `prompt.submit`. - [ ] An expensive model shows the host's message. Confirm resends with `confirm_expensive_model: true`. Cancel sends nothing and keeps the draft. - [ ] The Profile chip lists the host's Profiles. A new-chat pick is remembered for this server across relaunch. - [ ] A second Hermes server and a webui server keep their own selections. - [ ] A remembered Profile that the host no longer lists falls back to `current` without an error. - [ ] Picking another Profile in an existing chat offers a new chat and leaves the session's Profile unchanged. - [ ] `/model ` on a Hermes server changes this chat's model through the same path. - [ ] No request sends `POST /api/profiles/active`, `POST /api/model/set`, `refresh: true` or `--global`. - [ ] Bot Chat's model menu behaves as before. ## Tests These fail on today's code unless noted. - **Catalog adapter:** a fixture from the pinned `model.options` shape, including `capabilities`, an unauthenticated row and unavailable models. `BotChatControlsTests` pass unchanged. - **Selected Profile:** seeding from `current`, persistence per server, a stale fallback, and clearing on sign-out. - **Composer view model, on the scripted gateway fixture:** - a pick with and without a runtime - the confirm and cancel paths - `deferred` - the Profile chip in a new versus an existing chat - `/model` - **Admission:** `HermesCall` never builds a model value without `--session`. - **Run:** `scripts/test-sim --only HermesMobileTests/BotChatControlsTests --only HermesMobileTests/ModelCatalogTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatComposerConfigLoaderTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatDraftStoreTests --only HermesMobileTests/AuthManagerStateTests`, plus the new Hermes composer classes and the #701 chat classes the change touches. ## Mocks Not required. The existing chips, menu and sheet are reused with no new copy beyond the new-chat offer, which reuses today's alert. If the work needs a new control, stop and ask for a mock. ## Manual test Device: the simulator, signed in with `scripts/sim-login --hermes`. 1. Open a Hermes chat and change the model. Send a message. Expected: the reply comes from the new model, and the next chat in that Profile still starts on the Profile's default model. 2. Start a new chat, pick another Profile, and send. Expected: the session is in that Profile. Relaunch: the new-chat Profile is still selected. 3. In that existing chat, pick a different Profile. Expected: the offer to start a new chat, and the session stays where it was. 4. Switch to the webui server and back. Expected: each keeps its own Profile. Picking an expensive model on the live host is optional and Uzair's call. ## Surfaces - **Entry points:** the composer chips and `/model`. Bot Chat's model menu shares the catalog only. - **Targets:** main app only. The share extension, Live Activity widget and notification service don't read the catalog or the Profile. App Intents keep listing only webui Profiles until #706. - **Servers:** the selected Profile is keyed by server. Walk two Hermes servers and one webui server. - **Reverse states:** a pick can be changed back, and a pending confirm can be cancelled. - **Native quality:** VoiceOver labels on the chips follow today's. ## Preservation - #508: never resend a prompt or a setting after reconnect. - #775 and #825: one shared connection and handshake per server. - #899: Hermes servers keep their own sign-in, and App Intents leave them out. - #903: draft and setting keys follow the conversation target. ## Blockers #1010, set as a GitHub dependency: its Hermes composer, `current` seed and hidden controls are what this builds on. ## Outside reach None. Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code.

title: feat(hermes): set reasoning and personality in the Hermes composer
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, the composer's reasoning menu and `/personality` work: reasoning changes for this chat only and shows what the host actually used, and a personality change says plainly that it applies to the whole Profile.
**Why it matters:** These are the last composer runtime controls that webui chats have and Hermes chats would lack after #701 and 5.1.
**Cost:** Small to medium. One PR. Simulator only; no phone needed.

Part of #705 (slice 5.2) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1015 (#705 slice 5.1)

## Problem and outcome

On webui, reasoning and personality go through webui routes:
- **Reasoning:** `GET`/`POST /api/reasoning` for the ladder, the gating and a per-session effort (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatViewModel.swift:1044-1072`, `:1306-1353`; `/reasoning` at `:3301-3341`).
- **Personality:** `GET /api/personalities` and a per-session `POST /api/personality/set`, reachable only through `/personality` (`ChatViewModel.swift:1112-1137`, `:3373-3431`).

Neither route exists on a Hermes host.

After this, on a Hermes server:
- **The effort submenu** (`ComposerModelEffortMenu`, `HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatComposerSelectorControls.swift:104-255`) offers the host's ladder for models that reason. A pick applies to this chat only. When the host lowered the level for the model, the menu says so.
- **`/personality`** lists the host's personalities and sets one through `config.set`. The copy says it changes the Profile's default.

webui servers don't change.

## Contract

Evidence is pinned to Hermex `209e0987` and hermes-agent `ca678285` (0.21.5). None of these methods changed since 0.21.4.

- **`config.set {key:'reasoning', value, session_id, profile, scope:'session'}`** (`tui_gateway/methods_config_set.py:299-328`).
  - Accepted values: `none` plus `minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max, ultra` (`hermes_constants.py:1300-1327`). This is already `BotModelCatalog.effortLevels`, and `HermesCall`'s admission refuses anything else (`HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesCall.swift:356-360`).
  - With a live session it is session-only. A stale `session_id` answers 4001 (`methods_config_set.py:478-488`).
  - The reply echoes the requested word, not the level actually used.
  - **Never send `show`, `hide`, `on`, `off`, `full`, `clamp`, …**: those write the host's global `display.*` settings (`:292-296`). `off` hides reasoning output; it does not disable reasoning.
- **No call lists a model's levels.** `model.options` rows give only `capabilities[model] = {reasoning, can_disable_reasoning?}` (`inventory.py:317-360`). The host lowers a level the model can't take when it sends the request (`agent/reasoning_effort.py:120-159`). The result is reported only as `session.info.reasoning_effort_wire`, beside the requested `reasoning_effort` (`tui_gateway/server.py:2162-2167`).
- **`config.set {key:'personality', value, profile, session_id?}`** (`methods_config_set.py:435-443`).
  - It always writes the Profile's `display.personality` (`hermes_cli/personality.py:127-147`). With a session it also switches that session (`agent_callbacks.py:261-288`).
  - `config.set` binds the `profile` parameter's home (`_profile_scoped`, `tui_gateway/server.py:551-578`), so the write lands in that Profile's config.
  - `none` clears it. An unknown name answers 5001.
  - The reply is `{key, value, history_reset: false, info?}`. There is no session-only option.
- **`complete.slash {text:'/personality '}`** answers `{items: [{text, display, meta, kind}], replace_from}`, with `none` first and at most 30 items (`methods_complete.py:276-327`).
  - It reads the dashboard's launch-Profile config (`commands_completion.py:27-44`). Built-in personalities are the same everywhere; user-defined ones are the launch Profile's.
  - Check its params at the pin before adding the case.
- **The `personality_switch` row** the host appends is filtered out of `session.resume` (`session_history.py:143-151`), so no transcript marker reaches the app.
- **The current values** are `session.info.reasoning_effort`, `reasoning_effort_wire` and `personality` (session value, else the Profile default).

## Plan

- [ ] **Effort menu on Hermes.**
  - Lift the hiding that #1010 (#701 slice 1.1) added, and that 5.1 kept, for the effort control.
  - Show it when `capabilities[model].reasoning` isn't `false`, using the shared catalog from 5.1.
  - Feed `ReasoningEffortOption.options(forSupportedEfforts:)` (`ChatComposerSelectorControls.swift:340-394`) the full host ladder. Leave out `none` when `can_disable_reasoning` is `false`. Add titles for `max` and `ultra` to `allCases` rather than relying on the capitalized fallback.
- [ ] **Effort pick.**
  - In a chat with a runtime, send `config.set` reasoning at once.
  - In a new chat, hold it in the draft settings, as 5.1 does for the model. 5.1's apply step sends it after creation and before `prompt.submit`.
  - The pick shows as the selection. The next `session.info` supplies `reasoning_effort_wire`.
- [ ] **What the host used.** When `reasoning_effort_wire` is non-empty and differs from `reasoning_effort`, the menu label reads "xhigh · sent as high" (localized), with a matching VoiceOver label.
- [ ] **`/reasoning <level>`** on a Hermes server goes through the same path.
  - `show` and `hide` are refused on Hermes with a short message, and the Hermes autocomplete leaves them out. They would write the host's global display settings.
  - The usage line lists the Hermes ladder.
- [ ] **Personality list.** Add one `HermesCall` case with the `/personality ` text fixed in the case, so no caller can widen it into the general slash completer. `personalitySuggestions` and the bare `/personality` list (`ChatViewModel.swift:3410-3431`) read it on Hermes.
- [ ] **Personality set.**
  - `/personality <name>` asks first: "Change the personality for <Profile>? New chats in <Profile> use it on every device, and this chat switches now." Confirming sends `config.set` personality with the Profile, plus the `session_id` when the chat has a runtime. A new chat needs no draft hold, because the write is Profile-wide.
  - Success adds today's local notice, worded for the Profile.
  - `none`, `default` and `clear` send `none`.
  - A 5001 shows the host's message. A user-defined personality from the launch Profile may not exist in this Profile.
  - Add the setting next to `HermesCall.SessionSetting`, and update that type's comment: personality is the one write that reaches the Profile, deliberately.
- [ ] **Docs.** Add a short note in `docs/agents/bots.md` (or the Hermes chat doc #701 adds): reasoning is session-scoped, and personality is Profile-wide.

## Decisions

**Decided (Uzair, 2026-10-03):**
1. **Personality** keeps today's `/personality` command (no new chip). The copy and the confirmation name the Profile, because the host has no session-only personality. Its list comes from `complete.slash`, and the launch-Profile caveat is accepted.
2. **Reasoning ladder:** the host's full ladder, as in Bot Chat. `none` only shows when the model can turn reasoning off. The level the host used shows when it differs. The copy scopes changes to "this chat".
3. **Bot Chat doesn't change.** It keeps its own effort menu. Showing the level the host used there is a separate follow-up if wanted.
4. **`/reasoning show|hide` are refused on Hermes.** On the host they write global display settings, which `HermesCall` already never sends. A client-only reasoning visibility toggle would be new UI and is out of scope.

## Acceptance

- [ ] On a Hermes server, a reasoning model shows the effort menu with the host's ladder. A model reporting `reasoning: false` hides it, and one with `can_disable_reasoning: false` has no None.
- [ ] A pick in a running chat sends one `config.set` reasoning with `scope: 'session'`. In a new chat it is sent once, after creation and before `prompt.submit`. Other chats in the Profile keep their effort.
- [ ] When `reasoning_effort_wire` differs, the label shows both levels. When they match or the wire level is empty, it shows one.
- [ ] `/reasoning high` works. `/reasoning show` is refused with a message and sends nothing.
- [ ] `/personality` lists the host's personalities. Picking one asks first and names the Profile. Confirming sends one `config.set` personality with that Profile. Cancel sends nothing.
- [ ] A 5001 shows the host's message, and the chat is unchanged.
- [ ] No request sends a display word to `config.set reasoning`.
- [ ] webui chats and Bot Chat behave as before.

## Tests

These fail on today's code unless noted.
- **Effort options:** from `capabilities`, including `can_disable_reasoning: false` and `reasoning: false`, plus the label when the host used a lower level.
- **On the scripted gateway fixture:**
  - an effort pick with and without a runtime
  - `/reasoning` with a level, and `show`
  - `/personality` list, confirm, cancel and 5001
- **`HermesCall` admission:** the fixed personality completion text, and no display word for reasoning.
- **Unchanged:** `ReasoningEffortGatingTests`, `PersonalityAutocompleteTests` and `BotChatControlsTests` pass for webui and Bot Chat.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/ReasoningEffortGatingTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatComposerConfigLoaderTests --only HermesMobileTests/PersonalityAutocompleteTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotChatControlsTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientConfigurationTests`, plus the Hermes composer classes from 5.1.

## Mocks

Not required. The reasoning menu reuses today's submenu, and personality reuses `/personality`. The new copy is the "sent as" label, the Profile-wide confirmation and the refusal line; the reviewer checks it in the simulator. If the work needs a new control, stop and ask for a mock.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator, signed in with `scripts/sim-login <udid> --hermes`.
1. Open a Hermes chat on a reasoning model and set the effort to its highest level. Send. Expected: the menu shows the level, plus "sent as …" if the model takes less.
2. Open another chat in the same Profile. Expected: its effort is unchanged.
3. Run `/personality`, pick one, and confirm. Expected: the Profile-wide wording, then the notice.
4. Run `/personality none` to put the Profile back.
5. Run `/reasoning show`. Expected: the refusal message.

Step 3 writes the test Profile's default personality on the host, and step 4 restores it. Run it only on a Profile Uzair names as disposable, or against `scripts/local-hermes`.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the effort submenu, `/reasoning` and `/personality`.
- **Targets:** main app only.
- **Servers:** the effort is per chat and the personality per Profile on the host. Nothing is stored in a way that could cross servers.
- **Reverse states:** effort can be changed back. `/personality none` clears the Profile's personality.
- **Native quality:**
  - a VoiceOver label for the "sent as" text
  - new strings in the String Catalog for every language (`docs/agents/i18n.md`)
  - Dynamic Type in the menu label

## Preservation

- #508: never resend a setting after reconnect.
- #18: webui's effort gating and vocabulary stay as they are for webui servers.
- #1015: the catalog, the confirm and the draft-hold path are reused, not duplicated.

## Blockers

#1015 (#705 slice 5.1), set as a GitHub dependency.

## Outside reach

None. The manual personality step writes host config, so it runs only on a Profile Uzair names, or locally.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code.

title: feat(bots): show sent images and files as attachments in Bot Chat user bubbles
body:
**What the user gets:** In a Bot Chat, a photo or file you sent shows as an attachment: an image thumbnail or a file row you can tap to open the existing preview. You no longer see the raw instruction lines, host paths and `@file:` tokens.
**Why it matters:** Today every attachment you send to a bot shows up in your own bubble as machine text with an absolute path from the host. It looks broken and leaks host paths onto the screen.
**Cost:** Small. Simulator, plus a Branch TestFlight glance.

Epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1012 (its Hermes reference-line rule) · Not a #701 slice: it changes Bot Chat, which #903 and #701 keep unchanged.

## Problem and outcome

Bot Chat sends attachments as text references (`BotConversation.attachmentPrompt`, `HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotConversation.swift:1209-1240`):
- **Images:** `[The user attached an image: <name>]` followed by `[Examine it with the vision_analyze tool using image_url: <absolute host path>]` (`HermesMobile/Networking/Bots/BotAttachmentUpload.swift:53-56`).
- **Documents:** the host's `@file:<path>` token from `file.attach`.

User bubbles render that text raw:
- `MessageBubbleView(…, textOnly: true)` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotArtifactMessageView.swift:42-48`).
- `textOnly` turns off chips and attachment-marker stripping (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/MessageBubbleView.swift:351`, :619).
- The bubble's Copy action copies the raw content too (`BotArtifactMessageView.swift:118-125`).

Assistant rows already show media as tappable rows with thumbnails (`BotArtifactRow`, `BotArtifactMessageView.swift:284-320`) that open `BotArtifactPreview` through `model.artifactData(path:context:)`.

After this, a Bot Chat user bubble shows its typed text plus one attachment row per reference, built with #1012's Hermes reference-line rule. Images get a thumbnail, and a tap opens the existing preview.

## Contract

No new calls. Evidence pinned to hermes-agent `ca678285`.
- Downloads use the existing `GET /api/fs/download?path&profile&session_id` (`hermes_cli/web_routers/files.py:734-745`).
- A relative path resolves against the session's cwd and an absolute path is taken as is (`hermes_cli/web_server_files.py:24-45`). So both the absolute image-upload path and the workspace-relative `@file:` path download through the same `artifactData`.

## Plan

- [ ] **Parse.** For `role == "user"` rows, run #1012's rule on `message.content` to get the typed text and the attachment references.
- [ ] **Render.**
  - Keep `MessageBubbleView(textOnly: true)` for the typed text. Omit the bubble when the typed text is empty.
  - Render the references under it, right-aligned, as rows that reuse `BotArtifactRow`: the image thumbnail, or a file row with its name, and the existing preview on tap.
  - Make the row accessible to user rows (it is `private` today) rather than copying it.
- [ ] **Copy.** The user bubble's Copy copies the typed text only (`BotMessageActions.items(copyText:)`, `BotArtifactMessageView.swift:124`).
- [ ] **Unknown shapes.** A reference the rule doesn't recognise stays as text. Never drop content.
- [ ] **Docs.** `docs/agents/bots.md` § attachments: user bubbles show attachments, not reference lines.

## Decisions

Recommended:
1. **Reuse #1012's rule and `BotArtifactRow` with `BotArtifactPreview`.** No second parser and no new preview.
2. **Copy excludes the reference lines.** They're machine text, and composer recall already strips them (`BotAttachmentUpload.typedText`, `BotAttachmentUpload.swift:64-73`).
3. **Assistant rows are unchanged.**

## Acceptance

- [ ] A sent image shows as a thumbnail that opens the preview, live and after reopening the chat from cache.
- [ ] A sent PDF or document shows as a file row that opens the preview.
- [ ] No host path, instruction line or `@file:` token is visible in a user bubble.
- [ ] An attachment-only message shows only the attachment rows.
- [ ] Copy on a user bubble copies only the typed text.
- [ ] Assistant rows and Sessions chat are unchanged.

## Tests

These fail today:
- `BotChatPresentationTests` (or the closest existing Bot presentation suite): the user-row split into text and references for an image, a plain `@file:`, a quoted `@file:`, attachment-only content, and an unrecognised line that stays text.
- `BotMessageActions`: copy text excludes the reference lines.

Unchanged and passing: `BotConversationTests`, `BotAttachmentSendingTests`, `TranscriptMediaParserTests`.

Run: `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/BotChatPresentationTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotAttachmentSendingTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotConversationTests --only HermesMobileTests/TranscriptMediaParserTests`

## Mocks

Not required. It reuses the assistant row's existing attachment row and preview, aligned to the user side.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`, then a glance on a physical iPhone (Hermex Branch, batched).

1. In a Bot Chat, send a photo with a caption. Expected: the caption bubble and a thumbnail under it. A tap opens the preview.
2. Send a PDF with no text. Expected: only a file row. A tap opens the preview.
3. Leave the chat and reopen it. Expected: the same rows, from cache.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** Bot Chat from the inbox, a bot link or a push tap.
- **Targets:** main app only.
- **Native quality:** VoiceOver reads "Open attachment <name>" (the existing label); thumbnails scale with Dynamic Type layout; light and dark.

## Non-goals

- Inbox previews and search snippets, which show the host's preview text.
- Group rooms.
- Sessions chat, which #1012 covers.

## Preservation

- #508: drafts and recall are unchanged.
- #791: reactions on user rows are unchanged.

## Blockers

#1012, set as a GitHub dependency.

## Outside reach

None.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code.

title: test(bots): BotInboxTests retry test can miss its brief empty state
body:
## Problem

`BotInboxTests.testAFailedReReadWhileABotIsBusyTriesAgainUntilOneAnswers` failed once on the Xcode 27 CI runner ([run 37164497243](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/actions/runs/37164497243), #1009) with `Exceeded timeout of 5 seconds ... "inbox settled"` after 45 s, then passed on the next run. It passes locally on iOS 27.

The test waits for `liveStatuses` to become empty after two failed status reads, then for it to return to `working`. With `statusPollInterval: .zero`, the retry can restore `working` before the `settle` task re-checks its condition, so the first `settle` never sees the empty state and times out.

## Fix direction

Assert the retry without depending on observing the transient empty state, for example by waiting on the wire's `session.active_list` call count passing the two failures, then settling on `working`.

Filed from #1009. Model and harness: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context), Claude Code in T3 Code.

title: refactor(hermes): one conversation engine for Bot Chat and Hermes sessions
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #903

## What changed

`BotConversation` (1,792 lines) mixed what #701 needs (attach, replay, rebuild after a gap, never resend) with Bot-only features, and its keys assumed one conversation per Profile.

- New `HermesConversation` engine (`Features/Hermes/`) for one `ConversationTarget`: attach, replay reconciliation (cursor, epoch, gaps), #901's 512-frame hold, the 4007/4009 refusal window, backoff, the generation guard, and `write(_:attempt:runtime:stillCurrent:)`, which re-checks attach and runtime at the socket write. Recovery only reads. It hands its owner frames in `seq` order plus a rebuild signal (`afterGap`, `conversationDidLoseFrames`, `replayWasReset`); rendering stays with the owner.
- Targets: `.canonicalChat(profile)` alone runs the title lookup and changed-root rejection. `.session(profile, key)` resumes its key with no `session.list`. `.new(profile)` calls `session.create {profile}` once (new `HermesCall.sessionNew`), accepts the reduced reply, then becomes `.session` on `stored_session_id`.
- `BotConversation` is now the engine's Bot Chat owner, with unchanged text, features and keys; every write goes through `write` with its old checks. 1,792 → 1,638 lines.
- Keys: `ChatDraftKey.hermesSession` and `BotRecentTranscripts.Key.session`; `discardBotDrafts` also drops session drafts. Only a Bot Chat writes the search index.
- Request restore (`open_requests`, plus Bot's `pending_approval` / `pending_connection`) stays with the owner, documented in the engine and `docs/agents/bots.md`: its race guards depend on screen state (cards, answers, withdrawals). #1011 owns it for sessions.
- Docs: `docs/agents/bots.md` (the engine and targets), `CONTEXT.md` ("Conversation target").

Decisions: [#903 decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/903#issuecomment-5975927564), decisions 1–4. Preserved: #508, #506, #775, #777, #791, #520, #574, #901, #902.

Contract, from source and `scripts/local-hermes` at hermes-agent 0.21.5 `ca678285`: `session.create {profile}` returns `{info, message_count, messages, session_id, stored_session_id}`; identity and full resume of an unstarted session return the same reduced shape (no `session_key`, no `running`).

## How it was tested

iPhone 17e simulator, after `git diff --check`:
- `HermesConversationTests` + `HermesRequestTests`: 6 passed; `HermesConversationTests --repeat 20`: 80/80.
- `BotConversationTests` (incl. #901 socket reattach), `BotLiveActivityTests`, `HermesAgentFixtureTests`, `BotDraftTests`, `BotHistoryCacheTests`: 156 passed. `BotPendingRequestTests` names no class; its classes ran by name below.
- `BotPendingRequestParsingTests`, `BotAnsweringTests`, `ApprovalScopeTests`, `BotRecentTranscriptTests`, `ChatDraftStoreTests` and 12 more classes: 384 passed, 2 existing skips.
- Full suite (project file changed), 3 chunks: 3,156 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed: `ChatTranscriptEnvironmentStabilityTests.testLinkReadersSkipOwnerPassesWhileTheKeyboardIsUp` fails identically on untouched master 8705e614 locally (the keyboard never shows) and passes in CI.
- No existing assertion edited. Red: none possible; the new tests can't compile without `HermesConversation`, `ConversationTarget` and the new keys.

## Checklist

- [x] Local validation per `AGENTS.md` § Verifying (selection above)
- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly (none added)
- [x] No new third-party dependencies
- [x] No invented API endpoints or JSON shapes (verified on pinned source and `scripts/local-hermes`)

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator
1. iPhone: in a Bot Chat, send a message and let the reply stream. Expected: text appears once, no duplicate.
2. iPhone: send a long task, tap Stop. Expected: it stops, the chat goes idle.
3. iPhone: ask for a command that needs approval, answer it, then go home and return mid-reply. Expected: the answer lands once, the chat reconnects quietly with no duplicated text.
4. iPad Pro 11-inch (M5): repeat steps 1–3. Expected: same.

Model and harness: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context), Claude Code (hermex-batch).

title: feat(hermes): send and stream a Hermes session in the main chat
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1010. Stacked on #1019; merge after it.

## What changed

On a Hermes server the app only had the Bots inbox: `ChatView` and `ChatViewModel` spoke only webui (a concrete `APIClient` and SSE stream ids).

- `ChatTurnCoordinating` is the run surface `ChatViewModel` drives. `ChatStreamCoordinator` conforms unchanged, and webui's start, cancel and session-load reconcile stay on it.
- `HermesChatTurnCoordinator` owns a #903 `HermesConversation` and reduces its ordered frames onto the shared `ChatStreamCoordinatorDelegate`, following the issue's reducer table (`thinking.delta` and `reasoning.available` are never reasoning). A turn is (stored key, `turn_started_at`). It goes idle only after `message.complete` and `session.info {running:false}`. An `error` ends it at once only before its `message.start`.
- A rebuild (gap, backwards `seq`, reset replay, new runtime) rebuilds the transcript from the snapshot and drops only the held deltas its in-flight reply already holds after the replayed text. An unbroken reattach applies the replay.
- Send is `prompt.submit {queued:true}`, with no `config.set` or `session.cwd.set`. Queue uses the host queue and shows only a receipt, which any client's Stop clears. Steer is `session.steer` (a refusal keeps the draft and the run, #856). Stop & send is `session.redirect`. Stop is `session.interrupt`, confirmed only when a queued prompt or an open request would be lost. Nothing is resent (#508).
- Hidden on a Hermes session: the model, reasoning, Profile and workspace selectors, Files, git, the + menu and attachments, voice notes, the `/` panel, and Regenerate/Edit/Fork.
- Entry: "New Session" in the Hermes home's + menu, in DEBUG and Hermex Branch only, on `/api/profiles/active` `current`. #709 replaces it. A new session's draft moves to the session's key once the host accepts the first prompt.
- Docs: `docs/agents/bots.md` and `CONTEXT.md` ("Turn identity"). Four new strings, each in 17 languages.

Decisions: [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1010#issuecomment-5975927660), 1–6 plus 7–8. Preserved: #508, #775, #856, #857, #858, #868, #869, #902, #903. title: feat(hermes): answer approvals, questions, sudo and secret prompts in a Hermes session
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1011. Stacked on #1020; merge after it.

## What changed

A Hermes session in the main chat couldn't answer its host's requests, so an agent waiting on an approval or a question stayed stuck.

- `HermesChatRequests` keeps the session's open requests: live envelopes, `request.cancel`, and `open_requests` on every attach, deduped by `srq` id. It parses them with the Bot models. Answers go through the engine's guarded `answer`, which Bot Chat now shares with the same writes. Nothing is retried (#508).
- The approval overlay shows only the host's choices (`ApprovalScope.Host.hermes`). Skip all sends `config.set yolo on`, then `approval.respond once`. The bypass pill follows `session.info.yolo`. Turn off clears only this session's flag. A host-wide bypass (`approval_mode: off` or `--yolo`) is only reported.
- Questions, sudo and secret prompts use the Bot request card in the clarification slot. A batch locks each `qid` and never sends a bare answer. Vault prompts (#943), Desktop's tasks and unknown methods are never answered.
- A withdrawn card leaves its note (#948), except after this phone's Stop. Stop & send keeps the cards, because a redirect during a tool only steers. Any open request shows "Waiting for you". Skip all reports success only once the card leaves. A question or credential card with no room falls back to its bar, as the webui card does.
- Docs: `docs/agents/bots.md`.

Decisions: [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1011#issuecomment-5975927761), 1–4. I checked the contract against the hermes-agent `ca678285` source; details are in a comment.

iPhone 17e simulator, after `git diff --check`:
- After the review fixes: `HermesChatRequestTests`, `HermesChatTurnTests`, `BotChatPresentationTests` and `ClarificationTests`: 103 passed, 2 skipped.
- Before them: 12 request, chat, Bot, presentation and localization classes: 439 passed, 2 skipped. The full suite ran in chunks because the project file changed: 3,778 passed, 4 skipped, 1 failed. The failure is `ChatTranscriptEnvironmentStabilityTests.testLinkReadersSkipOwnerPassesWhileTheKeyboardIsUp`, the keyboard wait that #1020 also sees on untouched master.
- Red: the new class can't compile on the old code. The 5 review-fix tests fail on the pre-fix code. Stop & send cleared the card (`nil` instead of `"srq-c1"`). Turn off hid a `--yolo` bypass and sent `config.set` on an `approvals.mode: off` host. Skip all reported success after a refused release. The cramped inset never collapsed (`[:]` instead of `[40.0: 1]`).

## Checklist

- [x] Local validation per `AGENTS.md` § Verifying (selection above)
- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly (`BotJSON` reads only)

title: feat(hermes): attach images and documents in a Hermes session
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1012. Stacked on #1022; merge after it.

## What changed

A Hermes session's composer hid the + menu, so photos and files never reached the agent. Bot Chat already sends them through a verified path, but its bubbles show raw host paths, which Sessions must not.

- **Staging:** `ChatAttachmentCoordinator` keeps only the local copy under the session's #903 draft key, with Bot Chat's limits (8 files, 25 MB each, 50 MB total, counting files still staging) and JPEG/PNG conversion. Restoring a draft never uploads. The + menu, paste and drop now work on Hermes sessions.
- **Upload:** Send and Queue upload in `HermesChatTurnCoordinator.submit` on the attach and runtime they captured: image-upload plus the vision-tool line, and `file.attach` with its `ref_text` verbatim. A failure, Cancel (new, on the "Uploading attachment..." line) or a reattach submits nothing and keeps the text and files.
- **#508:** the submission mark is flushed just before the prompt. A lost or unreadable answer holds Send (also restored from the draft) while the chat reattaches and rebuilds. That attach releases the hold. Nothing is resent.
- **During a run:** with files staged, Steer drops out and a Steer default queues. Stop and send stays text-only and leaves the files staged (the Bot rule).
- **Transcript:** `MessageAttachment.hermesReferences` turns whole-block image pairs and plain or quoted `@file:` tokens into name-only chips. It also drops the host's saved `--- Context Warnings ---` / `--- Attached Context ---` footer, live and after a rebuild. ↑ recalls only the typed text. Audio chips show as file cells, and a pathless chip previews its local copy.
- Docs: `docs/agents/bots.md` § attachments.

Decisions: [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1012#issuecomment-5975927907) (Bots' image path, Bot limits, Bot Chat rendering left to #1017). I checked the contract against `scripts/local-hermes` at hermes-agent `ca678285`. Details are in a comment.

## How it was tested

iPhone 17e simulator, after `git diff --check`:
- After the bot fixes (9b779be8): `HermesChatAttachmentTests`, `ChatAttachmentCoordinatorTests`, `TranscriptMediaParserTests` and `HermesChatTurnTests`: 89 passed.
- After the review fixes (6b6a9c16): `HermesChatAttachmentTests`, `ChatComposerSendGateTests`, `HermesChatTurnTests` and `HermesChatRequestTests`: 69 passed. `ResponseSelectionVisibilityTests`, `ChatAttachmentPreviewViewModelTests` and `ChatAttachmentCoordinatorTests`: 28 passed.
- Before them (8858ee53): 11 attachment, chat, draft and Bot classes: 290 passed. The full suite (the project file changed): 3,757 passed, 4 skipped, 1 failed. The failure is `ChatTranscriptEnvironmentStabilityTests.testLinkReadersSkipOwnerPassesWhileTheKeyboardIsUp`, a keyboard wait that failed on this simulator before this branch existed.
- Red on 4fcda2c8: 4 tests failed. Staging was refused (`[]` instead of `["photo.jpg"]`), no `file.attach` went out, a text-only prompt went out after a failed upload, and the rebuilt row still held the paths and footer. The stale-error test failed on 8858ee53 (`XCTAssertNil failed: "Use up to 8 attachments…"`), and the two bot-fix tests failed without their fixes. The rest can't compile on the old APIs.

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator, physical iPhone
1. iPhone simulator on `scripts/local-hermes`, Bots inbox → New Session: tap + → Photos and pick a photo, then + → Files and pick a PDF. Type "What is in these?" and Send. Expected: the bubble shows a photo thumbnail and a PDF chip above the text, with no host path or "[The user attached an image" line. If the upload is slow, "Uploading attachment..." shows a Cancel that keeps the text and files.
2. Background the app and return. Expected: the same chips, and no paths or "Context Warnings" text. A photo sent with no text shows only the chip.
3. While a response runs, paste a copied image, type text and long-press Send. Expected: only Queue and Stop and send. Stop and send stops the run and sends just the text, and the image stays staged.

title: feat(hermes): /goal, /btw and background in a Hermes session
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1013. Stacked on #1023; merge after it.

## What changed

In a Hermes session, `/goal`, `/btw` and `/background` went to the host as plain text: goal was webui-only, btw was blocked mid-turn, and background polled webui.

- **Networking:** `HermesCall.promptBtw` / `.promptBackground` (empty text refused before sending), REST `sessionMessages` (`GET /api/sessions/{id}/messages?profile=`, nil on 404). A refused `command.dispatch goal` keeps the host's 4004 reason; a 4001 reattaches.
- **`HermesChatSideTasks`** (owned by `HermesChatTurnCoordinator`): goal through `command.dispatch {name: goal, arg}`, state from `session.control.read` on attach and every `session.control.update`. One btw at a time, matched to `btw.complete` by task id; background cards filled by `background.complete`. Unknown ids are ignored, an early completion waits for its task id, nothing is resent. After an attach that lost frames, a waiting btw is unavailable and each unfinished task is read once from its `bg_<id>` session (404 or no reply: unavailable).
- **ChatViewModel:** goal `exec` output is a notice (pinned mid-turn); a goal `send` message goes out once as a queued prompt shown as its `display` (#508). Set Goal waits for the running turn; the control verbs run mid-turn. btw and background run mid-turn; they and a typed /goal keep the draft when not delivered.
- **ChatView:** only /goal, /btw, /background and /bg are routed on Hermes. The btw card docks in the clarification slot and shrinks to one line when a host request takes it; Expand opens a full-screen cover with a static run pill ("Waiting for you" when a request holds the turn). No repainting animation; Reduce Motion transitions.
- 16 new strings with 17 translations; `docs/agents/bots.md` § send modes.

Decisions: [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1013#issuecomment-5975946794). Contract checked on `scripts/local-hermes` at hermes-agent `ca678285`, including the `bg_<id>` messages read; details in a comment.

**Design:** pick B (card above the composer) + expand 1 (full-screen cover), https://fdamggempluc.postplan.dev/v/2#issue-1013

## How it was tested

iPhone 17e simulator, after `git diff --check`:
- Red on 9b779be8: `HermesChatSideTaskTests` 0 passed, 7 failed (btw/background `unsupported` instead of `executed`, goal went to webui, no side-session read). The 4001 test failed on 2a8164ec (`"refused"` instead of the reconnect copy).
- After the bot fix (57f636e7): `HermesChatSideTaskTests`, `HermesChatTurnTests`, `SlashCommandExecutorTests`, `SlashCommandTests`, `ChatViewModelSendTests`: 340 passed. The new draft test failed first on 1a615ad2 (`unsupported` instead of `notDelivered`).
- After the review fixes (1a615ad2): `HermesChatSideTaskTests` `--repeat 5`: 85 passed; with `HermesChatTurnTests` and `HermesChatRequestTests`: 43 passed.
- On 2a8164ec: 10 Hermes, Bot, slash, agent-control and localization classes: 152 passed; `ChatViewModelSendTests` + `BotConversationTests`: 316 passed; full suite (project file changed): 3,779 passed, 2 skipped. `ci/check_string_catalog.py`: all 2,186 keys covered.

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator, physical iPhone
1. iPhone simulator on `scripts/local-hermes`, New Session: send `/btw what are you doing? Give me a long answer`. Expected: the BTW card docks above the composer with the answer, and some transcript stays visible above it with the keyboard up and at an accessibility text size (the card body scrolls). With Reduce Motion on, X and ask again: the card fades in and out, no slide.
2. Tap Expand. Expected: a full-screen BTW view over the session title; Collapse returns to the card, X closes it.
3. `/background summarize this chat`. Expected: a Background card that fills with the result.
4. `/goal write three haiku`; while its approval shows, open Goal controls. Expected: Set Goal disabled, Pause enabled; Pause turns the toolbar icon to pause, and after Allow once "⏸ Goal paused" shows. Resume and Mark Done each post a notice.
5. iPad Pro 11-inch (M5) simulator, same host: `/btw`, then Expand. Expected: the cover fills the window, sidebar included, and the answer keeps a readable column; Collapse returns to the card.
6. Physical iPhone (Hermex Branch): start a long turn that will ask for approval or a question, then `/btw what are you doing?`. Expected: the card answers while the turn streams on, with no duplicated text. If a question arrives with the card open, the card shrinks to one line above it.
7. Expand the btw before the approval or question arrives. Expected: the pill reads "Waiting for you" once it does; Collapse shows the request.
8. `/background summarize this chat`, background the app past the tunnel's idle timeout and return. Expected: the result card, or "Result unavailable.", never a spinner.

title: feat(hermes): drive the Live Activity from a Hermes session
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1014. Part of #701 (slice 1.5). Stacked on #1024; merge after it.

## What changed

A Hermes session in the main chat drove no Live Activity. Only webui chats and Bot Chat did, so a Hermes run could not be followed from the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island.

`HermesChatTurnCoordinator` now drives the shared `AgentLiveActivityManager` at its own turn points:
- **Start** when a turn begins, under the interim key `hermes:<profile>:<stored key>` ([decision 1](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1014#issuecomment-5975927995)). The stream id is the host's `turn_started_at` when known, otherwise an id kept for the turn. A reattach inside the turn adopts the same activity. The snapshot title is applied first, so the activity opens under the session title.
- **Updates:** reasoning, tool start/complete and title. Reply text only while excerpts are on; with them off the reply still moves the status to writing, as in Bot Chat. Open requests from #1011 show as waiting for approval (an approval) or for clarification (anything else), as in Bot Chat.
- **Stale and end:** stale on leave/background and on a dropped socket. Complete, Stop/interrupted, and error (or a lone `error`) end it as complete, cancelled and failed.
- **Ownership:** every update, stale and end call checks the manager still drives this key, so webui and Bot activities are never touched.
- **Tap and reconcile:** `AgentRunTapTarget` builds no URL for a `hermes:` key (the tap opens the app as it is), and the webui orphan reconciler skips `hermes:` keys. No push until #706. `AgentRunActivityAttributes` is unchanged (decision 2).
- `docs/agents/bots.md` § Bot Live Activity: the interim key and what #706 slice 6.2 changes.

**Limit:** while the app is in the background the socket is closed, so a locked phone shows the last state, dimmed as not current, until the app returns. Live background updates for Hermes sessions come with push in #706.

## How it was tested

iPhone 17e simulator, after `git diff --check`:
- Red on 57f636e7 plus the init seam: `HermesChatLiveActivityTests` 1 passed, 9 failed (no start, updates, waiting or end, and a webui tap URL for a `hermes:` key). The one pass is the ownership guard, green before and after.
- `HermesChatLiveActivityTests`, `LiveActivityTests`, `BotLiveActivityTests`, `HermesChatTurnTests`, `HermesChatRequestTests`: 131 passed.
- Full suite (project file changed) on c3754b11: 3,789 passed, 4 pre-existing environment skips. `ci/check_string_catalog.py`: all 2,186 keys covered.
- Review fix (df457bce): `testTheReplyAfterAnAnsweredQuestionMovesTheActivityOffWaiting` red first (events `[waitingForClarification]` with no `responding`); then the five classes above: 132 passed.

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, physical iPhone
1. iPhone simulator on `scripts/local-hermes`, a Hermes session: send a prompt that runs a tool behind an approval, then pull down Notification Center. Expected: one activity under the session title showing working, then the tool, then waiting for approval.
2. Close it, Allow once, and let the turn finish; then send another prompt and tap Stop. Expected: "Response complete", then "Response cancelled".
3. Physical iPhone (Hermex Branch), through the tunnel: start a long tool turn and pull down Notification Center. Expected: live tool progress, and waiting once an approval opens. Lock the phone. Expected: the last state stays, dimmed. Unlock and open the session after the turn ends. Expected: finished.
4. Start another turn, go to the Home Screen, and check the Dynamic Island compact, then expanded (long-press). Expected: the webui layout, no bot avatar. Tap it, and the Lock Screen card on a later turn. Expected: the app opens where it was, with no switch to a webui server.

title: feat(hermes): keep attachment thumbnails, preview PDFs and export images in a Hermes session
body:
**What the user gets:** In a Hermes session, a photo you sent keeps its thumbnail after you reopen the chat, and tapping any sent attachment opens it in a preview with Save to Files and Share. That includes PDFs.
**Why it matters:** Found during the #1012 batch and the 2026-10-05 merge walk. Today, a rebuilt Hermes transcript shows a generic file icon for photos, a PDF won't open, and nothing sent can be saved.
**Cost:** Small to Medium. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; physical iPhone only if this ships in a batch.

Epic #713 · Follows #1012 ([PR #1023](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/1023)) and reuses #1017's Bot Chat attachment rows.

## Context

All three gaps come from one cause. A Hermes session's attachment chip doesn't keep the host path, and the session has no way to download a file from the host.

- `HermesChatTurnCoordinator.displayed` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/HermesChatTurnCoordinator.swift:714`) builds chips as `MessageAttachment(name:isImage:)`, so the path from `MessageAttachment.hermesReferences` is dropped.
- Local thumbnails are keyed by the prompt's temporary `local-…` id (`ChatViewModel.swift:2698`, `ChatAttachmentCoordinator.keepLocalPreviews`). A rebuilt row has a different id, so it finds no thumbnail. With no path, `GridAttachmentCell` (`MessageBubbleView.swift:~640`) can't load one remotely either.
- `ChatAttachmentPreviewViewModel.load` (`ChatAttachmentPreviewView.swift:362`) fetches only through the webui file API. With no path it falls back to "This attachment does not have a server file path." `ImageLightboxView` has no export.

Bot Chat already does all of this (#1017). `BotPrompt` (`BotArtifactMessageView.swift:310`) keeps each prompt attachment's host path. `BotArtifactRow` downloads thumbnails through `artifactData`, and `BotArtifactPreview` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotArtifactPreview.swift`) opens files in Quick Look with Save to Files and Share.

## Contract

Checked at hermes-agent `ca678285` (`HERMES_AGENT_TESTED_SHA`, 0.21.5):

- **`GET /api/fs/download?path=&profile=&session_id=`** (`hermes_cli/web_routers/files.py:733`). It returns a `FileResponse` with the file's MIME type.
- With `session_id`, the host looks up the session and resolves `path` with `_fs_path(path, cwd=<session cwd>)` (`web_server_files.py:24`):
  - Absolute paths are used as they are. Image-upload's `HERMES_HOME/images/dashboard_…` path is one.
  - Relative paths resolve against the session's working directory. `@file:` references are relative.
  - An unknown session returns 404.
- Hermex already builds this request in `HermesREST.downloadArtifact` and sends it through `BotClient.artifactData` with the stale-owner checks. Nothing new crosses the wire.

## Expected behavior

- **Chips keep the path internally.** `displayed` keeps the host path from `hermesReferences` on each chip. The path never shows up anywhere: not in bubble text, chip labels, VoiceOver labels, preview titles, Copy, or composer recall.
- **Thumbnails.** On a Hermes session, `loadAttachmentImage` downloads through the session's Bot transport. It uses `engine.wire.artifactData` with a `BotArtifactContext` built from the connection, Profile, stored session key and current attempt, as in `upload` (`HermesChatTurnCoordinator.swift:289`). Thumbnails go through `TranscriptImageCache`, under a namespace that includes the connection id, Profile and stored session key, so nothing crosses connections or Profiles. The local-id thumbnail still covers the live row before any rebuild. When there's no connection, the cell shows its file icon; it doesn't show a spinner indefinitely.
- **Preview and export.** Tapping a chip in a Hermes session opens `BotArtifactPreview`, downloading through the same transport, for every kind of file, images included. PDFs open in Quick Look, and every file gets Save to Files and Share. A chip without a path, such as a row from before this change, still opens its local copy as it does today. Webui chats keep `ChatAttachmentPreviewView` and `ChatAttachmentImageLightbox` unchanged.
- **Stale results.** A download that finishes after a reattach, a session switch or dismissal is dropped (`BotFailure.stale`). `BotArtifactPreview` already removes its temporary file when it's dismissed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] After reopening a Hermes session, a sent photo's chip shows its thumbnail.
- [ ] A sent PDF opens in Quick Look with Save to Files and Share.
- [ ] A sent image opens with Save to Files and Share.
- [ ] No host path appears anywhere in the UI, live or after a rebuild.
- [ ] Two connections, or two Profiles on one connection, never show each other's thumbnails.
- [ ] Webui attachment chips, previews and the lightbox are unchanged.

## Validation plan

Tests, in `HermesChatAttachmentTests` or a sibling. These fail today:
- `displayed` keeps the path on image-pair and plain/quoted `@file:` chips, and the displayed text still has no path in it.
- The Hermes image loader sends `HermesREST.downloadArtifact` with the session's Profile and stored key, and drops a result that arrives after the attempt changes.
- The thumbnail cache namespace differs across connection id and Profile.

Unchanged and passing: `ChatAttachmentCoordinatorTests`, `ChatAttachmentPreviewViewModelTests`, `TranscriptMediaParserTests`, `BotAttachmentSendingTests`.

## Linked issue

## What changed

Switching a server from hermes-webui to the Hermes dashboard at the same address stopped at "This server is already configured." The old webui server was still saved under that address, and Hermex gave no hint about how to get past it.

title: feat(chat): preview Hermes MEDIA documents natively
body:
## Linked issue

Refs #145 — the PDF/document-preview slice, retargeted to Hermes sessions as requested. Reuses #1039's `BotArtifactPreview`; does not close the broader MEDIA rendering issue.

## What changed

Hermes session MEDIA document cards now open the same native Quick Look reader used by sent files, with Save to Files and Share. The earlier webui implementation has been reverted; webui document rows remain download-only.

- Local documents use the existing Hermes filesystem download, scoped to the active Profile and durable session/compression-tip key. No webui fallback.
- Public HTTP(S) document URLs download directly through an ephemeral, cookie/credential-free transport, never through a filesystem endpoint. Existing streaming 25 MB limits and redirect rejection apply to both preview and export.
- Reuse the existing supported-format classifier. Images/audio/video keep their existing surfaces; their local Hermes paths now use the scoped Hermes transport. Unknown formats stay download-only. Ordinary external document links remain links.
- Cancellation and reattach generation guards prevent late bytes from producing previews or exports.
- README and agent conventions describe the direct-session path. No new endpoint or dependency.
- Native document cards localize “Tap to preview” and “Preview %@” in all 17 shipped translation languages (`needs_review`) and use `chevron.forward`. They inherit interface direction; other media and webui retain the original forced-LTR modifier and alignment guides.

## How it was tested

- Production document card rendered in English and Arabic: localized subtitle, right-pointing LTR / left-pointing RTL chevron. Temporary presentation fixture removed before final normal build/install/launch. The normal app reached its saved localhost connection, whose disposable smoke server is stopped; `scripts/sim-login` cannot reconnect here because the required `hermex-webui` Keychain item is absent. This follow-up is a localization/layout smoke, not a new connected-chat or phone-export claim. [Visual evidence](https://github.com/stevenbarash/hermex/issues/2#issuecomment-6025021835).

- Signed Debug main-chat smoke against `scripts/local-hermes` (pinned Hermes 0.21.5), with a disposable session and a generated synthetic PDF. Observed the download-only baseline row, native preview row, real session-scoped PDF download and rendered Quick Look reader. Also rendered the PDF through the public-URL path using a disposable loopback static server.
- Temporary launch fixtures invoked the production document presentation handler; fixture code was removed afterward. Save/Share controls were visibly present and export-byte reuse is covered by regressions. This is not a claim of physical-phone taps, completed Files/Share operations, or composer-focus restoration.
- Final ordinary signed Debug build/install/launch after removing smoke fixtures. No real user session or Health data used.

![Public-URL native document reader](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ba03ee4d-1d1d-4d56-b88b-f56a7466ba09)

### Manual checks confirmed

The contributor confirms that all requested manual checks work on the phone. These are contributor-reported checks, separate from the automated and simulator evidence above.

- [x] Local file preview and public-URL document preview.

title: feat(hermes): pick the model and Profile in the Hermes composer
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1015

## What changed

Hermes chats hid the model and Profile chips, so every chat ran the host's current Profile on its default model.

- **Model chip:** lists `model.options` for the chat's Profile (unauthenticated providers, unavailable models, and providers left empty are skipped). A pick is one `config.set` with `--session` through Bot Chat's own `BotChatControls`, so the expensive-model confirm and the "applies after this response" (`deferred`) path are shared, not rewritten. A new chat's session exists from the moment it opens, so its pick also goes out at once (agreed in the plan). `/model <name>` resolves against the catalog and takes the same path.
- **Profile chip:** lists `profiles.list`, the setup Profile included. In a new chat with nothing sent, a pick swaps the chat to that Profile and carries the draft over. In an existing chat, the "Start New Session?" alert opens a new chat on top, so Back returns to the original session, whose Profile never changes.
- **Remembered Profile:** New Session uses the last pick per server (`hermes.selectedProfile|<server>`), falling back to `current` when the host no longer lists it. It is never written to the host. Sign-out and server removal clear it.
- `BotModelCatalog` becomes the shared `HermesModelCatalog`. Reasoning stays hidden until #1016.
- No `POST /api/profiles/active`, `POST /api/model/set`, `refresh: true` or `--global`. `model.options` shapes were checked against `inventory.py` at the `HERMES_AGENT_TESTED_SHA` pin.

## How it was tested

2. In a new chat, pick another Profile and send. The session is in that Profile; after relaunch, New Session opens in it again.

title: feat(bots): browse and create sessions within a bot profile
body:
## Problem

A direct Hermes server opens the Bots workspace, where each bot profile currently exposes only its canonical `Bot Chat`. Hermes Desktop supports multiple sessions per profile, but Hermex does not let a user browse or create those profile-scoped sessions.

The Bot Mode toggle adds to the confusion: turning it off does not convert a direct Hermes server into the webui Sessions interface, because the direct Hermes server intentionally remains Bots-first.

## Proposed behavior

- Keep tapping a bot as the fast path to its existing canonical `Bot Chat`.
- Add a bot-scoped Sessions screen under `Bots → <profile>` that lists sessions for that profile and has a New Session action.
- Keep the canonical Bot Chat visibly distinct and preserve existing profile-only bot links.
- Scope drafts, cached transcript state, activity, navigation, and future deep links by connection + profile + session key, rather than profile alone.

## Constraints

The gateway contract needs to be used deliberately: the present Bot transport only requests `session.list` by the exact `Bot Chat` title and treats it as the one canonical session. The feature must add a safe all-sessions list/create path without changing the canonical behavior or mixing regular webui Sessions with direct Hermes Bots.

title: feat(hermes): slash commands and autocomplete in Hermes chats
body:
**What the user gets:** In a Hermes chat, typing `/` opens the command panel with the host's full command list: built-ins, Hermes-only commands such as `/context`, the user's own quick commands, plugins and skills. Running one shows the host's answer in the chat, and arguments get the host's suggestions.
**Why it matters:** Parity with Hermes Desktop and the CLI (#713). Today the panel is hidden in Hermes chats and every command except `/goal`, `/btw`, `/bg` and `/model` reaches the model as plain text. #1025 asked for `/context`.
**Cost:** Large. One PR. Simulator only.

Epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1016 · Fixes #1025 · Bot Chat follows in #1038

## Context

- The host's `prompt.submit` never interprets a leading `/` (`docs/agents/bots.md` § Slash suggestions). A command runs only through `slash.exec` or `command.dispatch`.
- **The panel is hidden.** `slashQuery` starts with `guard showsSessionControls` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatComposerView.swift:370-400`, flag at `:275`), and `ChatView.swift:650` passes `showsSessionControls: !isHermesSession`.
- **Typed commands go out as text.** The send path runs a slash command in a Hermes chat only when `ServerSideAction.runsInHermesSession` is true (`ChatView.swift:2254-2298`, `SlashCommand.swift:73-78`), which covers `goal`, `btw`, `background` and `model`.
- **Every panel loader is webui-only:** `agentCommands` (`ChatComposerConfigLoader.swift:85`, skipped for Hermes at `ChatViewModel.swift:955`), `loadSkillSlashSuggestions` (`:1219`), `loadPersonalitySuggestions` (`:1185`).
- Reference client: Hermes Desktop at the pin, `apps/desktop/src/lib/desktop-slash-commands.ts` and `apps/desktop/src/app/session/hooks/use-prompt-actions/slash.ts` (`runSlash`). It lists `commands.catalog`, runs everything it doesn't own through `slash.exec`, and acts on the returned directive.

## Decisions (Uzair, 2026-10-05)

1. **Full parity with Hermes Desktop and the CLI.** Hermes-only commands are in scope. The panel lists every command `commands.catalog` lists, including the ones the host tags `desktop: terminal|settings|advanced|…`; the host answers for them.
2. **`slash.exec` opens for Hermes chats.** The user's `quick_commands` (which can run shell) and plugin commands appear and run when picked or typed, as on Desktop.
3. **The app owns** `/new`, `/stop`, `/model`, `/reasoning`, `/personality`, `/goal`, `/btw`, `/bg` (and Hermex's `/background`) and `/yolo`. Each keeps or gets its native path. Everything else in the catalog goes to the host.
4. **Held until #702 slice 2.3:** `/compress` `/compact` `/undo` `/retry` `/clear` `/branch` `/fork` `/title` `/resume` `/sessions`. They rewrite history or move between chats, so the host alone would leave the phone stale. They stay in the panel; running one shows a notice naming #702 and sends nothing.
5. **A name the catalog doesn't know** (`/tmp/foo is broken`) is sent as text, as today.
6. **A chat with no runtime yet** answers host commands locally: "Send a message first, then run /<name>." No empty host session is created. App-owned commands still work.
7. **The command list is read once per chat**, searched on the phone. `complete.slash` runs only at the argument stage, debounced, latest reply wins.
8. **Bot Chat** gets the same engine in #1038. Group rooms are out.

## Contract

Read from source at `HERMES_AGENT_TESTED_SHA` (`ca678285`, 0.21.5). Re-check each against `scripts/local-hermes` before building on it (Validation plan).

- **`commands.catalog {session_id?, profile?}`** → `{pairs: [[name, description]], sub: {name: [subcommand]}, canon: {alias: canonical}, commands: {"/name": {argument_mode?, desktop?}}, categories: [{name, pairs}], skills: {key: {usage, origin}}, skill_count, warning}` (`tui_gateway/methods_tools.py:485-511`, contract `tui_gateway/contracts/tools_commands.py:190-228`).
  - Lists registry commands (including `cli_only`), then `quick_commands` (category "User commands"), plugin commands, and skills. It leaves out `gateway_only` commands and `_TUI_HIDDEN` (`sethome`, `commands`, `approve`, `deny`), and adds `_TUI_EXTRA` (`/density`, `/logs`, `/mouse`, `/sessions`; `tui_gateway/server.py:3270-3277`).
  - It is not Profile-scoped (`_rpc`, not `_scoped_rpc`). With `session_id` the skills follow that session's Profile and workspace. Without one they come from the launch Profile; `profile` only picks the working folder. Built-ins are the same everywhere.
- **`complete.slash {text, session_id?}`** → `{items: [{text, display, meta, kind: "command"|"skill"}], replace_from}` (`tui_gateway/methods_complete.py:276-327`). At the argument stage (`text` contains a space) items keep the command's order, at most 30, and `replace_from` is the index after the last space.
- **`slash.exec {session_id, command}`** → `{output, warning?}`, or a directive `{type, output?, target?, message?, notice?, display?, name?, status?}` (`tui_gateway/methods_tools.py:937-994`). It needs a live session (`_sess_nowait`).
  - Answered in-process, no worker: `context`, `usage`, `status`, `help`, `tools`, `history`, `review`, `prompt`, `clear`, `compress` and a bare `model` (`_LIVE_SLASH_OUTPUT`, `tui_gateway/methods_slash.py:214-245`).
  - Routed to `command.dispatch`, returning a directive: `retry`, `queue`/`q`, `steer`, `plan`, `goal`, `loop`, `moa`, `undo`, `learn`, `init`, `compress`/`compact` (`_PENDING_INPUT_COMMANDS`, `server.py:3281`), and skill bundles.
  - A skill answers error 4018 "skill command: use command.dispatch for /<name>".
  - Plugin commands answer `{output}`.
  - Everything else runs in a per-session slash worker (a headless CLI started on first use) with a 45 s limit per command (`_SLASH_WORKER_TIMEOUT_S`, `server.py:104`). A worker failure is 5030.
- **Directive `type`:** `exec`/`plugin` carry `output`; `alias` a `target`; `send`/`prefill`/`skill` a `message`. UIs render `display`, never `message` (`DispatchType`, `tools_commands.py:244-275`).
- **Worker side effects reach the live chat only for** `model`, `approvals`, `personality`, `prompt`, `compress`, `fast`, `reload-mcp` and `stop` (`_SLASH_MIRRORS`, `methods_slash.py:347-354`). A `/yolo` through `slash.exec` changes only the worker, which is why the app owns it.

## Expected behavior

- [ ] **Panel.** Lift the Hermes gate so `/` opens the panel in Hermes chats. webui chats don't change.
- [ ] **Command rows** come from `commands.catalog`: `pairs` for names and descriptions, `canon` for aliases, and `skills` for which rows are skills (as Bot Chat reads it, `BotSlashCommands.swift`). They are ranked with the existing ranker.
  - Read with the runtime's `session_id` once the chat has one, and again after a reconnect. A new chat reads it with `profile`.
  - A stale reply (the chat moved on or the server switched) is dropped. The list lives only in the chat's view model: nothing persisted, nothing crosses servers.
  - A failed read is silent and the panel shows the app-owned rows only.
- [ ] **Arguments.**
  - App-owned commands keep their native suggestions: model groups, the reasoning ladder and personalities from #1016, goal actions.
  - Host commands ask `complete.slash` with the draft up to the cursor, about 150 ms after typing stops. Only the newest reply is used, and a pending one is cancelled when the panel closes. Accepting a row replaces from `replace_from`.
  - #1016's fixed `/personality ` completion case becomes this general case.
- [ ] **Send.** A draft that opens with `/name` resolves in this order:
  1. app-owned → its existing handler (`/yolo` → the approval-bypass `config.set yolo`, `HermesChatRequests.swift:222`);
  2. held → the #702 notice;
  3. a catalog skill → the existing skill expansion;
  4. any other catalog name or alias → `slash.exec {session_id, command: <the draft line>}`;
  5. otherwise → sent as text.

  `runsInHermesSession` is replaced by the app-owned set.
- [ ] **Results.**
  - `output`, `warning` and `notice` show as a local notice (pinned while a turn runs), with line breaks kept.
  - `send` submits `message` through the normal send path, so a running turn queues it.
  - `skill` submits `message`; the transcript shows the host's projection of the typed line.
  - `prefill` puts `message` in the composer.
  - `alias` runs `target` once. A second alias in a row is an error notice.
  - A host error shows the host's message and puts the draft back.
- [ ] **`HermesCall`** gets two cases, with admission:
  - `slashExec(sessionID:command:)`: non-empty session; one line starting with `/`.
  - `completeSlash(text:sessionID:)`: one line starting with `/` that contains a space (argument stage only).

  Gateway policy:
  - `slashExec` times out locally, with a deadline above the host's 45 s worker limit, so a slow command fails only itself and never ends the chat's connection. It carries the host's message on rejection.
  - `completeSlash` is cancellation-safe and times out locally.
- [ ] **Docs.** Rewrite `docs/agents/bots.md` § Slash suggestions: Hermes chats run commands through `slash.exec`; Bot Chat until #1038; the app-owned and held sets. Drop "`slash.exec` stays unsupported".

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] In a Hermes chat, `/` lists the host's commands, quick commands, plugin commands and skills; `/ctx` finds `/context` by alias.
- [ ] `/context`, `/usage` and `/help` show the host's text as a notice. Nothing reaches the model.
- [ ] `/personality ` suggests the host's personalities. A host command with subcommands (for example `/approvals `) suggests them from `complete.slash`.
- [ ] `/queue <text>` while a turn runs sends `<text>` as the next message.
- [ ] A user quick command runs once and its output shows.
- [ ] `/undo` shows the #702 notice and sends nothing. `/notacommand hi` is sent as text.
- [ ] In a new, unsent chat, `/context` says to send a message first, and no host session is created.
- [ ] A host error (for example `/steer` with no text) shows the host's message and leaves the draft in place.
- [ ] A command running longer than 30 s does not drop the chat's connection.
- [ ] webui chats behave as before.

## Tests

- **`HermesCall` admission:** `slashExec` and `completeSlash` accept and refuse the right shapes; `completeSlash` refuses a bare `/con`.
- **Send routing** on the scripted gateway (`BotSocketHost`, as in `HermesChatSideTaskTests.openChat`): an app-owned command, a held one, a skill, a catalog command, an unknown name, and a chat with no runtime.
- **Directive handling:** `output`, `send`, `skill`, `prefill`, `alias` (and a double alias), and a host error.
- **Catalog:** rows from a recorded `commands.catalog` reply, aliases through `canon`, a stale reply dropped.
- **Argument completion:** debounce, and only the newest reply applied.
- **Unchanged:** `SlashCommandTests`, `SlashCommandExecutorTests`, `ComposerSlashTriggerTests`, `HermesChatSideTaskTests`, `HermesChatSettingsTests`.

## Validation plan

Before building on the contract, run `scripts/local-hermes` and record the replies in the PR:
- `commands.catalog` with and without `session_id`;
- `complete.slash {text: "/personality "}` and `{text: "/approvals "}`;
- `slash.exec` for `/context`, `/help`, `/queue hi` (`send`), a skill (4018) and a configured quick command.

Add the replies the tests use to `HermesMobileTests/Fixtures/HermesAgent/`.

Run: `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesRequestTests --only HermesMobileTests/SlashCommandTests --only HermesMobileTests/SlashCommandExecutorTests --only HermesMobileTests/ComposerSlashTriggerTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatSideTaskTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatSettingsTests`, plus the new classes.

title: feat(hermes): set reasoning and personality in the Hermes composer
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1016

## What changed

Hermes chats had no effort menu, and `/reasoning` and `/personality` went to the host as plain prompt text.

- **Effort menu:** shows the host's ladder (`none` through `ultra`) unless `model.options` marks the live model `reasoning: false`, and leaves out None when `can_disable_reasoning` is false. A pick is one `config.set` reasoning with `scope: "session"` through Bot Chat's `BotChatControls`, so other chats in the Profile keep their effort. A new chat's session exists from the moment it opens (#1034), so its pick goes out right away, before any `prompt.submit`; nothing waits in the draft.
- **What the host used:** when `session.info.reasoning_effort_wire` differs from `reasoning_effort`, the chip reads "XHigh · sent as High", with a matching VoiceOver sentence.
- **`/reasoning <level>`** takes the same path. Display words (`show`, `hide`, `on`, `off`, …) are refused with a message and send nothing. Like the menu, it waits for a running reply.
- **`/personality`:** the bare command lists `complete.slash {text: "/personality "}`, a new `HermesCall` case with the text fixed. `/personality <name>` first asks "Change the personality for <Profile>?", then sends one `config.set` personality (Profile-wide by design; no scope). `none`, `default` and `clear` send `none`. It's refused while a response runs, as on webui. The host's 5001 message shows as-is.
- Max and Ultra get localized titles without joining webui's fallback ladder, so webui is unchanged. Bot Chat is unchanged.
- The `/` autocomplete parts moved to #1036 (the panel is still hidden in Hermes chats).
