Use `tool_call_labels` for names when present. - Reasoning becomes a `ReasoningGroup`. - `display_kind` handling: - `hidden`: skipped. - `steer`: unwrapped as today. - `async_delegation_complete`: the delegation completion row. - `failed_turn`: the failed-turn note. - A compaction summary: the existing "Context compaction · Reference only" card (`CompressionAnchorResolver`, `Chat/CompressionAnchorResolver.swift`, `ChatViewModel.swift:7052-7059, 7278-7284`). - Compacted rows (`compacted == 1`) render above the card as reference rows, as webui shows them. - `codex_*` arrays are skipped. - [ ] **Load and page.** On attach, the coordinator still runs `session.resume` for identity, live state and the in-flight turn, but with `omit_messages: true`. Settled history comes from the latest page. - `hasOlderMessages` follows `returned == limit`. - `loadOlderMessages` pages with `offset = loaded display rows` and dedupes by row id, since new rows shift offsets. - The in-flight prompt and reply from `inflight` still sit after the page, as `rebuild` does today. - [ ] **After a turn.** When `message.complete` reports `persisted_turn.complete`, re-read the newest page and merge it by row id. The streamed rows swap to their durable ids without a visible jump: match by `user_row_id` and `final_assistant_row_id`. A reconnect gap (`rebuildAfterGap`) re-reads the newest page the same way. - [ ] **Row ids.** `ChatMessage.rowID` (`Models/ChatMessage.swift:29-32, 50`) is set from the REST row. Update its comment, which says only the Bot projection sets it. - [ ] **Docs.** `docs/agents/bots.md`: Hermes sessions page REST history; Bot Chat keeps the snapshot. ## Decisions Recommended (no product question): 1. **REST for settled history, the socket for the live turn.** REST carries tool output and paging; the snapshot doesn't. 2. **Message ids come from row ids** (`/row-`), so a page reload, a turn end and a later cache (2.1b) agree on identity. 3. **Legacy rotated ancestors are out of scope.** `/messages` reads the tip segment only, and in-place compaction (the default) keeps everything in one segment. 4. **Bot Chat keeps the snapshot projection.** Moving it is #709's or #1038's call. ## Acceptance - [ ] Opening a Hermes session with more than 100 messages shows the newest 100, and scrolling up loads earlier pages until the first message, with no duplicates. - [ ] Tool calls in history show their full output, not just a name. - [ ] A compacted session shows its earlier turns above the "Context compaction · Reference only" card. - [ ] `hidden` rows never render, and an unknown `display_kind` renders as plain content. - [ ] After a turn ends, the transcript keeps its scroll position and the sent message and reply carry row ids. - [ ] A reconnect mid-turn ends with no duplicated or missing rows. - [ ] Bot Chat history is unchanged. ## Tests These fail today. - **New `HermesTranscriptPagingTests`:** - exact query - newest-page load - paging to the start on a short page - dedupe when offsets shift - tool pairing by `tool_call_id` - `display_kind` cases, including `hidden` and an unknown kind - compaction card placement - `codex_*` skipped - `persisted_turn` merge - the gap re-read - **Fixtures:** sanitized `/messages` pages shaped from the pinned handler, checked once against a read-only `curl` of the live host. - **Unchanged and passing:** `HermesChatTurnTests`, `HermesConversationTests`, `BotConversationTests`, `ChatViewModelMergeDedupTests`. - **Run:** `scripts/test-sim --only HermesMobileTests/HermesTranscriptPagingTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesConversationTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotConversationTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatViewModelMergeDedupTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatSideTaskTests` ## Mocks Not required. The rows, tool groups and compaction card are reused. ## Manual test Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`. 1. Open a session with a long tool-heavy history. Expected: the latest messages, with tool output, and earlier ones on scroll. 2. Run `/compress` from the host's CLI on that session, then reopen it. Expected: the earlier turns sit above the compaction card. 3. Send a message, background the app mid-reply, and return. Expected: one copy of each message. ## Surfaces - **Entry points:** every way into a Hermes session (the 2.1 list, new chat). Bot Chat is not touched. - **Targets:** main app and tests. - **Connection modes:** a reconnect mid-turn re-reads the newest page. A REST failure keeps what's on screen and shows the existing load error. - **Native quality:** no new animation, and scroll position is kept across loads. ## Preservation - #508: never resend after a reconnect. - #1012: attachment rows and their paths render as today. - #1013: `/goal`, `/btw` and background rows render as today. - #1030's attachment thumbnails, if it lands first. ## Blockers #1046 (2.1), set as a GitHub dependency. Without the list, nothing opens a long existing session. ## Outside reach None. Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code (T3 Code).

title: feat(hermes): rename, pin, archive, delete and export Hermes sessions
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, the Sessions list can rename, pin, archive (with an Archived screen to restore from), delete and export a session as JSON, the same as on webui. `/title ` renames the open chat. **Why it matters:** 2.1 shows the list with these actions hidden. Without them a Hermes user can't tidy or remove sessions from the phone, and every one-way door needs its way back. **Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed. Part of #702 (slice 2.3a) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1046 (2.1), #1036 · **Unblocks:** none ## Problem and outcome webui's row actions are `SessionMutator` calls (`Features/SessionList/SessionMutator.swift:39-85`) wrapped by `SessionListViewModel.archive`, `unarchive`, `delete`, `rename` and `export` (`SessionListViewModel.swift:947-1112`). The menus and swipes are in `SessionListComponents.swift:643-700, 880-980`; the confirmations are in `SessionListActionConfirmations.swift`; the Archived screen is `ArchivedSessionsView` (`SessionListView.swift:684, 1037-1057, 1939`); and #865 added the "Archived · Undo" toast (`SessionListView.swift:1460-1464`). 2.1 hides all of these on Hermes rows. After this, on Hermes rows: - Rename, Pin/Unpin, Archive, Delete and Export → JSON work, from the context menu and the swipes. - The Archived screen lists the Profile's archived sessions, including archived hidden Bot Chats, labeled as such, and Restore brings them back. - `/title ` renames the open Hermes chat, and #1036's hold for `/title` is removed. Duplicate and Move stay hidden until 2.3b and 2.4. "Export as HTML" and "Copy Deeplink" stay hidden on Hermes: the host has no HTML export, and Hermes deep links are #706. ## Contract Evidence is pinned to Hermex `490120d1` and hermes-agent `ca678285`. Unchanged since 0.21.4. **`PATCH /api/sessions/{id}`** with body `{title?, archived?, hidden?, pinned?, unread?, profile}`; `profile` goes in the body (`wr/sessions.py:751-790`, `web_models.py:258-265`). - `title` sets that exact id only (not the lineage), and `""` clears it. A 400 carries the host's message for: - a title already in use ("Title 'X' is already in use by session …", `hermes_state_titles.py:98-119`); - more than 100 characters; - renaming the hidden "Bot Chat" (`:89-95`). Titles are cleaned: control and bidi characters stripped, whitespace collapsed. - `pinned` and `archived` apply across the compression lineage (`hermes_state_sessions.py:869-976`). `pinned: true` also clears `hidden`. - Response: `{ok, title, : bool…}`. 404 if not found; 400 if no field is given. **Archived screen.** `GET /api/sessions?profile=

&archived=only&order=recent&limit=100&offset=&exclude_sources=…`. Under `archived=only` the hidden filter is off, so archived hidden Bot Chats are included (`hermes_state_sessions.py:1279-1284`). The pinned back-fill still appends non-archived pinned rows, so keep only `archived == true`. A Bot Chat row is `hidden == 1` with title "Bot Chat". **Rename an open chat.** `session.title {session_id: , title}` (`tg/methods_session.py:1074-1103`) sets the title and emits `session.info`. Errors: 4021 (empty), 4022 (uniqueness or length, with the host's message), 4001 (runtime reaped). **Delete.** `session.delete {session_id: , profile}` → `{deleted}` (`tg/methods_session.py:1033-1052`). - 4023 if a live runtime in this gateway process holds the session; runtimes in other processes are not checked. - `session.close {session_id: }` → `{closed}` ends our own runtime first (`:2010-2014`). - Deleting removes the row and its messages. Delegate children go with it; branch and compression children are detached (`hermes_state_sessions.py:1554-1588`). - Do **not** use REST `DELETE /api/sessions/{id}`: it has no live-runtime check, and an omitted Profile hits the launch Profile. **Export.** `GET /api/sessions/{id}/export?profile=

` streams `{…session row, messages:[…]}` for that exact id (`wr/sessions.py:797-829`). It is unredacted: the system prompt and host paths are included. ## Plan - [ ] **REST.** Extend 2.1's PATCH helper to `title`, `pinned` and `archived`. Add `export` and the archived-list variant of the list request. - [ ] **RPC.** Add `HermesCall` cases `sessionDelete(profile:storedKey:)`, `sessionClose(runtime:)` and `sessionRename(runtime:title:)` (`session.title` with a title). The Profile is non-optional, and admission refuses an empty key or title (`HermesCall.swift:377-444`). - [ ] **Row actions on Hermes.** Route `SessionListViewModel`'s rename, pin, archive, unarchive, delete and export through the Hermes backend. Show the host's 400 or 4022 message in the rename sheet (`SessionRenameSheet.swift`). Keep the "Archived · Undo" toast. Updates are optimistic with rollback, as on webui. - [ ] **Delete.** - If this phone holds a runtime for the session and it is idle, `session.close` it, then `session.delete`. - If it is busy, refuse: "Stop the reply first." - On 4023 (another app holds it), say it is open elsewhere and nothing was deleted. - The confirmation copy states that deleting can't be undone. - [ ] **Archived screen on Hermes.** `ArchivedSessionsView` gets the Hermes backend, and Settings shows its entry on Hermes servers (`SettingsView.swift:129`): paging as in 2.1, plus Restore and Delete. Label archived Bot Chats "Bot Chat · "; restoring one sends it back to the Bots inbox. - [ ] **Export.** "Export → JSON" downloads to a temp file named after the title and opens the share sheet, as webui does (`SessionListViewModel.swift:1112`). HTML and Copy Deeplink stay hidden on Hermes. - [ ] **`/title`.** In an open Hermes chat, `/title ` sends `session.title` on the chat's runtime and updates the nav title from `session.info`. Remove the `/title` hold #1036 added. - [ ] **Docs.** Add the row actions to `docs/agents/bots.md` § sessions list. ## Decisions Decided (Uzair, 2026-10-05): JSON export is in; HTML export is hidden on Hermes because the host has no route. Recommended: 1. **Rename from the list uses PATCH; `/title` in an open chat uses `session.title`,** so the live runtime and Desktop see the change at once. 2. **Delete uses the RPC path, never REST `DELETE`,** so an open runtime elsewhere blocks it (4023) instead of losing work. 3. **Archived Bot Chats are listed and labeled** on the Archived screen. It is the only place they can be restored from. ## Acceptance - [ ] Rename shows the host's message for a duplicate or too-long title and keeps the sheet open. - [ ] Pin and unpin move the row in and out of Pinned, on the phone and on Desktop. - [ ] Archive removes the row with an Undo toast. The Archived screen lists it, and Restore brings it back. - [ ] An archived Bot Chat appears in Archived, labeled, and Restore returns it to the Bots inbox. - [ ] Delete removes the session on the host. A session open in another app is refused with no change. A session busy on this phone asks you to stop first. - [ ] Export → JSON opens the share sheet with a JSON file. HTML and Copy Deeplink don't appear on Hermes. - [ ] `/title Foo` renames the open chat and the list row. - [ ] webui row actions are unchanged. ## Tests These fail today. - **`APIClientSessionMutationTests`, Hermes cases (URLProtocol):** PATCH bodies, including `profile` in the body; the 400 title message surfaced; the export request. - **New `HermesSessionActionsTests`, on the scripted gateway fixture:** - close-then-delete on our own idle runtime - busy refusal - 4023 handling with nothing changed - `session.title` with 4022 - archived list filtering, including a hidden Bot Chat and the dropped non-archived pin - optimistic rollback - **`SessionListMutationTests`:** the Hermes action policy, covering hidden Duplicate, Move, HTML and Deeplink. - **Run:** `scripts/test-sim --only HermesMobileTests/HermesSessionActionsTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientSessionMutationTests --only HermesMobileTests/SessionListMutationTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesSessionListTests --only HermesMobileTests/SlashCommandExecutorTests` ## Mocks Not required. The menus, sheet, toast and Archived screen are reused. The new copy is the delete refusals and the Bot Chat label. ## Manual test Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`, in a disposable session you create. 1. Rename it to an existing title. Expected: the host's message. Then rename it to something unique. Expected: the row and Desktop update. 2. Pin, unpin, archive, Undo, archive again, then restore from Archived. 3. Open the session on the host's dashboard chat, then delete it from the phone. Expected: refused. Close it there and delete again. Expected: it's gone. 4. Export → JSON and save to Files. ## Surfaces - **Entry points:** the row context menu, swipes, the Archived screen and `/title`. Settings → Archived Sessions is hidden on Hermes today (`Features/Settings/SettingsView.swift:129`). Lift that gate so it reaches the same Hermes screen. - **Targets:** main app and tests. - **Servers:** actions go to the row's own server and Profile. - **Reverse states:** pin ↔ unpin, archive ↔ restore (and Undo), rename again. Delete is confirmed and one-way. - **Native quality:** destructive roles on Delete, and VoiceOver labels as today. ## Preservation - #865: the archive Undo toast. - #17: the Archived screen also reachable from Settings. - Bot Chat's own pin and hide (`ui_meta` via `profiles.configure`) are untouched. This only restores archived Bot Chats. ## Blockers #1046 (2.1) and #1036 (`/title` is held there), both set as GitHub dependencies. ## Outside reach Deleting or renaming sessions on the live host is Uzair's call; tests use `scripts/local-hermes`. Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code (T3 Code).

title: feat(hermes): edit, regenerate, undo and retry in a Hermes session
body:
**What the user gets:** In a Hermes session, Edit Message and Regenerate Response work from a message's long-press menu, and `/undo` and `/retry` work, as on webui.
**Why it matters:** These actions are hidden on Hermes today (`offersHistoryActions` is false). Fixing a typo or asking again is a daily action, and Desktop offers it.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed.

Part of #702 (slice 2.3c) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1047 (2.2), #1036 · **Unblocks:** none

## Problem and outcome

- `ChatMessageActionContext.offersHistoryActions` is `hermesTurn == nil` (`ChatViewModel.swift:2013, 7075-7077`). So Regenerate Response, Edit Message and Fork From Here (`Chat/ChatMessageActions.swift:143-172`) never show on a Hermes chat.
- The webui paths are `editMessage` (`ChatViewModel.swift:4849`), `regenerateAssistantResponse` (`:4955`), `/undo` (`undoLastExchangeFromSlashCommand`, `:4484`) and `/retry` (`retryLastTurnFromSlashCommand`, `:4522`). They return "available for WebUI sessions only" on Hermes.
- `HermesCall.promptRewind(sessionID:text:beforeRowID:)` (`Networking/Hermes/HermesCall.swift:54, 287-291`) already sends a truncating `prompt.submit`. Only Bot Chat's failed-turn retry uses it (`Bots/BotConversation.swift:1106-1144`).
- #1036 holds `/undo` and `/retry` in Hermes chats with a notice naming #702.

After this, in a Hermes chat:
- **Edit Message** on a user row and **Regenerate Response** on an assistant row rewind the host's transcript at that user turn and resend in one call.
- **`/retry`** regenerates the last reply.
- **`/undo`** removes the last exchange.
- The transcript re-reads from 2.2's newest page.
- Fork From Here stays hidden until 2.3b.

## Contract

Evidence is pinned to Hermex `490120d1` and hermes-agent `ca678285`.

**Rewind and resend.** `prompt.submit {session_id: <runtime>, text, truncate_before_row_id, confirm_truncate: true, confirm_empty_truncate: true}` (`tg/methods_prompt.py:564-700`). It cuts before the row and starts the new turn under the history lock.
- The row id is the REST row `id` from 2.2.
- Errors:
  - 4009 when busy: a truncating submit is never queued (`:643-650`).
  - 4018 when the target is stale or not in the live tip, e.g. compacted away (`:288-290`).
  - 4028 when the cut empties the transcript without `confirm_empty_truncate`.
  - 4029 when `confirm_truncate` is missing.
  - 4030 when an ordinal and a row id disagree. Never send an ordinal.
  - 4004 for a bad value.
  - 5008 when the write fails.
- Result: `{status: "streaming", user_row_id?, survivor_user_row_ids | survivor_row_id_map}`. 2.2's page re-read makes the survivor ids unnecessary.
- Dropped rows are soft-archived (`active=0`). No client can see them afterwards, Desktop included, and no RPC restores them (`:384-414`).

**Undo.** `session.undo {session_id: <runtime>}` → `{removed}` (`tg/methods_session.py:1830-1848`). It needs a live runtime, which the open chat holds, and rewinds the last real user turn. Errors: 4009 (busy), 5008, 4001 (runtime reaped: reattach first).

**`/retry` and `/undo` from the composer.** The host routes them to `command.dispatch` (`_PENDING_INPUT_COMMANDS`, `tg/server.py:3281`). Its retry covers only the last turn, refuses attached media, and still needs a follow-up submit (`methods_tools.py:696-719`). Hermex uses the two calls above instead.

**`/skill` turns.** Over RPC the host re-expands a displayed `skill_invocation` on a truncating submit (`methods_prompt.py:615-619`). The slice verifies what the REST `content` of such a row holds (the invocation or the expanded body) and resends the invocation.

## Plan

- [ ] **Offer the actions.** `offersHistoryActions` becomes true on Hermes for Edit and Regenerate. Fork stays gated for 2.3b: split the flag or gate `.fork` separately. The actions are disabled while busy or showing cached data, as today.
- [ ] **Edit.** On Hermes, `editMessage` sends `promptRewind` at the user row's `rowID` with the edited text. Keep the existing confirmation ("Editing this message will discard N later messages", `ChatView.swift:3580`) and say that later messages are removed for every app.
- [ ] **Regenerate.** Regenerating an assistant row resends the text of the user row before it, at that user row's `rowID`.
- [ ] **`/retry`** regenerates the last assistant reply through the same path. **`/undo`** sends `session.undo`. Remove both holds that #1036 added.
- [ ] **Errors.**
  - 4009: "Wait for the current reply to finish."
  - 4018: "That message can't be changed any more" (Bot Chat's copy).
  - 5008: the host's message.
  - The draft is never lost: on failure, an edit returns to the composer.
- [ ] **Turns with attachments.** Hide Edit and Regenerate on user turns that carried attachments: a text-only resend would drop them.
- [ ] **After success.** The new turn streams as normal, and 2.2's newest-page re-read replaces the cut rows.
- [ ] **Docs.** Add the rewind rules to `docs/agents/bots.md` § sessions.

## Decisions

Recommended:
1. **One mechanism for edit and regenerate:** a truncating `prompt.submit` addressed by row id (Desktop does the same). `/undo` uses `session.undo`.
2. **Hide edit and regenerate on turns with attachments.** Re-attaching on a rewind is a later issue if anyone asks.
3. **Bot Chat is out of scope.** #745 (after 2.0) can reuse this path.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Long-pressing a Hermes user row offers Edit Message, and an assistant row offers Regenerate Response. Fork From Here is not offered yet.
- [ ] Editing the second of three prompts removes the later turns, sends the edit and streams a reply. Desktop shows the same transcript.
- [ ] Regenerate replaces the last reply.
- [ ] `/retry` and `/undo` work, and their holds are gone.
- [ ] Busy, stale-row and write failures show the copy above, and an edit's text is never lost.
- [ ] Turns with attachments don't offer Edit or Regenerate.
- [ ] webui edit, regenerate, undo and retry are unchanged.

## Tests

These fail today.
- **New `HermesHistoryRewindTests`, on the scripted gateway fixture:**
  - `promptRewind` addressed by the user row's `rowID`
  - regenerate picks the preceding user row
  - `session.undo`
  - the 4009, 4018 and 5008 copy
  - an edit restored to the composer on failure
  - attachment turns not offered
  - the page re-read after success
- **`SlashCommandExecutorTests`:** `/undo` and `/retry` on Hermes are routed, not held.
- **Unchanged and passing:** `BotConversationTests` (failed-turn retry), `ChatViewModelSendTests`.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesHistoryRewindTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesTranscriptPagingTests --only HermesMobileTests/SlashCommandExecutorTests --only HermesMobileTests/ChatViewModelSendTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotConversationTests`

## Mocks

Not required. The menus, sheet and confirmation are reused.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`, in a disposable session.
1. Send three prompts. Edit the second. Expected: the third turn is gone and the edit gets a reply.
2. Regenerate the last reply, then `/undo`. Expected: the last exchange is removed.
3. Open the session on the host's dashboard. Expected: the same transcript.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the message long-press menu, `/retry` and `/undo`. Bot Chat is untouched.
- **Targets:** main app and tests.
- **Reverse states:** none on the host. The cut is permanent, and the confirmation says so.
- **Native quality:** VoiceOver for the menu items as today.

## Preservation

- #508: never resend after a reconnect. A rewind is sent once and never retried automatically.
- #481 and #745 for Bot Chat: unchanged.

## Blockers

#1047 (2.2: row ids and the page re-read) and #1036 (holds `/undo` and `/retry`), both set as GitHub dependencies.

## Outside reach

None.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code (T3 Code).

title: feat(hermes): compress and clear a Hermes session
body:
**What the user gets:** In a Hermes session, `/compress` (or `/compact`, with an optional focus) shrinks the context and shows where it was compacted. `/clear` starts a fresh chat with the same Profile, model and working folder, and the old chat stays in the list.
**Why it matters:** Long agent sessions hit the context limit; compressing from the phone keeps them going. #1036 holds both commands until this lands.
**Cost:** Small to medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed.

Part of #702 (slice 2.3d) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1047 (2.2), #1036 · **Unblocks:** none

## Problem and outcome

- webui compress and clear are REST calls: `ChatViewModel.swift:4317` (compress) and `:4441` (clear). On Hermes, clear says "available for WebUI sessions only" (`:4419`).
- The webui clear asks for confirmation (`ClearConversationAlertModifier`, `ChatView.swift:3747-3760`) because it empties the chat.
- #1036 holds `/compress`, `/compact` and `/clear` in Hermes chats with a notice naming #702.

After this, in a Hermes chat:
- **`/compress [focus]`** and **`/compact`** compress through the host. The composer shows the existing "Compressing context..." state (`ChatComposerView.swift:1243`), the transcript re-reads 2.2's newest page with the compaction card, and the result line reports what was removed.
- **`/clear`** opens a new chat in place of this one, with the same Profile, the chat's current model and its working folder. There is no confirmation; the old chat is untouched and stays in the list.

## Contract

Evidence is pinned to Hermex `490120d1` and hermes-agent `ca678285`.

**Compress.** `session.compress {session_id: <runtime>, focus_topic?, profile}` (`tg/methods_session.py:1953-1976`).
- Result: `{status: "compressed"|"aborted", removed, before_messages, after_messages, before_tokens, after_tokens, summary, usage, info, messages}`.
- `{compressed: false, lock_held: true, message}` when another process holds the compression lock (`:1969-1972`).
- `{status: "pending", turn_isolation: true}` while the compute host is still running (`:1883-1888`).
- Errors: 4009 (busy), 5005 (failed), 4001 (runtime reaped).
- **Ids.** By default compaction is in place and the stored id doesn't change (`hermes_cli/config_defaults.py:658-663`). In legacy mode (`compression.in_place: false`), `session_key` re-points to a new stored id, carried in `info.stored_session_id` and the emitted `session.info` (`tg/session_compression.py:269-305`). Auto-compression mid-turn re-points it the same way (`tg/prompt_turn.py:749-755`).

**New chat with the same settings.**
- `session.create {profile, cwd?, model?, provider?, …}` (`tg/methods_session.py:334-433`). No DB row is written until the first prompt.
- The chat's current model and folder come from its `session.info` (`model`, `cwd`).

## Plan

- [ ] **RPC.** Add `HermesCall.sessionCompress(runtime:focus:profile:)` with the Profile non-optional.
- [ ] **`/compress` and `/compact`.** Route both on Hermes, and remove their #1036 holds.
  - Show the busy state.
  - On `compressed`, re-read the newest page (2.2) and post one note ("Compressed: N messages removed"), as webui does.
  - `aborted`, `lock_held` and `pending` each show the host's message or a plain "Already compressing; try again shortly."
  - On 4009: "Wait for the current reply to finish."
- [ ] **Id rotation.** When `session.info.stored_session_id` differs from the conversation's `storedKey`, adopt it as the new stored key and keep `root` (the list identity). This applies after a compress and after auto-compression mid-turn. Draft and list keys stay on `root`. Check `HermesConversation.identify` (`Features/Hermes/HermesConversation.swift:426-438`) and `storedKey`/`root` (`:158-167`).
- [ ] **`/clear`.** Remove its hold, and on Hermes open a new chat through `startHermesSession(in:replacing: true)` (`ChatView.swift:2854-2869`).
  - Carry the current model the way #1015's held pick does: the apply step after `session.create`.
  - Pass the current `cwd` to `session.create`: extend `ConversationTarget.new` or the coordinator's create with an optional `cwd`.
  - Skip `ClearConversationAlertModifier` on Hermes.
  - The composer's draft text, if any, stays with the old chat.
- [ ] **Docs.** Add compress and clear to `docs/agents/bots.md` § sessions.

## Decisions

Decided (Uzair, 2026-10-03): **Clear starts a new chat** with the same Profile, model and working folder. The old chat stays, untouched, so there's no confirmation.

Recommended:
1. **Adopt a rotated stored id but keep the root.** Legacy chains rotate; the default doesn't.
2. **Only the model and folder carry over,** as decided. Reasoning, personality and yolo start at the new chat's defaults.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `/compress` on a long Hermes session reports what was removed, and the transcript shows the compaction card with the earlier turns above it.
- [ ] `/compact focus on the API` sends the focus.
- [ ] Compressing during a reply is refused with the wait copy.
- [ ] On a host set to legacy rotation, the chat keeps sending after compress, and the list row stays one row.
- [ ] `/clear` opens an empty chat in the same Profile, model and folder. The old chat is still in the list with its full transcript.
- [ ] The compress, compact and clear holds are gone. webui compress and clear are unchanged.

## Tests

These fail today.
- **New `HermesCompressClearTests`, on the scripted gateway fixture:**
  - the compress params, with and without a focus
  - `compressed` triggers the page re-read and the note
  - the `aborted`, `lock_held`, `pending` and 4009 copy
  - a `stored_session_id` change adopts the stored key and keeps the root
  - `/clear` creates with the old chat's Profile, `cwd` and model, and leaves the old target unchanged
- **`SlashCommandExecutorTests`:** the three commands route on Hermes.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesCompressClearTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesConversationTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatSettingsTests --only HermesMobileTests/SlashCommandExecutorTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesTranscriptPagingTests`

## Mocks

Not required. This adds no new UI; the copy is short notes.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`, in a disposable session with some history.
1. `/compress`. Expected: a note and the compaction card. Scroll up to see the earlier turns.
2. Change the model in the composer, then `/clear`. Expected: a new empty chat on that model in the same folder. Back in the list, the old chat is still there.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the slash commands. The host's own auto-compression mid-turn is covered by the id-rotation rule.
- **Targets:** main app and tests.
- **Reverse states:** compression can't be undone on the host. Clear's way back is the old chat in the list.
- **Native quality:** no new animation.

## Preservation

- #1015 and #1016: the held-settings apply step.
- #1010: a new chat creates its session once.
- Bot Chat's own compression-tip handling (`BotProfile.canonicalTipID`) is unchanged.

## Blockers

#1047 (2.2: the compaction card and page re-read) and #1036 (holds the commands), both set as GitHub dependencies.

## Outside reach

None.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code (T3 Code).

title: feat(hermes): branch and duplicate a Hermes session
body:
**What the user gets:** In a Hermes session, Fork From Here (on a message) and `/branch` / `/fork` open a branch linked to the original. Duplicate in the Sessions list makes an independent full copy, tool output included. **Why it matters:** Trying an alternative without losing the original is a core agent workflow. Desktop branches, and webui users already duplicate and fork from the phone. **Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed. Part of #702 (slice 2.3b) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1047 (2.2), #1036 · **Unblocks:** none ## Problem and outcome - **Fork From Here** (`Chat/ChatMessageActions.swift:163-172`) is gated by `offersHistoryActions`, which is false on Hermes (`ChatViewModel.swift:2013`). The webui paths are `forkFromMessage` (`:4756`) and `branchSessionFromSlashCommand` (`:4233`). The "Forked from" row is `ForkOrigin` (`Chat/ForkOrigin.swift`, `ChatView.swift:332`). - **Duplicate** is `SessionListViewModel.duplicate` (`SessionListViewModel.swift:1062`) behind `SessionRowActionPolicy.canDuplicate` (`SessionListComponents.swift:907-915`). 2.1 hides it on Hermes. - #1036 holds `/branch` and `/fork` with a notice naming #702. After this, in a Hermes chat: - **Fork From Here** on a message, and `/branch [name]` / `/fork [name]` (the whole transcript), create a host branch and open it on top of the current chat. - A branch shows "Forked from ". - **Duplicate** on a Hermes list row makes an independent copy with every row and opens it. ## Contract Evidence is pinned to Hermex `490120d1` and hermes-agent `ca678285`. **Branch.** `session.branch {session_id: , name?, count?}` (`tg/methods_session.py:2077-2120`). - It needs a live runtime, which the open chat holds; otherwise 4001, so reattach first. - `count` keeps the first N rows of the host's visible history: user and assistant rows with non-empty text, from the display projection (`_visible_branch_history`, `:2017-2021`, `_branch_source_history` `:2051-2066`). - The copy keeps reasoning, `display_kind`, `display_metadata` and timestamps (`_BRANCH_COPY_FIELDS`, `:2042-2048`). It drops tool rows, as Desktop's branch does. - The default title is the parent's next lineage title (`_branch_title`, `:101-106`). - Result: `{session_id (new runtime), stored_session_id, title, parent, message_count, messages, info}`. Errors: 4008 (nothing to branch), 5008, 5000. - The branch lists as its own session with `parent_session_id` set (`hermes_state_common.py:209-210`). **Duplicate.** `session.branch_stored` is out, because the copy keeps only user and assistant text: no tool rows, reasoning or timestamps (`tg/methods_session.py:277-280, 2018-2022`). Per decision 4's fallback, use export → transform → import: - `GET /api/sessions/{id}/export?profile=

` returns `{…row, messages:[…]}`, for that exact id only (`wr/sessions.py:797-829`). - `POST /api/sessions/import {sessions:[…], profile}` (`wr/sessions.py:442-462`, `hermes_state_portability.py:576-620`): - It returns `{ok, imported, skipped, detached, imported_ids, skipped_ids, errors}`. - An existing id is skipped, not overwritten. - Validation is all-or-nothing (400). - Limits: a 25 MB body (413) and 10,000 messages per session. - A duplicate title fails the batch with a 500 (unique title index). - **Transform:** - A new id in the host's format, `YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_` (`hermes_state_ids.py:24-28`). - Drop `parent_session_id`, `_lineage_*`, `timings` and each message's `id`. - Set `title` to null, `archived` false and `pinned` false. - Then `PATCH /api/sessions/{newId} {title, profile}` with a unique title. - **Parent title for "Forked from".** `GET /api/sessions/{id}?profile=

` returns the raw row; flags are ints. ## Plan - [ ] **RPC and REST.** Add `HermesCall.sessionBranch(runtime:name:count:)`, and `HermesREST` `export`, `importSessions` and the single-row read. 2.3a may already add `export`; reuse it if so. - [ ] **Fork From Here.** Turn on `.fork` for Hermes. - `count` = the number of 2.2 REST rows up to and including the chosen message that are user or assistant with non-empty text. Exclude `hidden` and compacted rows, to match the host's display projection. - Verify against `scripts/local-hermes` that the branch ends at the chosen message, including after a tool-heavy turn. If it doesn't, stop and report before shipping a heuristic. - Open the branch as `.session(profile, key: stored_session_id)` on top of this chat. - [ ] **`/branch [name]` and `/fork [name]`** branch the whole transcript (no `count`) with the name. Remove their #1036 holds. - [ ] **"Forked from".** A Hermes session with `parent_session_id` shows `ForkOrigin` with the parent's title from the single-row read. Tapping it opens the parent. - [ ] **Duplicate.** Turn on `canDuplicate` for Hermes rows. - Run export → transform → import → PATCH title. - The title is " (copy)", adding " 2", " 3", … on the host's in-use 400. - Then open the copy. - A 413, or a session over the limits, shows "Too large to duplicate". A failed PATCH leaves the copy untitled, never half-imported. - [ ] **Docs.** Add branch and duplicate to `docs/agents/bots.md` § sessions. ## Decisions Decided (Uzair, 2026-10-03 and 2026-10-05): **Duplicate is export → import**, because `session.branch_stored` loses tool output (decision 4's fallback). **Branch stays `session.branch`**, which drops tool rows the same way Desktop does. Recommended: 1. **Fork From Here counts the host's visible rows** and is verified against `scripts/local-hermes` before it ships. 2. **Duplicate titles are "<title> (copy)" with a numeric suffix.** 3. **A copy sorts by its messages' timestamps** (`last_active` is message-derived), so it opens right away rather than relying on list position. ## Acceptance - [ ] Fork From Here on the second assistant reply opens a branch ending at that reply, and its "Forked from" row opens the original. - [ ] `/branch Experiment` opens a whole-transcript branch titled "Experiment". Both the original and the branch appear in the list. - [ ] Duplicate opens a copy whose tool calls still show their output. The original is unchanged, and the copy has no parent link. - [ ] Duplicating twice gives "(copy)" and "(copy 2)". - [ ] A session too large to import is refused with the copy above, and nothing is left behind. - [ ] The `/branch` and `/fork` holds are gone. webui fork and duplicate are unchanged. ## Tests These fail today. - **New `HermesBranchDuplicateTests`:** - `count` from REST rows, skipping tool, hidden, compacted and empty rows - `/branch` with a name and no count - the 4008 copy - the export transform: new id format, parent dropped, message ids dropped, title nulled - the import result handling, including `skipped` and the 413 - the title retry on 400 - `ForkOrigin` from `parent_session_id` - **`APIClientSessionExportTests` and `APIClientSessionMutationTests`:** Hermes request shapes. - **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesBranchDuplicateTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientSessionExportTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientSessionMutationTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesTranscriptPagingTests --only HermesMobileTests/SlashCommandExecutorTests` ## Mocks Not required. The menus, the "Forked from" row and the open-on-top navigation are reused. ## Manual test Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`, in a disposable session with a tool call. 1. Fork From Here on the first reply. Expected: a branch with one exchange and "Forked from". 2. `/branch Try B`. Expected: a full branch named "Try B". 3. Duplicate the original from the list. Expected: a copy whose tool output still shows. Delete the copies afterwards. ## Surfaces - **Entry points:** the message menu, the slash commands and the list row menu. - **Targets:** main app and tests. - **Reverse states:** branches and copies are ordinary sessions, deleted through 2.3a. The "Forked from" row leads back to the parent. - **Native quality:** VoiceOver for the "Forked from" row as today. ## Preservation - #873: the "Forked from" row. - #1010: a new runtime per opened session. - Bot Chat has no branch action (#745 is after 2.0). ## Blockers #1047 (2.2: row identity for Fork From Here) and #1036 (holds `/branch` and `/fork`), both set as GitHub dependencies. ## Outside reach Branching or duplicating on the maintainer's live host is a mutation and stays Uzair's call; verification uses `scripts/local-hermes`. Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code (T3 Code).

title: feat(hermes): projects as folder lanes on Hermes
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, the Sessions list shows projects as folder lanes, the same projects Desktop shows. Users can create, rename and delete them, and Move to Project changes a session's working folder.
**Why it matters:** On Hermes a project is a set of folders, and a session belongs to the project whose folder it works in. Without this, Hermes users can't group or find work by project from the phone. It also resolves the model behind #279 and #212.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed.

Part of #702 (slice 2.4) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1046 (2.1) · **Unblocks:** none

## Problem and outcome

webui projects are tags:
- `ProjectSummary {projectId, name, color}` (`Models/Session.swift:100-123`) and `SessionSummary.projectId` (`:204`).
- `APIClient+Projects.swift:4-29` reads `/api/projects*`.
- The list filters on `projectId` (`SessionListViewModel.swift:233-236`). Project rows are `ProjectFilterRow` / `SessionSidebarUtilityRows` (`SessionListComponents.swift:240-260, 435-460, 1401-1460`). Moving is `SessionProjectMoveMenu` (`:991-1050`).
- The sheets are `ProjectCreationSheet` / `ProjectRenameSheet` (`ProjectCreationSheet.swift:3-81`), and the view-model methods are at `SessionListViewModel.swift:1155-1355`.

On Hermes, project tags are dropped (epic decision 10). A session's project is derived from its folder. After this, on a Hermes list:
- The project rows list the host's projects, including the automatic per-repository ones.
- Selecting one shows its sessions, with the same rows and flags as 2.1.
- "New Project…" takes a name, a color and a folder. Rename and Delete work.
- A row's **Move to Project** changes that session's working folder to the project's primary folder, with copy that says Hermes works there from now on and that files are not moved. An Undo toast moves it back.

## Contract

Evidence is pinned to Hermex `490120d1` and hermes-agent `ca678285`. Every `projects.*` method is unchanged since 0.21.4.

**Storage and membership.**
- Projects live per Profile in `$HERMES_HOME/projects.db` (`hermes_cli/projects_db.py:23-67`).
- Membership is derived, never stored: a session belongs to the project with the longest folder that is an ancestor of its `cwd` or `git_repo_root` (`tg/project_tree.py:311-342`).
- Unclaimed sessions fall into automatic per-repository projects (`isAuto`) and a "No project" bucket (`isNoProject`) (`:369-498`).

**`projects.tree {profile, preview_limit?, session_limit?}`** (`tg/methods_config.py:85-97`) returns `{projects:[node], active_id, scoped_session_ids}`.
- A node is `{id, label, path, color, icon, isAuto, isNoProject, sessionCount, lastActive, repos, previewSessions, sessionIds}` (`project_tree.py:345-366`). `sessionIds` is every claimed row.
- Inputs: `min_messages=1`, not archived, not hidden, and excluding `cron`, `kanban` and `oneshot`.

**Methods** (`tg/methods_projects.py`). Errors: 5061 (generic), 5062 (no such project), 5063 (bad argument).
- `projects.list {profile}` → `{projects:[ProjectInfo], active_id}`, archived included.
- `ProjectInfo` is `{id ("p_<hex>"), slug, name, description, icon, color, board_slug, primary_path, archived, created_at, folders:[{path, label, is_primary, added_at}]}` (`projects_db.py:148-175`).
- `projects.create {profile, name, folders:[path], primary_path, color?}` → `{project}`. A duplicate primary path or a bad slug gives 5063 (`:91-99`, `projects_db.py:220-256`).
- `projects.update {profile, id, name?, color?}`; `""` clears the color (`projects_db.py:273-295`).
- `projects.delete {profile, id}` → `{projects, active_id}`. It is a hard delete, and sessions are untouched. `active_id` can keep pointing at the deleted id (`projects_db.py:370-400`), so ignore `active_id`.

**Move.** `session.workspace.move {session_key: <stored id>, cwd, profile}` → `{cwd, branch, git_repo_root}` (`tg/methods_session.py:965-1001`).
- It works on an idle stored session with no runtime. A live runtime moves too, even mid-turn, and emits `session.info`.
- It updates that exact id only and replaces the git branch and repository root (`hermes_state_sessions.py:526-556`).
- Errors: 4007 (not found), 4016 (no cwd), 4017 (the folder doesn't exist), 5007.

**Folder entry.** `HermesCall.completePath` already completes host paths.

## Plan

- [ ] **RPC.** Add `HermesCall` cases `projectsTree`, `projectsList`, `projectsCreate`, `projectsUpdate`, `projectsDelete` and `sessionWorkspaceMove`, each with the Profile non-optional. Admission refuses an empty name, folder or key.
- [ ] **Lanes.** On Hermes, the project rows come from `projects.tree`: user projects first, then automatic repositories. Skip `isNoProject`.
  - Selecting a project filters 2.1's rows to the node's `sessionIds`. Paging continues until the lane holds `sessionCount` rows or the list ends.
  - Reload the tree with the list on `sessions.changed`.
- [ ] **Create, rename, delete.**
  - `ProjectCreationSheet` on Hermes adds a required folder field with host path completion. It is prefilled with the session's `cwd` when opened from a row's Move menu.
  - Rename and color use `projects.update`.
  - Delete confirms with "Sessions stay; only the project is removed." Automatic projects offer neither rename nor delete.
- [ ] **Move to Project.** `SessionProjectMoveMenu` on Hermes lists user projects. A pick sends `session.workspace.move` to the project's `primary_path`, after copy along the lines of "Hermes will work in <folder> from now on. Files aren't moved."
  - An "Moved · Undo" toast moves the session back to its previous `cwd`.
  - A busy session is allowed (the host moves it mid-turn), but the copy says so.
  - "Remove from Project" is not offered on Hermes; a folder has no "none".
- [ ] **Docs.** Add a projects section to `docs/agents/bots.md`. Note in `CONTEXT.md` that a Hermes project is folder-based.

## Decisions

Decided:
- Tags are dropped and projects are folder lanes (epic decision 10, 2026-09-26).
- Move changes the working folder with consequence copy (Uzair, 2026-10-03).

Recommended:
1. **Lanes include the automatic per-repository projects,** as Desktop does. "No project" is just the unfiltered list.
2. **A lane is the REST list filtered by `sessionIds`,** so rows keep pinned and unread. `projects.project_sessions` rows lack those flags.
3. **Undo restores the previous folder.** It replaces "Remove from Project".
4. **Archive project (`projects.archive`) is out.** Delete is enough, because sessions survive it.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The project rows match Desktop's for the Profile, including automatic repositories.
- [ ] Selecting a project lists exactly its sessions, paging in older ones.
- [ ] Creating a project with a folder shows it with its matching sessions. A duplicate folder shows the host's error.
- [ ] Rename, recolor and delete work. After delete, the sessions are still in the list.
- [ ] Move to Project shows the consequence copy, then the session appears in the target lane. Desktop shows it there, with the new folder in its `session.info`. Undo moves it back.
- [ ] Moving an idle session with no runtime works.
- [ ] webui projects are unchanged.

## Tests

These fail today.
- **New `HermesProjectsTests`, on the scripted gateway fixture:**
  - tree parsing: user, automatic and no-project nodes
  - lane filtering by `sessionIds` across pages
  - create params with a folder, and the 5063 copy
  - update and delete
  - `active_id` ignored
  - move params and the 4017 copy
  - Undo to the previous `cwd`
- **`SessionListMutationTests`:** the Hermes project-menu policy (no Remove; automatic projects are read-only).
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesProjectsTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesSessionListTests --only HermesMobileTests/SessionListMutationTests`

## Mocks

Not required. The rows, menus and sheets are reused. The one new field is the folder in the existing create sheet. If the sheet needs more than a path field with completion, stop and ask for a mock.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`, with two folders on this Mac.
1. Create project A on folder 1. Expected: it lists the sessions working in folder 1.
2. Move a session from another folder into A. Expected: the copy, then the session in A's lane. Undo returns it.
3. Delete A. Expected: the sessions are still in the list.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the list's project rows, the row's Move menu, and the create, rename and delete sheets. The workspace browser (#703) reads the new `cwd`.
- **Targets:** main app and tests.
- **Servers:** projects are per Profile and per server.
- **Reverse states:** move ↔ Undo; create ↔ delete; rename again.
- **Native quality:** VoiceOver on lane rows and the folder field; Dynamic Type in the sheet.

## Preservation

- #212 and #279: the folder model.
- webui tag projects are unchanged.
- #703 builds its file browser on the session folder this changes.

## Blockers

#1046 (2.1), set as a GitHub dependency.

## Outside reach

Creating projects or moving sessions on the live host is Uzair's call.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code (T3 Code).

title: feat(hermes): search Hermes sessions
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, searching the Sessions list finds sessions by title, id and message content, with highlighted snippets. Archived results are labeled, and a Bot Chat result opens that bot. `/sessions` and `/resume [name]` work from a Hermes chat. **Why it matters:** webui users search every day, and a long Hermes history is unusable without it. #1036 holds `/resume` and `/sessions` until this lands. **Cost:** Small to medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed. Part of #702 (slice 2.5) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1046 (2.1), #1036 · **Unblocks:** none ## Problem and outcome - webui search filters loaded rows locally and merges a debounced remote content search (`SessionListViewModel.searchSessions`, `SessionListViewModel.swift:451-505`, merge `:248-261`). Snippets come from `SessionSearchExcerpt` (`SessionSearchExcerpt.swift`). The endpoint is `.sessionsSearch` (`Endpoints.swift:9, 422`). - 2.1's Hermes list filters only the rows it has loaded. - #1036 holds `/resume` and `/sessions` in Hermes chats with a notice naming #702. After this, on a Hermes list: - Typing a query filters the loaded rows at once, then merges the host's search results with snippets. - Archived results show an "Archived" label. A hidden Bot Chat shows "Bot Chat" and opens that bot's chat. - In a Hermes chat: - `/sessions` and a bare `/resume` open the Sessions list. - `/resume ` opens the session titled exactly ``, or opens the list searching for it. ## Contract Evidence is pinned to Hermex `490120d1` and hermes-agent `ca678285`. Unchanged since 0.21.4. **`GET /api/sessions/search?q=&profile=

&limit=&exclude_sources=cron,kanban,oneshot,subagent,tool`** (`wr/sessions.py:278-421`). - An empty `q` returns `{results: []}`. `limit` is capped at 100 (default 20). - Id matches come first, then FTS5 content hits. Each token is prefix-wildcarded ("nimb" matches "nimb*"), and quoted phrases are kept. - Results are deduped by compression lineage. Branches stay separate. - Each result has: - `snippet` (FTS `snippet()` with `>>>`/`<<<` around matches and `...` elisions, `hermes_state_search.py:913`; or the preview for id hits), `role`; - `session_id` (lineage tip), `id`, `lineage_root`, `profile`; - `title`, `preview`, `last_active` (null on content hits; fall back to `session_started`), `started_at`, `message_count`, `parent_session_id`, `archived`, `source`, `model`. - Archived and hidden rows are included. The payload has `archived` but no `hidden` field. The hidden canonical chat is always titled "Bot Chat", and renaming it is refused (`hermes_state_titles.py:89-95`). - Errors: 500 "Search failed". ## Plan - [ ] **REST.** Add a `HermesREST` search request with the Profile non-optional and the same `exclude_sources` as 2.1. - [ ] **Search on Hermes.** - `searchSessions` uses the Hermes backend: the same debounce and local-first filter, then results merged by lineage root into the visible rows. - Results not in the loaded pages become rows from the result fields. - Convert `>>>`/`<<<` snippets into `SessionSearchExcerpt` highlights, never showing the markers. - Use `last_active ?? session_started` for recency. - [ ] **Labels.** - `archived == true` shows "Archived"; opening it works, and restore is 2.3a's. - `title == "Bot Chat"` with the row's `profile` shows "Bot Chat · " and opens that bot's chat through the existing bot destination (`ContentView` `pendingBotDestination`) instead of a session view. - [ ] **`/sessions` and `/resume`.** Remove their #1036 holds. - `/sessions` and a bare `/resume` pop to (or push) the Hermes Sessions list. - `/resume ` searches. It opens the single result whose `title` equals `` case-insensitively; otherwise it opens the list with `` in the search field. - [ ] **Docs.** Add search to `docs/agents/bots.md` § sessions list. ## Decisions Decided (Uzair, 2026-10-05): search is in #702, as its own slice. Hidden and archived results are labeled. Recommended: 1. **Bot Chat results open the Bot.** Opening a Bot Chat as an ordinary session would put one chat on two surfaces with two unread models. 2. **`/resume ` needs an exact title match** to jump straight to a session. Anything else lands on the search, so it never opens the wrong chat. ## Acceptance - [ ] Searching a word that only appears in an old message finds that session, with the word highlighted and no `>>>` markers. - [ ] Pasting a session id finds it first. - [ ] Archived results are labeled. A Bot Chat result opens the bot's chat. - [ ] Clearing the search restores the list. - [ ] `/sessions` opens the list. `/resume Exact Title` opens that session, and `/resume partial` opens the list searching "partial". - [ ] webui search is unchanged. ## Tests These fail today. - **New `HermesSessionSearchTests`:** - the exact query - marker-to-highlight conversion - merge by lineage root with loaded rows - the archived and Bot Chat labels and routing - `last_active` fallback - `/resume` exact versus partial - **`SessionSearchExcerptTests`:** Hermes snippets. - **`SlashCommandExecutorTests`:** `/sessions` and `/resume` route on Hermes. - **Run:** `scripts/test-sim --only HermesMobileTests/HermesSessionSearchTests --only HermesMobileTests/SessionSearchExcerptTests --only HermesMobileTests/SlashCommandExecutorTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesSessionListTests` ## Mocks Not required. Search for a word from an old message. Expected: that session, highlighted. 2. Search "Bot Chat". Expected: labeled bot chats that open in Bots. 3. In a chat, `/resume `, then `/sessions`. ## Surfaces - **Entry points:** the list search field and the two slash commands. - **Targets:** main app and tests. - **Servers:** search is per server and per selected Profile. - **Native quality:** VoiceOver reads the highlighted excerpt as plain text, as today. ## Preservation - The webui search debounce and excerpt rules are unchanged. - #709's filter button may later add "All Profiles" to search. ## Blockers #1046 (2.1) and #1036 (holds `/resume` and `/sessions`), both set as GitHub dependencies. ## Outside reach None. title: feat(hermes): offline cache for Hermes sessions
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, the Sessions list and recently opened transcripts are still there, read-only, when the host is unreachable: on a plane, with the Mac asleep, or while the tunnel is down.
**Why it matters:** webui users have had an offline cache for a long time. Without it, a Hermes server shows an empty list the moment the connection drops, which reads as data loss.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed.

Part of #702 (slice 2.1b) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1046 (2.1), #1047 (2.2) · **Unblocks:** none

## Problem and outcome

webui caches through `CacheStore` (`Persistence/CacheStore.swift`):
- `CachedSession.cacheKey` is `"<server>|session|<id>"` (`CachedSession.swift:59-61`).
- `CachedMessage.cacheKey` is `"<server>|session|<id>|message|<messageId or sortIndex-timestamp>"` (`CachedMessage.swift:50-58`).
- `cacheSessions` upserts, then **deletes every cached row for the server that is missing from the response** (`CacheStore.swift:83-131`). `cacheMessages` upserts a window, then **deletes the session's cached messages outside it** (`:162-223`).
- Both sweeps assume one complete response, which a paged Hermes list never is.
- `CachedMessage` has no `rowID` or `displayMetadata`.
- The fallback rules are `CacheFallbackPolicy` (`Networking/CacheFallbackPolicy.swift`). Clearing is server-scoped (`clearCache(for:)`, `:231-253`), with a 7-day TTL and a 5,000-message cap (`CachedSession.swift:4-10`).

No Hermes chat or list touches `CacheStore`: Hermes takes a separate path at `ChatViewModel.swift:1577`.

After this:
- Every Hermes list page (2.1) and transcript page (2.2) is upserted into the cache, keyed by server, Profile and the session's lineage root.
- When the host can't be reached, the Hermes list and an opened session show the cached copy, read-only, with the existing cached-data state.
- Nothing is swept because a page was partial.

## Contract

Nothing new on the wire. The cache stores what 2.1 and 2.2 already read:
- List rows (identity `_lineage_root_id ?? id`, Profile from the row).
- `/messages` rows (row `id`, `display_kind`, `display_metadata`).

## Plan

- [ ] **Keys.**
  - Sessions use `"<server>|hermes|<profile>|<lineage root>"`.
  - Messages use `"<server>|hermes|<profile>|<lineage root>|row|<row id>"`.
  - webui keys are unchanged. Store the current `id` (the tip) on the row so a cached open resumes the right key.
- [ ] **Model fields.** Add optional `rowID` and `displayMetadata` to `CachedMessage`, and optional `lineageRoot` and `unread` to `CachedSession`. Optional additions keep SwiftData's lightweight migration; confirm that an upgrade over an existing store opens.
- [ ] **Per-page upsert.**
  - Add Hermes write paths: `cacheHermesSessions(page:)` and `cacheHermesMessages(page:)`. They upsert only and never sweep.
  - A cached session is removed only when:
    - this phone deleted or archived it (2.3a);
    - a walk reached the end of the list (a short page) without seeing it;
    - or the TTL expired.
  - A cached message is removed only when a newest-page read no longer holds it inside that page's row-id range (a rewind or undo, 2.3c), or by the TTL or the cap.
- [ ] **Read paths.**
  - On a Hermes list load failure that `CacheFallbackPolicy` treats as offline, show cached rows for the selected Profile, sorted as 2.1 sorts, with the cached-data banner.
  - Opening a Hermes session offline shows its cached rows, read-only: the composer and history actions are disabled through `isViewingCachedData`, as on webui.
- [ ] **Clearing.** Sign-out and server removal already clear by server. Confirm that Hermes rows match that prefix, and add a test.
- [ ] **Docs.** Add a Hermes cache row (keys and the no-sweep rule) to `docs/agents/multi-server-state-isolation.md`.

## Decisions

Recommended (no product question):
1. **Keys include the Profile.** Each Profile has its own `state.db`, so the same id in two Profiles can't collide.
2. **No sweep on partial pages.** Removal follows the rules above, so a half-loaded list never erases the cache.
3. **Cached data is read-only,** as on webui. Nothing is queued to send later.

## Acceptance

- [ ] With the host reachable, browsing pages the list into the cache.
- [ ] With the host unreachable, the list shows cached sessions with the cached-data state, and opening one shows its cached transcript, read-only.
- [ ] Reconnecting replaces the cached view with live data, with no duplicate rows.
- [ ] Loading page 1 only never removes cached sessions from later pages.
- [ ] Deleting or archiving on the phone removes the cached row.
- [ ] Two Hermes servers and a webui server never show each other's cache. Sign-out clears the server's Hermes rows.
- [ ] Upgrading over an existing cache store opens without data loss.

## Tests

These fail today.
- **`CacheStoreTests`:**
  - Hermes keys, including the lineage root and Profile
  - per-page upsert with no sweep
  - end-of-list removal
  - deletion removal
  - the message range rule after a rewind
  - server-scoped clear
  - the TTL and cap still applied
- **`CacheFallbackPolicyTests`:** Hermes offline classification.
- **New `HermesOfflineCacheTests`:** offline list and transcript reads; read-only actions.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/CacheStoreTests --only HermesMobileTests/CacheFallbackPolicyTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesOfflineCacheTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesSessionListTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesTranscriptPagingTests`

## Mocks

Not required. This reuses the existing cached-data banner and read-only state.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`.
1. Open the list and two sessions, then stop `scripts/local-hermes` (the process you started).
2. Reopen the list and one of the sessions. Expected: the cached copies, read-only.
3. Restart the host. Expected: live data returns without duplicates.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the Hermes list and every Hermes session open.
- **Targets:** main app and tests. Extensions don't read the cache.
- **Servers:** keys carry the server and Profile.
- **Connection modes:** the tunnel's idle closes and Mac sleep both land on the cached view.

## Preservation

- webui caching and its sweep are unchanged.
- #508: cached data never triggers a send.

## Blockers

#1046 (2.1) and #1047 (2.2), set as GitHub dependencies.

## Outside reach

None.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code (T3 Code).

title: feat(hermes): slash commands and autocomplete in Hermes chats
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1036 · Fixes #1025

## What changed

In a Hermes chat the `/` panel was hidden, and every command except `/goal`, `/btw`, `/bg` and `/model` reached the model as plain text.

Now `/` lists the host's `commands.catalog` (built-ins such as `/context`, quick commands, plugin commands, skills), and aliases find their command (`/ctx` → `/context`). On send, `HermesSlashCommands.route` decides in this order:

1. **Hermex's own** commands keep their native path: `/new` (a new chat in the Profile), `/stop`, `/model`, `/reasoning`, `/personality`, `/goal`, `/btw`, `/bg`, and `/yolo` (`config.set yolo`).
2. **Held** commands that rewrite history show a #702 notice.
3. **Skills** expand through `command.dispatch`.
4. **Any other catalog name** runs once through `slash.exec`. Its output is a notice in a code block, so line breaks survive. `send`/`skill` go through the normal send path (queued mid-turn), `prefill` fills the draft, and `alias` runs once.
5. **Unknown names** are sent as text.

A host command's argument asks `complete.slash` (150 ms debounce, newest reply only). `slash.exec` waits twice the RPC deadline (above the host's 45 s worker limit), and its timeout fails only that command, not the chat's connection. A refusal shows the host's message and keeps the draft; in a chat with nothing sent yet it says "Send a message first, then run /<name>." (decided on the issue). webui chats are unchanged.

`docs/agents/bots.md` § Slash suggestions is rewritten. There are 11 new strings in all 17 languages.

## How it was tested

- Contract recorded from `scripts/local-hermes` at the pin (`ca678285`, 0.21.5), with a quick command and a local skill configured: `commands.catalog` with and without `session_id`, `complete.slash` for `/personality ` and `/approvals `, and `slash.exec` for `/context`, `/help`, `/queue hi` (`send`), `/steer` (4004), the quick command and a skill (4018). The replies the tests use are in `Fixtures/HermesAgent/slash-commands.json`.
- `scripts/test-sim <iPhone 17e> --only` HermesSlashCommandTests, HermesRequestTests, SlashCommandTests, SlashCommandExecutorTests, ComposerSlashTriggerTests, HermesChatSideTaskTests, HermesChatSettingsTests, HermesChatTurnTests, HermesChatAttachmentTests, HermesGatewayTests, LocalizationCatalogTests, ChatViewModelSendTests: **448 passed**.
- `ci/check_string_catalog.py`: all keys covered.
- Two existing assertions changed, both expected: the `/personality` list now sends `session_id`, and attach adds one `commands.catalog` read.
- Not covered by tests: the 30 s+ command timeout (gateway policy only). Screenshots come with the owner's simulator pass.

title: feat(hermes): Kanban boards and Cards on Hermes, read-only
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1043 · Part of #704 (slice 4.2a)

## What changed

On a Hermes server Kanban could not be opened: the code expected webui's client, stream, `config.columns`, `changed` and `read_only`, understood only `APIError`, and knew seven Statuses. Card `age` arrives as a dict on both backends, so staleness badges never showed.

- **Client.** New REST-only `HermesKanbanClient` on the shared `HermesConnection` (headers follow #898) reads config, boards, board, stats, assignees, Card detail and the worker log. It drops host paths and PIDs (`workspace_path`, `stored_path`, log `path`, `db_path`, `default_workdir`, `worker_pid`, `claim_lock`) before decoding, marks every reply read-only (#1044 lifts this), and filters by Assigned Profile on the client. A 404 on `/config` is "Kanban isn't available on this server."
- **Handshake and errors.** `KanbanDataClient.backend` picks the Hermes path: Columns come from the Board in host order, no `changed` needed, unknown Statuses still flag. `BotFailure` and `URLError` map to offline, server unavailable, today's sign-in copy, or unavailable; Hermes sign-out stays with the connection.
- **Statuses.** Scheduled (indigo) and Review (yellow) join the Status set. The Status bar follows the Board's Columns, so webui keeps its six plus Archived.
- **Age.** `age`/`age_seconds` decode as the dict (number fallback); this fixes webui's badges too.
- **No live updates on Hermes** (#1045): pull to refresh and a foreground return reload the Board, including a return while a Card covers it.
- **Entry.** "Kanban" in the Hermes inbox + menu, DEBUG and Hermex Branch only ([decision](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1043#issuecomment-6007532431)). The Board preference stays per server.
- Docs: `CONTEXT.md`, `docs/agents/kanban.md` § Hermes, the isolation table. Four strings in all 17 languages.

title: feat(hermes): manage Tasks on a Hermes server
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1040

## What changed

On a Hermes server, Tasks couldn't be reached: every Tasks view model called webui's `APIClient` (`/api/crons/*`), and the only way in was the webui session list's sidebar.

- **Seam.** New `CronDataClient` protocol (in `APIClient+Cron.swift`) covers what the Tasks screens call, plus `cronFeatures` (what a server supports). `APIClient` conforms by forwarding, so webui is unchanged. The three Tasks view models take `any CronDataClient`.
- **Hermes client.** New REST-only `HermesCronClient` sends through the shared `HermesConnection`, so custom headers (#898), cookies and re-sign-in come from there. It adds `HermesREST` cases for list, create, `PUT {updates}`, pause, resume, delete, delivery targets and skills. Every mutation names the job's own `?profile=`, and an update never sends the job's id or Profile. A 424 counts as saved: the list reloads and a "Saved" alert shows the host's warning. A 4xx shows the host's `detail`. A 403, 502-504 or 520-530 gets the Hermes proxy or tunnel copy. Editor models (`model.options {profile}`) and `profiles.list` go over the gateway. `hermes_home` is never decoded.
- **Derived state.** A job is running when it has a `fire_claim` or its `latest_execution` is `claimed`/`running`. Recent runs come from `last_run_at` and `last_status`. Task Detail's Refresh re-reads the list and updates the job's row. It ignores a reply that a Pause, Resume, edit or delete finished during.
- **UI.** Each row shows its Profile label (with a VoiceOver label). One scheduler notice appears when any enabled Task's `scheduler_heartbeat_age_s` is over 180 s. In the editor, pickers follow the Task's Profile. Picking another Profile drops the targets and skills you chose earlier that it doesn't offer. The Profile is locked while editing. Toast Notifications, Run Now and run history are hidden on Hermes.
- **Entry.** A temporary **Tasks** item in the Hermes inbox's + menu, behind the `HermesSessionEntry` gate (DEBUG/Branch). A new Task starts in the selected Profile (#1015), which is never written to the host.
- **Docs.** `docs/agents/bots.md` gains "Tasks on a Hermes host".

Applies the [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1040#issuecomment-6007531831) (decisions 1-4, Preserve #898 and #1015). Contract checked against `scripts/local-hermes` (0.21.5, ca678285): list, create, PUT, pause, resume, delete, 400/404 `{detail}`, delivery targets and skills.

## How it was tested

- `git diff --check` is clean. `ci/check_string_catalog.py` covers all 2222 keys.
- `scripts/test-sim <udid>` with `--only`: 83 passed on e90cb6d9 (HermesCronClientTests, CronManagementViewModelTests, CronManagementModelTests, CronJobEditorConfigurationTests, CronJobSkillsPickerTests, TaskRunHistoryTests, TaskConfigurationFieldTests, LocalizationCatalogTests). On the final head 87d7a7bf, the first five of those passed 58. Before the review fix, 14 Tasks and Hermes classes (including HermesRequestTests, HermesConnectionTests, HermesGatewayTests and APIClientCronEndpointTests) passed 165 tests.

- Red: the review-fix tests failed on the code before each fix. A 404 read "…points to a Hermes Web UI server", the detail went back to `scheduled` after a Pause, and the list got no re-read job. The other new tests use API that doesn't exist on master, so they can't compile there.

Device: iPhone simulator
1. [A Hermes server with two Profiles, plus a webui server] On the Hermes home, tap + → Tasks. Expected: every Profile's Tasks are listed, each with its Profile under the name, and there is no Run Now. Check whether the large "Tasks" title draws blurred under the filter bar, then open webui Tasks from the session list sidebar: if that blurs too, the issue was already there.

title: feat(hermes): live Kanban updates on Hermes
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1045 · Part of #704 (slice 4.3). Stacked on #1056; merge after it.

## What changed

A Hermes Board refreshed only on pull or foreground. The host's live channel is a ticketed WebSocket that sends nothing on a quiet Board, and a loopback-bound (tunneled) dashboard sends no protocol pings, so Cloudflare would close it at about 100 s.

- **Protocol.** `KanbanEventStreamingClient.start(board:since:onFrame:onFailure:)` replaces the URL start (webui's SSE client builds the same URL itself). `KanbanDataClient.makeEventStream(server:)` picks SSE for webui and the new `KanbanWebSocketEventClient` for Hermes.
- **Socket.** `/api/plugins/kanban/events?board=&since=&ticket=` on a fresh ticket per connect through `HermesConnection.kanbanEventsUpgrade`, never the gateway's (#775, #825). Saved headers go on the upgrade, same-origin only (#898). No subprotocol. The first pong or frame reports `.opened`. It pings every 25 s, and a ping unanswered by the next one ends the socket. A 403 upgrade tries one fresh ticket. Frames decode as `{events, cursor}`; unknown keys and keyless objects are ignored.
- **Feature state.** Hermes streaming is on. Reconnects wait 1, 2, 5, 10, then 30 s (webui still polls at its third failure, so it only uses 1 and 2). From the third Hermes failure "Live updates delayed" shows and the Board reloads every 30 s while the socket keeps reconnecting; `.opened` stops polling and catches up an offline or behind Board. A poll that reaches the Board while no socket is reconnecting (after a refused foreground check) reopens it. A reload whose `latest_event_id` is below the cursor resets it and reopens the socket. #1043's foreground-behind-a-Card reload is gone: the socket catches up from the cursor.
- `HermesKanbanClient.kanbanBoard` answers a `since` read with `changed: false` while `latest_event_id` has not moved, so polls and foreground checks keep an unmoved Board.
- Docs: `docs/agents/kanban.md` § Hermes, `docs/agents/bots.md`. Decisions: [Uzair, 2026-10-06](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1045#issuecomment-6007533002).

## How it was tested

- Contract on `scripts/local-hermes` (ca678285, 0.21.5): a fresh ticket opens with no subprotocol; a quiet Board sends nothing and a client ping gets a pong; creating then moving a Card sent `{events:[{id,task_id,run_id,kind,payload,created_at}],cursor:6}`, then cursor 7; a reused or missing ticket is HTTP 403 on the upgrade.
- The real `URLSessionWebSocketTask` path on the simulator against that host opened, idled 70 s on pings, got a frame for a new Card, and mapped a bogus ticket to `upgradeRefused(403)`.
- `scripts/test-sim <iPhone Air> --only` KanbanLiveUpdate, KanbanEventStreamClient, KanbanFeatureState, HermesConnection, HermesKanbanClient, HermesRequest, HermesGateway, APIClientKanban: **176 passed**. After the review fix, KanbanLiveUpdate, KanbanFeatureState, HermesKanbanClient, KanbanEventStreamClient: **123 passed**; `--repeat 20` KanbanLiveUpdate: 660 runs, 0 failures.
- Red on unchanged code: opening a Hermes Board started no stream (`0 ≠ 1`, `nil ≠ "11"`), and a poll after a refused foreground check never reopened the socket. The socket-client tests cannot compile against the old API.

## Checklist

- [x] Local validation passes using `scripts/test-sim <assigned-simulator-udid>` with the tests required by `AGENTS.md` § Verifying; the selection and results are recorded above
- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly (optionals for fields the server might add or rename)
- [x] No new third-party dependencies (the list in `AGENTS.md` is locked)
- [x] No invented API endpoints or JSON shapes (verified against upstream source or a running server)

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, physical iPhone
1. Simulator, signed in with `scripts/sim-login <udid> --hermes` against `scripts/local-hermes`: open a Board, then move a Card from the host's dashboard. Expected: the phone updates within a second or two.
2. Simulator: open a Card, background the app, move another Card on the dashboard, return and go back to the Board. Expected: the Board shows the move without a pull to refresh.
3. Physical iPhone, Cloudflare tunnel: open a quiet Board, leave it for 5 minutes, then move a Card from the dashboard. Expected: the phone updates without a pull to refresh.
4. Physical iPhone: background the app for a minute, moving a Card from the dashboard meanwhile, then return. Expected: the Board catches up.

title: feat(hermes): Run Now on Hermes Tasks with a server-confirmed running state
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1041. Stacked on #1057; merge after it.

## What changed

A Hermes host's trigger runs the Task before it replies, so through a Cloudflare tunnel a long run got a 524 at about 100 s and looked failed while it was still running. #1040 hid Run Now on Hermes for that reason.

- **Networking.** `POST /api/cron/jobs/{id}/trigger?profile=`, no body, with the `.provisioning` deadline. `CronFeatures.runNowWaitsForRun` (Hermes only), `offersRunNow(for:)` (hidden on a completed Hermes Task) and `runNowResumes(_:)` (a paused one).
- **Machine.** On Hermes, `TaskDetailViewModel.runNow()` sends the trigger once on a task nothing cancels, then reads the list every 5 s on an injected clock until the host's outcome: the trigger's job, or a read where the Task isn't running and `last_run_at` is newer than at the tap. `runNowState` is idle, requested or running, derived from #1040's running state, so "Running" shows only once the list does. A 504, 524, timeout or dropped connection keeps reading with no error. A `{detail}` refusal reads at once and shows the host's reason unless the Task is running or finished (409 "already running"). Three failed reads in a row end it with the read's error. Leaving a screen stops the reads, never the run. webui is unchanged.
- **Views.** Run now shows a small spinner only while requested and stays off while running. A paused Task asks "Run Now? This also resumes the Task." first, from every entry. The row action runs the same machine; its reads update the list unless a change or refresh landed while the read was out, and the row's actions (Delete included) wait for it.
- `docs/agents/bots.md`, and two catalog keys with all 17 translations.

Applies the [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1041#issuecomment-6007532003) (decisions 1-3, Preserve #1040). The disconnect check on `scripts/local-hermes` (0.21.5) showed the run outliving its request, so no #710 route. Contract evidence is in a comment below.

## How it was tested

- `git diff --check` clean; `ci/check_string_catalog.py` covers all 2224 keys.
- `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only` HermesRunNowTests, HermesCronClientTests, CronManagementModelTests, CronManagementViewModelTests, TaskRunHistoryTests: 60 passed on 79db2c20. On 360b0a91, those plus HermesRequestTests and APIClientCronEndpointTests passed 72.
- `--only HermesMobileTests/HermesRunNowTests --repeat 20`: 220 passes (11 tests), no continuation leaks.
- Red on the code before each change: the trigger test threw "unsupported", the 200-reply test sent nothing, the list-read test brought a deleted Task back and a refreshed one to its old state, and the failed-reads test never finished. The scripted-clock tests use the new `sleep:` and `runNowState` API, so they can't compile on the old code.

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator, physical iPhone
1. [`scripts/local-hermes` with a no_agent script Task that sleeps 20 s] Open the Task, tap Run now, then open Edit and cancel it. Expected: a spinner on Run now, then "Running" with Run now dimmed (the sheet doesn't stop it), then Active with the next run.
2. Pause the Task, then try Run now from the header button, the ⋯ menu, the row's swipe and the row's long-press menu. Expected: each asks "Run Now? This also resumes the Task."; Cancel leaves it paused; Run Now runs it and it ends Active.
3. Long-press a row → Run Now. Expected: within about 5 s it moves to Now ("Running · 5s") and its Delete is dimmed, then it moves back. Run Now a row again and open any Task at once. Expected: no "Could Not Update Task" alert; back in Tasks the row shows where the run is.
4. At the largest accessibility text size, tap Run now. Expected: the spinner and the dimmed button fit the stacked footer.
5. iPad Pro 11-inch (M5): Hermes inbox → + → Tasks → a Task → Run now, then back to Tasks mid-run. Expected: the same spinner, Running and outcome; no error on leaving.
6. Physical iPhone, Cloudflare tunnel: Run Now on a Task that takes longer than 2 minutes. Expected: no error at about 100 s, it shows Running, and it ends with the host's result.
