title: feat(hermes): change Kanban Cards and boards on Hermes
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1044 · Part of #704 (slice 4.2b). Stacked on #1059; merge after it.

## What changed

After #1043, Kanban on a Hermes server is read-only. The host's write contract also differs from webui's: To Do doesn't stick (the dispatcher promotes those Cards), block and unblock are Status changes that can land a Card elsewhere, prerequisite and comment replies echo nothing, tenant is create-only, and an empty assignee on create is a 400.

- **Client.** `HermesKanbanClient` implements every `KanbanDataClient` write under `/api/plugins/kanban`: Cards (create, edit, status, block, unblock), comments, prerequisites, Bulk Actions, the Dispatcher, and Boards (create, edit, archive, switch). Replies are `read_only: false`, and prerequisite replies are filled in from the request. A 400 or 409 throws `KanbanWriteRefusal` with the host's `detail`, through a new `HermesConnection.reply(_:)`.
- **Per-server rules** on `KanbanBackend`: create and Move offer Triage and Ready only; To Do, Scheduled, Review and Running are never destinations; Block only on Ready and Running; Complete only on Review (the host refuses Done without a result). `accepts(_:requested:from:)` counts a block landing in Triage, or an unblock landing in To Do or Review, as success. `restoreStatus(after:)` sends Undo Archive to Triage or Ready, and offers none for Done.
- **Feature state and views.** Every Hermes Card or prerequisite write reloads the Board. Refusals show the host's words on Card rows, Card detail, the editor, comments, the Undo banner and Board management. A create `warning` is a dismissible notice on the Board. The Card list follows a Card to where the host put it.
- **Editor on Hermes.** Triage and Ready only. Tenant is editable on create, read-only on edit, and never sent on edit. No workspace path. The workspace kind starts at the Board's `default_workspace_kind` and is sent unless it is a Scratch nobody picked. The assignee is sent only when it differs from the server's Card (`""` unassigns), and is null on create.
- webui requests, destinations and settlement are unchanged. Docs: `docs/agents/kanban.md` § Hermes. Decisions: [Uzair, 2026-10-06](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1044#issuecomment-6007532691).

## How it was tested

- Contract on `scripts/local-hermes` (ca678285, 0.21.5) on disposable Boards, archived afterwards. The replies are in a PR comment.
- `scripts/test-sim <iPhone Air> --only` HermesKanbanClient, HermesRequest, KanbanFeatureState, KanbanCardEditorState, KanbanCardDetailState, APIClientKanban: **155 passed**. HermesKanbanClient + KanbanLiveUpdate: **58 passed**. KanbanLiveUpdate, HermesRequest, HermesConnection, KanbanEventStreamClient: **55 passed**. After the review fixes, HermesKanbanClient, KanbanFeatureState, KanbanCardEditorState, KanbanCardDetailState: **129 passed**.
- Red on unchanged code: a block landing in Triage never settled, create threw `KanbanUnsupportedClientMethod`, the handshake stayed `partial`, and replies stayed read-only. Before the review fixes, the editor dropped the Board's `worktree` kind and an Overwrite sent no assignee (`null` ≠ `""`). The other write tests can't compile against the old API.

## Checklist

- [x] Local validation passes using `scripts/test-sim <assigned-simulator-udid>` with the tests required by `AGENTS.md` § Verifying; the selection and results are recorded above
- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly (optionals for fields the server might add or rename)
- [x] No new third-party dependencies (the list in `AGENTS.md` is locked)
- [x] No invented API endpoints or JSON shapes (verified against upstream source or a running server)

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator
Signed in with `scripts/sim-login <udid> --hermes` against `scripts/local-hermes`, on a disposable Board. No screenshots: the simulator's device session was held by another session (DEVICE_IN_USE), so these steps stand in for them.
1. Tap New Card. Expected: Status offers only Triage and Ready, there is no Workspace path field, and Tenant is editable. Create Card A in Triage, then Card B in Ready with Prerequisite A. Expected: B shows under To Do.
2. On B, Card Actions → Move → Ready. Expected: "Update failed" with the host's "blocked by parent(s) not done" line, and B stays in To Do. Open B → Edit. Expected: Tenant is greyed out, with the footer "Tenant is set when the Card is created and cannot be edited here."
3. Create Card C in Ready with Profile "default". Expected: a notice banner "No gateway is running…" with a dismiss button. Block C, Unblock it, then Block it again. Expected: the second block lands C in Triage without an error, and the list switches to Triage with C focused.
4. At the largest accessibility text size, repeat step 2's refused move and step 3's create. Expected: the refusal line and the notice banner wrap without clipping, and VoiceOver reads the banner's button as "Dismiss".

title: feat(hermes): Task run history and output on Hermes
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1042. Part of #704. Stacked on #1061; merge after it.

## What changed

After #1040, a Hermes Task's detail hid its run history and output, because on a Hermes host each run is a session, not an output file.

- **Client.** `HermesREST.cronRuns` is `GET /api/cron/jobs/{id}/runs?profile=&limit=100`. `HermesCronClient` backs `cronHistory` (the newest 100 as one page with no total, so no "Load more") and `cronRunDetail` (the run session's final reply: the last assistant message without tool calls, via `sessionMessages`, which keeps its #1013 id check). A 404 reads "This run is no longer on the server." Rows decode only id, start, end, `is_active`, model, tokens and cost, never `system_prompt`. A page without `runs` is a failed read. Run reads take the Task's Profile; webui ignores it.
- **Status.** `TaskDetailViewModel.outcome(of:)` replaces `isFailedRun`. An active run shows Running (blue). The host stamps `last_run_at` once a run's session ends, so the detail reads the job before its runs, and only the newest run that ended by `last_run_at` carries the outcome (red with its reason, or green on `ok`). Other Hermes rows claim nothing (gray), as do runs read before a newer outcome. webui rows are unchanged.
- **Latest output.** On Hermes it is that run's reply, read only when it failed, the one time the card shows. After a Hermes Run Now the detail reads its runs again, so the outcome lands on the new run.
- `CronFeatures.hasRunHistory` becomes `runsAreSessions`. Rows add tokens. `CONTEXT.md` adds **Task Run**, `docs/agents/bots.md` records the contract, and two catalog keys come with all 17 translations.

Applies the [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1042#issuecomment-6007532201) (decisions 1-3, Preserve #1013). Defaults taken: rows don't show `preview`, because on the host it is the Task's prompt behind the scheduler's cron preamble, the same on every run. The output sheet stays monospaced text, as today. Contract evidence is in a comment below.

## How it was tested

- `git diff --check` is clean. `ci/check_string_catalog.py` covers all 2225 keys.
- `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only` TaskRunHistoryTests, HermesCronClientTests, HermesRunNowTests, HermesRequestTests, CronManagementViewModelTests and APIClientCronEndpointTests: 79 passed on 9a2ec748. The same set plus LocalizationCatalogTests: 83 passed on 12f2cf6f.
- Red on the code before each change. On 79db2c20, six new Hermes tests failed, with no runs read and no output. On 12f2cf6f, the Run Now test kept the old list and the latest-output test showed the active run's reply. On 32c3f34c and 424d8c18, each review fix's test failed: an old run took a newer failure, a page without `runs` emptied the list, and the runs read went out before the job. `outcome(of:)` is new API, so its test can't compile on the old code.

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator
1. [A Hermes host with a Task that has run several times] Open the Task. Expected: its runs are newest first with no "Load more". The newest has a green dot, or red with the reason if the Task failed, and older rows have a gray dot. Tap a run. Expected: the agent's final reply, or "No output for this run."
2. Tap Run now. While it runs, pull to refresh. Expected: the new run shows "Running" with a blue dot. When it finishes, the new row carries the outcome and the row that was newest before turns gray.
3. Switch between light and dark appearance. Expected: in both, the gray dot is easy to tell apart from the green, blue and red dots.
4. [A Task with about 100 runs] Scroll the detail from top to bottom. Expected: smooth scrolling with no hitches.

title: Third-party keyboard voice dictation stops after the first character
body:
## Summary

When the Hermex chat composer is empty, using the voice-dictation feature built into a third-party iOS keyboard reportedly inserts only the first character and then interrupts/stops that keyboard dictation session. This is the keyboard’s own dictation, not the microphone/voice-input control implemented by Hermex.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open a Hermex chat with an empty composer.
2. Switch to a third-party keyboard that provides voice dictation (reported with Doubao Input and WeChat Input).
3. Start that keyboard’s voice dictation and speak a phrase.

## Expected behavior

The third-party keyboard’s dictation session should continue and insert the recognized speech into the composer.

## Actual behavior

Only the first character appears, after which the third-party keyboard dictation session stops or is interrupted.

Reported comparisons:

- Ordinary typing with the affected third-party keyboards works in Hermex.
- Apple’s built-in keyboard dictation works in Hermex.
- The same third-party keyboards have been confirmed to work normally in WeChat, QQ, Apple Notes, and Apple Reminders; so far, the behavior has only been observed in Hermex.
- If the user first types a space or another character (reported examples: `A`, `R`, or `我`), third-party keyboard dictation reportedly works normally afterward.

## Investigation so far

This appears to be specific to Hermex’s native composer/input integration, but the root cause has not been established.

The composer is a SwiftUI wrapper around a `UITextView` (`ComposerChipTextView`). Its delegate publishes `sourceText` and selection to the SwiftUI bindings on `textViewDidChange`. The parent binding writes the draft synchronously. On a subsequent representable update, `applyBoundText` returns without changing the text view when its `sourceText` already equals the bound draft. Therefore, source inspection does **not** establish that the empty-to-first-character transition necessarily rewrites the `UITextView`; with the normal callback ordering, the bound value may already match and the synchronization is a no-op.

The bridge has special handling for active `markedTextRange`, selection synchronization, and chip rendering. A keyboard-specific timing or focus interaction remains possible, but there is no runtime trace showing that a text rewrite, selection assignment, chip render, or focus change occurs when dictation stops. The report should not be read as a confirmed diagnosis of any of those paths.

This is distinct from [#312](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/312), which tracks ordinary CJK IME composition being clobbered/split during parent updates. That issue and its implementation/review history (#202/#384) are relevant context for the composer bridge, but they do not establish that this voice-dictation interruption has the same cause. [#209](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/209) concerns auto-capitalization interfering with Chinese Pinyin, not voice dictation stopping.

## Impact

Minor bug. Third-party keyboard voice dictation is interrupted when started in an empty composer; typing a character first is a reported workaround.

## Environment

- App: Hermex 1.8 (previously reported; provisional and not freshly verified).
- Device / OS: iPhone 17 / iOS 27.0.1 (previously reported; provisional and not freshly verified).
- Affected keyboards: Doubao Input and WeChat Input (reported; keyboard versions not provided).
- `hermes-webui` server version and connection path: not provided. The symptom occurs during local text entry, before sending a message, and no server behavior has been implicated.

## Helpful next diagnostic evidence

A focused runtime trace or screen recording should compare dictation from an empty composer with dictation after typing a prefix, and record whether the text view remains first responder, whether `markedTextRange` is present, what `sourceText` and the draft binding contain, and whether `applyBoundText`, a selection assignment, chip rendering, or a focus transition occurs immediately before the keyboard stops. This would distinguish a composer synchronization/focus interaction from a third-party keyboard/iOS behavior without assuming a root cause.

title: fix(bots): malformed approval.respond count is shown as "already resolved"
body:
**What happens.** `BotConversation.respond` maps the reply with
`(reply["resolved"].integer ?? 0) > 0 ? .answered : .alreadyResolved`
(`BotConversation.swift:1354`, at `8705e61`). A reply of `{}`,
`{"resolved":"1"}` or `{"resolved":1.5}` is therefore labelled "already
resolved", which tells the user another client settled the request. The
gateway passes an empty result object through as success, so this path is
reachable.

**Impact.** It's a wrong label, but the outcome is conservative. Nothing is
resent, and `deliver` already schedules a full snapshot refresh afterwards
(`:1507-1515`), so the card is reconciled. The problem is the receipt the
user sees in the meantime: a drifted success looks like "not applied".

**Suggested fix.** Treat only an integer `0` as `.alreadyResolved` and a
positive integer as `.answered`. Treat a missing, null, non-integer or
negative value as `.uncertain`. Keep the existing refresh and the no-replay
behaviour.

**Evidence.** I compiled the pinned `HermesGateway`/`HermesCall` against a
scripted socket: a `{}` result reaches the caller as success. I replicated
the line-1354 expression with `BotJSON` for the five inputs above. I did not
run the full `BotConversation` state machine. A real test should drive
`respond` and assert the outcome and the send count.

Related: #1011 reuses this request model for Sessions.

Drafted with AI assistance (Claude Opus 5.5 in Hermes Agent), building on a
source audit by GPT Daybreak, and reviewed by Claude Fable 5.1 and GPT-6
Astra.

title: with a large/accessibility system text size the Bot Chat transcript is cut off at both screen edges and the composer's Send button becomes unreachable
body: ### Steps to reproduce 1. Connect to a Hermes server from the iPhone and open the Bots tab. 2. Open a Bot Chat whose transcript contains wide rows - tool-output rows, code, JSON or long path lines written by the agent. 3. Look at the transcript, then at the composer at the bottom of the screen. ### Expected behavior The transcript stays inside the screen in portrait: wide rows are wrapped, clipped or made horizontally scrollable. The composer and its Send button stay reachable at every system text size. ### Actual behavior The transcript column is wider than the screen, so rows are cut off on BOTH edges - only the middle of a row is visible. The beginning of a row is off-screen on the right (RTL text) and the end is off-screen on the left. The composer at the bottom is pushed past the right edge of the screen, so the Send button cannot be tapped at all. The chat becomes one-way: you can type, but you cannot send. It is intermittent: the same chat sometimes renders fine and sometimes is cut, depending on which row is currently on screen. ### Impact Blocks work completely ### App version / commit App Store build, released 2026-10-04 ### iOS version and device iOS 27.0.1 (24A446) on iPhone 15 Pro Max ### hermes-webui server version Hermes Agent v0.21.4 (2026.9.21), upstream 35f0b4b5 hermes-webui exp-v0.52.420 (commit d8ec400, 2026-10-05) ### How the phone reaches the server Tailscale ### Screenshots or screen recordings Notes from the app's source, for whoever triages this: - ChatReadingWidth.maximum = 768 caps the transcript column at 768 pt. BotChatView.swift applies maxWidth: ChatReadingWidth.maximumWidth(horizontalPadding:) (= 768 + 2*padding = 800 pt) and neither clips nor horizontally scrolls the overflow. On an iPhone in portrait (430 pt wide) a wide row therefore spills off both edges. - #915 / #873 added HorizontalOverflowEdgeFades for wide TABLES, but wide non-table rows (tool output, long unbroken lines) still overflow the column. - #977 reports BotChatPresentationTests.testTranscriptComposerEditsDraftAtAccessibilitySizeWithoutSending failing across iterations on Xcode 27 / iOS 26.5+ - the Bot Chat transcript + composer at an ACCESSIBILITY text size is already a known broken path. - Same class, fixed and shipped: #956 (a long approval description pushed Allow / Deny off-screen on iPhone) - fixed by #949, shipped in 1.9. What was tried already: - Clear the app's offline cache / reinstall the app: no change. - Update the app to 1.9: no change. - Update iOS to 27.0.1 (24A446): no change. - Reduce the widest server-side lines to <= 110 characters per line: reduces how often it happens, does not remove it. The maintainer's note on #956 was: "if you still notice the same problem, plz file a new issue" - so this is filed as a new one.

title: feat(hermes): browse and toggle skills on Hermes
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, a Skills screen lists the selected Profile's skills by category, turns each on or off, and opens its SKILL.md.
**Why it matters:** #705 slice 5.3 of Hermex 2.0 (#713). Skills is reachable only from the webui session list today, so a Hermes server can't browse or toggle skills at all.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed.

Part of #705 (slice 5.3a) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** none · **Unblocks:** #1070 (linked files)

## Problem and outcome

Skills is webui-only and hard-wired to the webui client:
- `SkillsViewModel` builds `APIClient(baseURL:)` (`HermesMobile/Features/Skills/SkillsViewModel.swift:15-19`). The detail screen bypasses the view model and calls `APIClient` directly (`HermesMobile/Features/Skills/SkillsView.swift:370`, `:385`).
- The calls are `GET /api/skills`, `GET /api/skills/content?name=&file=` and `POST /api/skills/toggle` (`HermesMobile/Networking/APIClient+Skills.swift:4-17`, `Endpoints.swift:393-398`, `:573-578`).
- The screen is reached only from the webui sidebar (`SessionListComponents.swift:293-295` → `SessionListView.swift:677-678`). A Hermes server routes to `HermesServerHome` (`ContentView.swift:331-357`), where Tasks and Kanban sit as temporary + menu items gated by `HermesSessionEntry.isOffered` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotsInboxView.swift:3-20`, `:238-253`).

After this, on a Hermes server, in a DEBUG build or Hermex Branch:
- The inbox's + menu offers **Skills**, opened on the selected Profile through `openOnSelectedProfile` (`BotsInboxView.swift:379-393`), with the Profile in the title.
- The list shows every skill, disabled ones included, grouped by category and searchable by name and description.
- The toggle turns a skill on or off for that Profile, optimistically with rollback, as on webui (`SkillsViewModel.swift:59-77`).
- The detail screen shows SKILL.md. Linked files are hidden until #1070.

webui servers don't change.

## Contract

Read from source at `HERMES_AGENT_TESTED_SHA` (`ca678285`, 0.21.5), `hermes_cli/web_routers/skills.py`. Re-check each against `scripts/local-hermes` before building on it.

- **`GET /api/skills?profile=`** (`:343-371`) → a **bare array** of `{name, description, category, enabled, usage, provenance: hub|bundled|agent}`. Disabled skills are included (`tools/skills_tool.py:183-218`). There are no `tags`, no related skills and no path. `HermesREST.skills(profile:)` already exists (`HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesREST.swift:82`, `:185`) and `HermesCronClient.cronSkills` decodes it (`HermesCronClient.swift:107-113`).
- **`PUT /api/skills/toggle`** with body `{name, enabled, profile}` (`:374-389`, `web_models.py:465-468`) → `{ok, name, enabled}`. It is **PUT**, not webui's POST. A `profile` in the body wins over the query; send it in the body.
- **`GET /api/skills/content?name=&profile=`** (`:392-410`) → `{name, content, path}`, or 404 `{detail}`. `path` is the absolute host path of SKILL.md: never render, log or persist it. #1070 uses it as an opaque handle.
- Errors are FastAPI `{detail}`, not webui's `{error}`.
- Not used: `POST /api/skills` (create) and `PUT /api/skills/content` (edit). There is no delete route. The app has none of these on webui either.

## Plan

- [ ] **Data client.** Add a `SkillsDataClient` protocol on the `CronDataClient` pattern (`HermesCronClient.swift:10-20`): list, content, toggle. `APIClient` conforms with today's calls. A new `HermesSkillsClient` conforms over `HermesConnection`. Route the view model and both detail calls (`SkillsView.swift:370`, `:385`) through it.
- [ ] **REST.** Add `HermesREST` cases for the toggle (PUT body) and the content read. Reuse `.skills(profile:)`. Map `enabled` to the app's `disabled`, as `cronSkills` does; share the decode rather than copying it.
- [ ] **Capabilities.** The Hermes client reports no tags and no linked files, so search drops tags and the detail screen hides the linked-files list. Keep this as a features value on the client, like `cronFeatures` (`HermesCronClient.swift:11`), not a server-kind check in the view.
- [ ] **Entry.** A "Skills" item in the inbox's + menu, beside Tasks and Kanban, behind the same gate and marked temporary until #709's build.

## Decisions

1. **Entry point:** a temporary + menu item, as Tasks and Kanban (decided 2026-10-06).
2. **Profile:** the inbox's selected Profile, named in the title. No picker in the screen.
3. **Create, edit and delete:** out of scope. Hermes has no delete, and the app has none of them today.

## Acceptance

- [ ] On a Hermes server, + → Skills lists the selected Profile's skills, disabled ones included, by category.
- [ ] Search matches name and description.
- [ ] Toggling sends one `PUT /api/skills/toggle` with `{name, enabled, profile}`. A `{detail}` refusal rolls the row back and shows the host's message.
- [ ] Opening a skill shows its SKILL.md. A 404 shows "not found" rather than an empty screen.
- [ ] No host path is shown or logged.
- [ ] A second Hermes server and a webui server each show their own skills.
- [ ] webui Skills behaves as before, linked files included.

## Tests

These fail on today's code.
- **`HermesSkillsClientTests`** (URLProtocol): the bare-array decode with `enabled` and unknown fields, the toggle's method, path and body, `?profile=` on reads, a `{detail}` error, and the content 404.
- **`SkillsViewModelTests`:** the view model on a stub `SkillsDataClient`: toggle rollback, search without tags.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/SkillsViewModelTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientSkillEndpointTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesCronClientTests`, plus the new class.

## Mocks

Not required: today's list and detail screens are reused, minus tags and linked files.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator, signed in with `scripts/sim-login <udid> --hermes` against `scripts/local-hermes`.
1. + → Skills. Expected: the Profile's skills by category, with the Profile in the title.
2. Turn a skill off, leave, come back. Expected: it is still off.
3. Open a skill. Expected: its SKILL.md.
4. Switch to a webui server and open Skills from the sidebar. Expected: unchanged, linked files included.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the + menu only. Tasks' skill picker and Hermes `/` suggestions (#1036) already read host skills and don't change.
- **Targets:** main app only.
- **Servers:** the client is built per server from its saved connection.
- **Reverse states:** a toggle turns back.

## Blockers

None.

## Outside reach

None. Toggles run against `scripts/local-hermes` only.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code in T3 Code.

title: feat(hermes): open a skill's linked files on Hermes
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, a skill's detail screen lists the files beside its SKILL.md (references, templates, scripts) and opens them.
**Why it matters:** #705 slice 5.3 of Hermex 2.0 (#713). webui shows a skill's linked files; after #1069 a Hermes skill shows only SKILL.md.
**Cost:** Small. One PR, stacked on #1069. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`.

Part of #705 (slice 5.3b) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** #1069

## Problem and outcome

Hermes has no skill-scoped file route. webui's `GET /api/skills/content?file=` serves files contained to the skill directory and groups them (`.codex-tmp/hermes-webui/api/routes.py:1060-1093`); the app decodes those groups in `SkillDetailResponse` (`HermesMobile/Models/Skills.swift:227-280`) and opens a file in a sheet (`HermesMobile/Features/Skills/SkillsView.swift:384-386`).

After this, on a Hermes server, the skill detail screen lists the skill directory's other files with paths relative to the skill, and tapping one opens its text in the same sheet.

## Contract

Read from source at `ca678285`, `hermes_cli/web_routers/files.py`. Re-check against `scripts/local-hermes`.

- **The directory** is the parent of `path` from `GET /api/skills/content` (#1069).
- **`GET /api/fs/list?path=`** (`:617-637`) → `{entries: [{name, path, isDirectory}]}` for one directory, not recursive.
  - **Errors come back as 200** with `{entries: [], error: "ENOENT"|…}`.
  - It hides build, `.git`, venv and similar folders (`:54-57`) and credential files (`:92-103`).
  - No `profile` parameter, and no root containment (`web_server_files.py:24-47`).
- **`GET /api/fs/read-text?path=`** (`:640-655`) → `{text, binary, truncated, byteSize, language, mimeType, path}`. Previews cap at 512 KiB (`:107`); 413 over 64 MiB; 404, 403, 400 for a directory.

## Plan

- [ ] Add `HermesREST` cases for `fs/list` and `fs/read-text`. #1073 adds `fs/write-text` beside them; keep the cases general.
- [ ] `HermesSkillsClient` lists the skill directory two levels deep, excluding SKILL.md, and returns relative names. Every path it requests is built from the content reply's `path`, never from user input, and must stay under that directory.
- [ ] Read a file through `read-text`. `binary` shows "Can't preview this file"; `truncated` shows the text with a "Preview truncated" note.
- [ ] Turn on linked files in the Hermes client's features value from #1069.

## Decisions

1. **Scope:** two levels under the skill directory, relative paths, flat list. It matches webui's subfolders without hard-coding their names.
2. **Host paths** are opaque handles: never shown, logged or persisted.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A Hermes skill with files lists them by relative path, without SKILL.md.
- [ ] Tapping a file opens its text. Binary and truncated files say so.
- [ ] A listing that answers 200 with `error` shows no files and no error banner.
- [ ] No request leaves the skill directory.
- [ ] webui linked files behave as before.

## Tests

- **`HermesSkillsClientTests`:** a two-level listing fixture, the 200-with-`error` reply, `binary` and `truncated` reads, and a path that would leave the directory is refused before any request.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesSkillsClientTests --only HermesMobileTests/SkillsViewModelTests`.

## Mocks

Not required: today's linked-files list and sheet are reused.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`. Open a bundled skill with a `references/` folder. Expected: its files listed and readable.

## Surfaces

Main app only; Hermes servers only.

## Blockers

#1069, set as a GitHub dependency.

## Outside reach

None.

title: feat(hermes): transcribe dictation with the host's speech-to-text
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, server dictation in a Sessions chat transcribes with the host's speech-to-text for the chat's Profile, instead of failing first and falling back to on-device.
**Why it matters:** #705 slice 5.3 of Hermex 2.0 (#713). Today every Hermes dictation with the default "Server first" setting uploads the recording to a webui-only route, waits for it to fail, then transcribes on-device: a wasted upload and extra latency on every dictation.
**Cost:** Small. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; a phone pass is optional.

Part of #705 (slice 5.3c) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** none · **Related:** #766 (Bot dictation; stays separate under #709 Option B)

## Problem and outcome

- The voice controller's only server seam is a concrete client: `var apiClient: APIClient?`, where a non-nil client means "server configured" (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ComposerVoiceInputController.swift:59`, `:209`). The upload is `transcribeAudio` (`:492`): multipart `POST /api/transcribe`, decoding `{transcript, error}` (`HermesMobile/Networking/APIClient+Transcribe.swift:13-37`).
- A Hermes chat is the Sessions chat view (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatView.swift:453-473`) and still passes a webui `APIClient` pointed at the Hermes host (`:532`). Dictation stays visible on Hermes chats (`ChatComposerView.swift:272-275`, `:975`), and the composer hands that client to the controller (`ChatComposerView.swift:1497`). hermes-agent has no `/api/transcribe`, so the upload fails and the controller falls back on-device (`ComposerVoiceInputController.swift:521-547`).

After this, on a Hermes server:
- With **Server first** or **Server only**, a recording goes to `POST /api/audio/transcribe?profile=<chat's Profile>`.
- With **On-device**, nothing is uploaded, as today.
- A host error under Server first falls back on-device, as on webui.

webui and Bot chats don't change.

## Contract

Read from source at `ca678285`, `hermes_cli/web_routers/audio.py`. Re-check against `scripts/local-hermes`.

- **`POST /api/audio/transcribe?profile=`** (`:77-137`): JSON, **not multipart**: `{data_url: "data:<mime>;base64,…", mime_type}` (`web_models.py:82-84`). The MIME must be `audio/*` or `video/webm` (`:91`); `audio/m4a` maps to `.m4a` (`:36-41`).
- **Limit:** 25 MiB of decoded audio, else 413 (`:43`, `:101-102`). The controller's 19 MiB ceiling (`ComposerVoiceInputController.swift:277`) fits.
- **Success:** `{ok: true, transcript, provider}`. Silence is `{ok: true, transcript: ""}` (`:130-137`).
- **Errors:** `{detail}`. 400 covers a bad payload, STT disabled and no provider; 500 is a provider failure.
- **Profile:** `?profile=` selects that Profile's STT config.
- **Timeout:** transcription can be slow; use `HermesConnection`'s `.provisioning` deadline (120 s per request, 180 s per resource, `HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesConnection.swift:74-78`, `:184`), not the standard 15 s / 30 s.

## Plan

- [ ] Replace `apiClient: APIClient?` on the controller with one transcriber closure, `(Data, String) async throws -> TranscribeResponse`. "Server configured" becomes "closure present". The webui composer wraps `apiClient.transcribeAudio`; behavior is unchanged.
- [ ] Add `HermesREST.transcribe(profile:dataURL:mimeType:)` and a send on the `.provisioning` deadline that maps `{transcript}` and `{detail}` to `TranscribeResponse`.
- [ ] A Hermes chat supplies the Hermes closure bound to its own Profile and connection. The closure captures the conversation's server, so a result for a chat that is gone or switched is dropped by the controller's existing stale guard.
- [ ] Bot chats keep their on-device-only path (`BotChatComposerView.swift:439-440`). #766 reuses this closure later.

## Decisions

1. **Setting:** Hermes follows the existing Dictation Provider setting (`SettingsView.swift:267`, policy `AppTheme.swift:892-960`), decided 2026-10-06.
2. **No capability probe.** Hermes has no safe one (`/api/audio/voice-config` returns provider keys). A 400 "STT disabled" under Server first falls back on-device; under Server only it shows the host's message.

## Acceptance

- [ ] On a Hermes chat with Server first, one `POST /api/audio/transcribe?profile=<chat's Profile>` carries a base64 `data_url` and `mime_type`, and the transcript lands in the draft.
- [ ] No Hermes dictation request goes to `/api/transcribe`.
- [ ] Silence inserts nothing and shows no error.
- [ ] A 400 under Server first falls back on-device; under Server only it shows the host's `detail`.
- [ ] On-device sends nothing.
- [ ] webui dictation sends the same multipart request as before.

## Tests

These fail on today's code.
- **`ComposerVoiceInputServerRecordingTests`:** the controller on a stub transcriber: present versus absent, fallback under Server first, the error under Server only.
- **`HermesTranscribeTests`** (URLProtocol): body shape, `?profile=`, the deadline used, `{transcript: ""}`, and `{detail}` mapping.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/ComposerVoiceInputServerRecordingTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientTranscribeTests --only HermesMobileTests/ComposerVoiceDraftComposerTests`, plus the new class.

## Mocks

Not required: no UI change.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes` with an STT provider configured (or the live host only with Uzair's say-so; transcription is read-only on the host).
1. Hermes chat, Server first, dictate a sentence. Expected: the transcript appears, and the host's log shows `/api/audio/transcribe`.
2. Set On-device and dictate. Expected: no host request.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the Sessions composer's mic on Hermes chats. Bot chats are out (#766).
- **Targets:** main app only.
- **Servers:** the closure is bound per chat, so its server and Profile follow the conversation.

## Preservation

#593 and #487 made Bot dictation on-device only; keep it.

## Blockers

None.

## Outside reach

None.

title: feat(hermes): Listen to replies in the host's voice
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, Listen on a Sessions reply plays it in the voice the host's Profile is configured with, and still falls back to on-device speech when the host can't.
**Why it matters:** #705 slice 5.3 of Hermex 2.0 (#713). Listen on Hermes chats is on-device only today, so users who set up a voice on their host don't hear it in Hermex.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; a phone pass for audio is optional.

Part of #705 (slice 5.3d) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** none · **Related:** #748 (Bot Listen; stays separate under #709 Option B)

## Problem and outcome

- Listen skips the server on Hermes: `guard hermesTurn == nil, ServerTTSPolicy.shouldUseServerTTS(for:)` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatViewModel.swift:5265-5270`).
- The webui path reads `client.settings()` for the engine and voice, calls `synthesizeSpeech` (`ChatViewModel.swift:5279-5314`, `HermesMobile/Networking/APIClient+TTS.swift:33`), and plays through `ServerTTSAudioPlayer`, falling back to `AVSpeechSynthesizer` silently on any failure (#15). `client` is a concrete `APIClient` (`ChatViewModel.swift:531`); there is no synthesize seam.

After this, on a Hermes server, Listen sends the reply text to `POST /api/audio/speak?profile=<chat's Profile>` and plays the returned audio. Text over 4,000 characters, any error, and audio the player can't decode go on-device, as on webui today. The stop, speed, Now Playing and stale-request guards don't change.

webui and Bot chats don't change.

## Contract

Read from source at `ca678285`, `hermes_cli/web_routers/audio.py`. Re-check against `scripts/local-hermes`.

- **`POST /api/audio/speak?profile=`** (`:284-338`), body `{text}` only (`web_models.py:231-232`). No voice, engine or rate: the host uses the Profile's `tts.provider`, Edge by default (`tools/tts_tool.py:101`, `:141-145`).
- **Reply:** `{ok, data_url: "data:<mime>;base64,…", mime_type, provider}`; the MIME is `audio/mpeg`, `ogg`, `wav` or `flac` (`:46-49`).
- **Text:** the host strips Markdown, emoji and think blocks, splits long text into provider-sized chunks (Edge 5000, OpenAI 4096, fallback 4000) and joins them with ffmpeg; without ffmpeg only the first chunk plays (`tts_tool_delivery.py:47-58`, `:342-344`). Each file is capped at 10 MB, about 13.4 MB of base64 JSON.
- **Errors:** `{detail}`. 400 for empty text or a provider failure; 500 otherwise. The first call may install edge-tts lazily, so it can be slow: use `HermesConnection`'s `.provisioning` deadline (`HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesConnection.swift:74-78`).
- **Rejected:** `/api/audio/voice-config` (returns provider API keys), `speak-stream` (raw PCM over a socket), and the `voice.tts` RPC (plays on the host's speaker).

## Plan

- [ ] Give `ChatViewModel` one injected `synthesize: (String) async throws -> Data?` closure. The webui closure keeps today's `settings()` + `synthesizeSpeech` logic verbatim; the Hermes closure posts to `audio/speak`, reads a bounded body (about 20 MB), and decodes the data URL.
- [ ] Remove the `hermesTurn == nil` guard. Apply a 4,000-character Hermes ceiling beside `ServerTTSPolicy.maximumTextLength` (`ChatViewModel.swift:7744-7756`), which keeps the host to one chunk.
- [ ] Undecodable audio (Ogg included) falls back on-device through the existing `startServerAudioPlayback` failure path.
- [ ] Don't extract a shared `ListenPlayer`: that refactor is #748's.

## Decisions

1. **Seam:** one closure in `ChatViewModel`, not the `ListenPlayer` extraction (decided 2026-10-06; #748 keeps the extraction).
2. **Voice settings:** webui's engine and voice rows don't apply on Hermes. The host's `tts.provider` decides. Settings hides those rows on a Hermes server (#899 already hides webui-only rows; confirm, don't add).
3. **Ceiling:** 4,000 characters to the host, longer on-device.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Listen on a Hermes reply sends one `POST /api/audio/speak?profile=<chat's Profile>` with `{text}` and plays the returned audio.
- [ ] Over 4,000 characters, a `{detail}` error, a timeout, or undecodable audio plays on-device with no alert.
- [ ] Stopping during the request plays nothing when the response arrives.
- [ ] webui Listen sends the same `/api/tts` request as before.

## Tests

These fail on today's code.
- **`ListenSynthesisTests`** (new, on `ChatViewModel` with a stub closure and the injectable player factory, `ChatViewModel.swift:657`, `:717`): host audio plays, each fallback path goes on-device, a stale response is dropped.
- **`HermesSpeakTests`** (URLProtocol): body, `?profile=`, data-URL decode, a non-base64 payload, and `{detail}`.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientTTSTests`, plus the new classes and any existing Listen class the change touches.

## Mocks

Not required: no UI change.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes` (Edge TTS needs network on the Mac).
1. Listen on a short Hermes reply. Expected: the host's voice, not the iOS voice.
2. Listen on a reply over 4,000 characters. Expected: the iOS voice.
3. Tap Stop while it loads. Expected: nothing plays.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the reply's Listen action in Hermes Sessions chats. Bot chats are out (#748).
- **Targets:** main app only.
- **Native quality:** Now Playing and Reduce Motion behavior unchanged.

## Preservation

#15: failures fall back silently, and a stale response never starts playback. #35: audio session activation stays at the two playback-start points.

## Blockers

None.

## Outside reach

None.

title: feat(hermes): edit memory and soul on Hermes
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, the Memory screen shows and edits the selected Profile's notes (MEMORY), user profile (USER) and soul (SOUL), and every save stays in the agent's own format so its later memory edits keep working.
**Why it matters:** #705 slice 5.4 of Hermex 2.0 (#713). Memory is webui-only today. A careless write on Hermes is worse than none: the agent refuses to edit a memory file it thinks someone else rewrote (its "drift" check), so one bad save silently breaks the agent's memory updates.
**Cost:** Medium–Large. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`; no phone needed.

Part of #705 (slice 5.4) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** none

## Problem and outcome

- `MemoryViewModel` takes a concrete `APIClient` (`HermesMobile/Features/Memory/MemoryViewModel.swift:26-30`) and calls `GET /api/memory` and `POST /api/memory/write {section, content}` (`HermesMobile/Networking/APIClient+Memory.swift:4-18`). A save posts the raw editor text and refetches: no conflict check, no canonical form (`MemoryViewModel.swift:90-111`).
- The screen has My Notes, User Profile and Agent Soul sections plus read-only project context (`HermesMobile/Features/Memory/MemoryView.swift:71-102`, `HermesMobile/Models/Memory.swift:3-9`). It is reached only from the webui session list (`SessionListView.swift:679-680`).
- SOUL is already editable on Hermes from a Bot's Profile editor, through `profiles.configure` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotProfileEditor.swift:25`, `:352`, `:372`).

After this, on a Hermes server, in a DEBUG build or Hermex Branch:
- The inbox's + menu offers **Memory**, opened on the selected Profile (`BotsInboxView.swift:379-393`), with the Profile in the title.
- My Notes and User Profile read and write the Profile's memory files. A section whose flag is off in the host's config is hidden.
- Agent Soul reads and writes the Profile's SOUL.md.
- Each editor shows a live count against the host's limit and won't save over it.
- If the file changed on the host since it was opened, the save stops with "Changed on the host", keeps the draft, and offers Reload.
- The screen says edits apply from the agent's next session.
- Project context is hidden on Hermes.

webui servers don't change.

## Contract

Read from source at `HERMES_AGENT_TESTED_SHA` (`ca678285`, 0.21.5). Re-check each against `scripts/local-hermes`.

- **Files.** `<profile.path>/memories/MEMORY.md` and `USER.md`. `path` comes from the `profiles.list` row (`tui_gateway/methods_profiles.py:275`); it is a host path, never rendered, logged or persisted (`HermesCronClient.swift:97-104` already drops it). Build only these two paths, only from a `profiles.list` row: `/api/fs/*` accepts any absolute path (`hermes_cli/web_server_files.py:24-46`).
- **`GET /api/fs/read-text?path=`** (`hermes_cli/web_routers/files.py:640-656`) → `{text, binary, truncated, byteSize, …}`, no mtime. 404 when missing. Over 512 KB is `truncated`.
- **`POST /api/fs/write-text {path, content}`** (`:659-700`) → `{ok, path, byteSize}`. Atomic temp-file + rename. It does **not** create directories: 400 "Parent directory does not exist" (`:688-689`). Its docstring leaves stale detection to the client (re-read before save).
- **`POST /api/files/mkdir {path}`** (`:576-583`): there is no `/api/fs/mkdir`. 409 if a file is in the way; 403 under a locked managed-files root (`web_server_files.py:124-138`). `memories/` normally exists (`hermes_cli/profiles.py:32`, `tools/memory_tool_store.py:148-150`).
- **`GET /api/config?profile=`** (`hermes_cli/web_routers/config_env.py:81-91`) returns the **whole, unredacted** config, `delegation.api_key` included. Decode only `memory`, never cache or log the body. Fields: `memory_enabled`, `user_profile_enabled`, `memory_char_limit` (default 2200), `user_char_limit` (1375) (`config_defaults.py:1289-1302`). Flags default true and accept truthy strings (`tools/memory_tool.py:258-261`).
- **`GET` / `PUT /api/profiles/{name}/soul`** (`hermes_cli/web_routers/profiles.py:890-925`): GET `{content, exists}`; PUT `{content}` → `{ok: true}`, atomic. 404 for an unknown Profile.
- **The format and the drift check** (`tools/memory_tool_store.py`):
  - Entries are separated by exactly `"\n§\n"` (`:23`). The parser splits on that, strips each entry and drops empty ones (`:510-512`). The agent writes the join with no trailing newline (`:521-526`). Reads strip a BOM (`utf-8-sig`).
  - **Drift** is `raw.strip() != "\n§\n".join(parsed)`, or any single entry longer than the whole file's limit (`_detect_external_drift`, `:530-544`). On drift the agent backs the file up and refuses to `replace` or `remove` entries; `add` doesn't check, so a bad save surfaces later.
  - Limits count Python `len`: Unicode scalars, not Swift grapheme clusters.

## Plan

- [ ] **Canonicalizer.** A pure `MemoryCanonicalizer`: strip a BOM, CRLF → LF, treat a line that trims to `§` as a separator, trim each entry, drop empties, dedupe in order, join with `"\n§\n"`, no trailing newline. `scalarCount` for limits. Its output must pass the drift predicate for every input.
- [ ] **Data client.** A `MemoryDataClient` protocol on the `CronDataClient` pattern: `APIClient` with today's calls, and `HermesMemoryClient` over `HermesConnection` with `HermesREST` cases for `fs/read-text`, `fs/write-text`, `files/mkdir`, `config(profile:)` and soul GET/PUT. #1070 may add `fs/read-text` first; reuse it.
- [ ] **Save** (MEMORY and USER): canonicalize → refuse over the limit → re-read and compare with the text loaded when the editor opened (refuse as "Changed on the host" if different) → write → on the parent-directory 400, mkdir once and retry → re-read and confirm. A 404 on load reads as empty. `truncated` or `binary` text opens read-only.
- [ ] **SOUL:** the same re-read check, then `PUT …/soul`. No canonicalizer and no limit.
- [ ] **Screen:** the client's features value hides mtimes and project context on Hermes. Add the counter, the conflict state and the next-session note (see Mocks).
- [ ] **Entry:** a "Memory" item in the + menu beside Tasks and Kanban, same gate, temporary until #709's build.

## Decisions

1. **Over the limit:** block the save, with a live count (decided 2026-10-06).
2. **Conflict:** "Changed on the host", keep the draft, offer Reload; no merge (decided 2026-10-06).
3. **Project context:** hidden on Hermes, no follow-up issue (decided 2026-10-06). `project.facts` returns file names only and misses the `HERMES.md` the agent reads first.
4. **Flags off:** hide the section, as webui does.
5. **SOUL in two places:** keep it here and in the Bot Profile editor.
6. **Profile:** the inbox's selected Profile, no picker.

Deliberate: we accept a small lost-update window (the agent can write between our re-read and our write, and `write-text` takes no lock) in exchange for using the host's public file routes. The locked `/api/learning/node` path has no add and needs learning-graph ids.

## Acceptance

- [ ] On a Hermes server, + → Memory shows the selected Profile's notes, user profile and soul. A section whose flag is off is hidden.
- [ ] Every MEMORY or USER save writes canonical text that passes the agent's drift predicate; the fixtures prove it.
- [ ] After a Hermex save, the agent can still `replace` and `remove` entries (checked on `scripts/local-hermes`).
- [ ] Over the limit, Save is disabled and the count says why. The count matches the host's (scalars).
- [ ] A file changed on the host since opening isn't overwritten: the draft stays and Reload shows the host's text.
- [ ] A missing memories folder is created once and the save succeeds; a 403 shows the host's message.
- [ ] No host path and no config body is shown, logged or cached.
- [ ] A second Hermes server and a webui server each show their own memory.
- [ ] webui Memory behaves as before.

## Tests

These fail on today's code.
- **`MemoryCanonicalizerTests`:** idempotence, blank lines around `§`, empties, duplicates, CRLF, BOM, a spaced `§` line, emoji counted as scalars, and every output passing a Swift port of `_detect_external_drift`.
- **`HermesMemoryClientTests`** (URLProtocol): path building from a `profiles.list` row, config decoding only `memory` (truthy strings included), the 404-as-empty read, the conflict refusal, mkdir-and-retry, the 403, and soul GET/PUT.
- **`MemoryViewModelTests`:** the view model on a stub client: limit blocking, conflict keeps the draft, hidden sections.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/MemoryViewModelTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientMemoryEndpointTests`, plus the new classes.

## Mocks

Required: the count against the limit, the "Changed on the host" state with Reload, and the next-session note, on today's editor sheet.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`.
1. + → Memory, add an entry to My Notes, save. Then ask the agent to remove that entry. Expected: it removes it, with no "Refusing to write".
2. Open My Notes, change MEMORY.md on the host (`hermes` CLI or a second chat), then save. Expected: "Changed on the host", the draft kept.
3. Type past the limit. Expected: Save disabled, the count over the limit.
4. Edit Agent Soul, then open the Bot Profile editor. Expected: the same text.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the + menu. The Bot Profile editor's soul field is unchanged.
- **Targets:** main app only.
- **Servers:** the client is built per server; config is never cached.
- **Reverse states:** a save can be redone; a conflict can be reloaded.
- **Native quality:** the count is announced by VoiceOver; Dynamic Type in the editor sheet.

## Blockers

None.

## Outside reach

None. Saves run against `scripts/local-hermes` only.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code in T3 Code.

title: feat(hermes): Insights on Hermes
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, Insights shows the selected Profile's token use, cost, cache hits and per-model share over 7, 30 or 90 days.
**Why it matters:** #705 slice 5.5 of Hermex 2.0 (#713). Insights is webui-only today, so a Hermes server has no usage view.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes` plus a read-only look at the live host; no phone needed.

Part of #705 (slice 5.5a) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** none

## Problem and outcome

- `InsightsViewModel` reads an `InsightsDataClient` (`sessions`, `insights(days:)`, `providers`, `providerQuota`, `HermesMobile/Features/Insights/InsightsViewModel.swift:6-11`) through `init(client:)` (`:147`); only `APIClient` conforms (`:13`). It loads `GET /api/insights?days` and, if that fails, rebuilds the figures from `/api/sessions` (`:171-212`). Limits load separately from `/api/providers` and `/api/provider/quota` (`:219-283`).
- The screen: limits, window picker, chart, totals grid, models card, top sessions (`HermesMobile/Features/Insights/InsightsView.swift:79-139`), from `InsightsResponse` (`InsightsModels.swift:3-16`). It is reached only from the webui session list (`SessionListView.swift:681-682`).

After this, on a Hermes server, in a DEBUG build or Hermex Branch:
- The inbox's + menu offers **Insights**, opened on the selected Profile, with the Profile in the title.
- The window picker offers 7, 30 and 90 days. Today and the hourly chart are hidden.
- Totals, the daily chart, cost, cache-hit percent and the models card come from the host's analytics. Sessions and message counts come from `insights.get`; messages are marked approximate ("≈").
- Limits and top sessions are hidden.

webui servers don't change.

## Contract

Read from source at `ca678285`. Re-check against `scripts/local-hermes`, then read-only against the live host.

- **`GET /api/analytics/usage?days=&profile=`** (`hermes_cli/web_routers/analytics.py:143-153`, shape `:128-136`): `days` 1-365, 422 outside it; 503 for a corrupt store.
  - `daily[]`: `{day` (UTC date), `input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, reasoning_tokens, estimated_cost, actual_cost, sessions, api_calls}`.
  - `totals`: `{total_input, total_output, total_cache_read, total_reasoning, total_estimated_cost, total_actual_cost, total_sessions, total_api_calls}`.
  - Also `by_model`, `by_task`, `skills`, `tools`, `period_days`. No hourly or day-of-week data, no message counts.
- **`GET /api/analytics/models?days=&profile=`** (`:305-312`, shape `:287-301`): `models[]` keyed by model and provider (one model can appear twice), with tokens, costs, `sessions`, `api_calls`, `tool_calls`, `last_used_at`.
- **`insights.get {days, profile}`** RPC (`tui_gateway/methods_tools.py:1000-1010`) → `{days, sessions, messages}`, counting only the 500 newest sessions: approximate. Error 5017 when the store is unavailable.
- **Cache-hit percent** is client-side: `cache_read / (input + cache_read)`. `input_tokens` excludes cached reads (`agent/usage_pricing.py:66-77`) and no route reports cache writes, so it reads slightly higher than webui's, which includes writes.

## Plan

- [ ] Add `HermesREST.analyticsUsage` and `.analyticsModels`, and `HermesCall.insightsGet`.
- [ ] A `HermesInsightsClient: InsightsDataClient` maps the replies into `InsightsResponse`: model share and cache-hit percent computed client-side, cost from `estimated_cost`. `providers()` and `providerQuota()` return nothing (hiding Limits), and there is no `/api/sessions` fallback.
- [ ] A features value on the client hides Today, the hourly chart and top sessions, and marks message counts approximate.
- [ ] Fixtures from `scripts/capture-hermes-fixtures --local`.
- [ ] Entry: an "Insights" item in the + menu beside Tasks and Kanban, same gate, temporary until #709's build.

## Decisions

1. **Gaps:** hide Today and the hourly chart; mark messages "≈" (decided 2026-10-06).
2. **Provider limits:** hidden on Hermes until #710's companion route (decided 2026-10-06).
3. **One model under two providers:** two rows, the provider as a subtitle; no merging.
4. **Cost:** `estimated_cost`, as webui.
5. **Profile:** the inbox's selected Profile.

## Acceptance

- [ ] On a Hermes server, + → Insights shows the selected Profile's totals, daily chart, cache-hit percent, cost and models for the chosen window.
- [ ] Changing the window refetches with that `days`.
- [ ] Message counts are marked approximate; Today, the hourly chart, Limits and top sessions are not shown.
- [ ] A 503 or a 5017 shows an error state, not zeros.
- [ ] A second Hermes server and a webui server each show their own figures.
- [ ] webui Insights behaves as before.

## Tests

These fail on today's code.
- **`HermesInsightsClientTests`:** the mapping from captured fixtures, cache-hit percent with zero input, one model under two providers, the 503 and 5017 errors.
- **`InsightsViewModelTests`:** the hidden sections and approximate label from the features value.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/InsightsViewModelTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientInsightsTests`, plus the new class.

## Mocks

Not required: today's cards are reused with sections hidden. The "≈" marker reuses the totals grid's value style.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator, signed in with `scripts/sim-login <udid> --hermes`.
1. + → Insights on the live host (read-only). Expected: figures close to the dashboard's own analytics page for the same Profile and window.
2. Switch to 7 days. Expected: the chart and totals change.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** the + menu.
- **Targets:** main app only.
- **Servers:** the client is built per server.

## Blockers

None.

## Outside reach

Read-only analytics on the live host for the manual check.

title: feat(hermes): update Hermes from Settings
body:
**What the user gets:** On a Hermes server, Settings says when Hermes has an update, applies it from the phone, and follows the host through its restart to "Updated to <version>", or says exactly what to run on the host when it can't update itself.
**Why it matters:** #705 slice 5.5 of Hermex 2.0 (#713). Hermex shows a Hermes host's version but can't check for or apply an update; users switch to another client (a commenter on #705 uses Telegram's `/update`).
**Cost:** Medium–Large. One PR. Simulator against a throwaway `scripts/local-hermes` copy; `needs-manual-validation`; never the live host without Uzair's say-so.

Part of #705 (slice 5.5b) in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** none

## Problem and outcome

- The Hermes server card shows only the version saved at sign-in (`HermesMobile/Features/Settings/SettingsView.swift:916-937`), read from `/api/status` (`HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesConnection.swift:116`). There is no update check.
- The webui update rows (`SettingsView.swift:617-619`, check `:1261`, `:1292-1313`, apply `:1317`, restart wait `:1380-1430`) talk to webui routes and are hidden on Hermes (#899).
- The push restart already waits through a dashboard respawn: a dropped connection means the restart has begun, then it probes the public `/api/status` on `restartDelays` (`HermesMobile/Features/Bots/HermexPushProvisioner.swift:139`, `:490-525`).

After this, on a Hermes server, the server card shows:
- **Up to date**, or **Update available** with the commit count, from a passive check when Settings opens; a Check button forces one.
- **Update**, after a confirm that says running turns stop and the host restarts.
- While it runs: **Updating…**, then **Restarting Hermes…** while the dashboard is away, then **Updated to <version>**, or the host's partial or failed outcome.
- **Restart the dashboard on the host** with the command to run, when the update finished but the dashboard never came back.
- When the install can't update itself (`can_apply` false), the host's update command with a Copy button instead of Update.

webui servers don't change.

## Contract

Read from source at `ca678285`, `hermes_cli/web_routers/actions.py` unless noted. Re-check each against `scripts/local-hermes` before building on it.

- **`GET /api/hermes/update/check?force=&profile=`** (`:258-311`) → `{install_method, current_version, behind` (0, -1 unknown, null when the check failed), `update_available, can_apply` (git installs only), `update_command, message, commits?}`. A container install returns a `managed-runtime` payload (`:271-276`). Cached 24 h; `force` busts it.
- **`POST /api/hermes/update`**, no body (`:219-249`) → 200 except a spawn failure (500):
  - refused: `{ok: false, error, message, update_command}`, `error` one of `dashboard_update_managed_externally`, `docker_update_unsupported`, `apt_update_required`, `nix_update_unsupported`, `update_not_in_place`;
  - already running: `{ok: true, already_running: true, action_id?}`;
  - started: `{ok: true, pid, name, action_id}`.
- **`GET /api/actions/hermes-update/status`** (`:331-391`) → `{name, running, exit_code, pid, lines[], action_id?, receipt?}`; 404 for an unknown action. After a respawn the registry is empty: `running: false`, and `exit_code` comes from the log marker or the receipt, or is null, meaning keep waiting (`:300-316`). Needs auth.
- **`GET /api/hermes/update/receipt`** (`:413-424`) → `{receipt: {outcome, pre_sha, post_sha, post_version, …}, summary}`, or 404 when no update has run. `outcome` is `running`, `success`, `partial`, `failed` or `refused` (`hermes_cli/update_receipt.py:61`, `:234`). Needs auth.
- **`GET /api/health`** (`hermes_cli/web_routers/status.py:115-119`) → `{ok, version, auth_required}`, public.
- **The restart** (`hermes_cli/update_cmd_maint.py:236-278`): a systemd or launchd dashboard is restarted; a manually started one is stopped and may not come back (the host only prints "Re-launch it"); a failed Node refresh leaves the old dashboard running, so `version` doesn't change.

## Plan

- [ ] **Routes.** `HermesREST` cases for check, apply, status, receipt and health.
- [ ] **State machine.** A pure reducer, `checked → applying → recovering → done | partial | failed | needsDashboardRestart`, fed by scripted events: status replies, transport errors, 404s, health replies, receipts and ticks. Rules:
  - a transport error or 5xx while applying moves to `recovering`;
  - trust `receipt.outcome` over `exit_code`;
  - a null `exit_code` keeps waiting;
  - `done` only when `health.version == receipt.post_version`;
  - health silent for about 2 minutes after the action ended → `needsDashboardRestart`;
  - about 3 s cadence, about a 10-minute ceiling.
- [ ] **Shared restart wait.** Extract the probe loop from `HermexPushProvisioner.restartHermes` (`:490-525`) into one helper both use, rather than copying it. Push behavior and `HermexPushProvisioningTests` don't change.
- [ ] **After done:** refresh the saved server version and reconnect the shared gateway socket (it reconnects on `.active` today, `HermesMobile/Networking/Hermes/HermesGateway.swift:126`, not on a dashboard respawn). The status poll signs in again once on a 401 (`HermesConnection.data`).
- [ ] **Rows** in the Hermes server card (see Mocks). The update keeps running when Settings closes; reopening reads the receipt and the status to resume the display.

## Decisions

1. **Checks:** passive on open (the host caches 24 h), forced on tap.
2. **Non-self-updating installs:** show `update_command` with Copy (decided 2026-10-06).
3. **Confirm copy** names the consequence: running turns stop and Hermes restarts.
4. **Testing:** `needs-manual-validation`; apply only against a throwaway `scripts/local-hermes` copy, never the live host unless Uzair says so (decided 2026-10-06).

## Acceptance

- [ ] On a Hermes server, the card shows Up to date or Update available from the check.
- [ ] Update, after the confirm, sends one `POST /api/hermes/update` and moves through Updating and Restarting to Updated to <version>.
- [ ] A dashboard that drops mid-update is treated as restarting, not as a failure.
- [ ] A `partial` or `failed` receipt shows that outcome and the host's summary.
- [ ] A dashboard that never returns ends in Restart the dashboard on the host, with the command.
- [ ] A refused apply or `can_apply: false` shows the host's command with Copy.
- [ ] After done, the card's version is the new one, and a Hermes chat works without signing in again.
- [ ] webui update rows behave as before.

## Tests

These fail on today's code.
- **`HermesUpdateMachineTests`:** scripted sequences: a clean run; transport errors mid-run; a 404 status after respawn with a receipt; a null `exit_code` then a receipt; `partial`; `failed`; refused; `already_running`; health silent → `needsDashboardRestart`; a version mismatch.
- **`HermesUpdateClientTests`** (URLProtocol): each route's shape and the 401 re-sign-in.
- **`HermexPushProvisioningTests`** pass unchanged after the extraction.
- **Run:** `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermexPushProvisioningTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientUpdatesCheckTests --only HermesMobileTests/APIClientUpdatesApplyTests`, plus the new classes.

## Mocks

Required: the Hermes server card's update rows in each state (up to date, available, updating, restarting, updated, partial or failed, restart on the host, copy command), light and dark.

## Manual test

Device: the simulator against a **throwaway copy** of `scripts/local-hermes`'s cached clone, checked out a few commits behind the pin. Updating the cached clone in place moves it off the pin.
1. Settings. Expected: Update available with a commit count.
2. Update, confirm. Expected: Updating, Restarting, then Updated to <version>.
3. Stop the copy's dashboard during the update and leave it down. Expected: Restart the dashboard on the host, with the command.

## Surfaces

- **Entry points:** Settings' Hermes server card only.
- **Targets:** main app only.
- **Servers:** state is per server; switching servers mid-update leaves that server's update running and resumes its display on return.
- **Reverse states:** a check can be redone; an update can't be undone, so the confirm says so.
- **Connection modes:** the restart wait must hold through a Cloudflare tunnel, where a dropped dashboard reads as a 502 or 530.

## Preservation

#934: the push restart's wait and its re-sign-in after the dashboard's new session key.

## Blockers

None.

## Outside reach

Applying an update on any real host. Read-only checks on the live host are fine.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) in Claude Code in T3 Code.

title: feat(hermes): list and open sessions on a Hermes server
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1046

## What changed

On a Hermes server nothing listed or reopened old sessions: the inbox could only start new ones. The inbox's + menu (Debug and Branch builds, `HermesSessionEntry`) now offers **Sessions**: one Profile's sessions, newest first, with the host's unread dots and live states. A row opens in the main chat.

- **REST:** `HermesREST.sessionList(profile:offset:)` sends the issue's full query. `updateSession` is the `PATCH {unread, profile}` helper that later slices extend.
- **Rows:** `HermesSessionPage` decodes tolerantly and skips a bad row. It never reads `total`, dedupes by `_lineage_root_id ?? id` and drops the archived pinned back-fill. A page under 100 rows ends paging. Untitled rows show `preview`. Hermes rows keep only Copy Full Title and Mark as Read/Unread.
- **List:** `HermesSessionListView` runs on `SessionListViewModel` with a Hermes source. It has "Load more" paging and host unread, with an optimistic PATCH and rollback, marked read again after returning from a chat. `session.active_list` states re-read every 5 s while a row is busy, and `sessions.changed` reloads after a 1 s debounce (newest read wins). `session.most_recent {profile}` makes the host watch that Profile. A removed Profile (4064 or 404) moves to the saved pick or `current`. The Profile menu writes `HermesProfilePreference` (#1015).
- **Attachment titles:** `MessageAttachment.hermesTitle` drops whole and cut-off reference lines. The chat header falls back to the first prompt's attachment.
- **Review fixes:** a list read that starts during "Load more" now reads that page too. `profiles.list` is cancellation-safe, so pushing a chat can't detach the list's client, and a `.stale` read reconnects. The list stops reconnecting on the refusals the inbox stops on (`BotConnectionAdvice.isRetryable`).

Decisions: [2026-10-06](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1046#issuecomment-6021462961) (1–5) and the [attachment-title rule](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1046#issuecomment-6006176791). **Deviation, for Uzair:** a photo-only row reads "Untitled Session" until the host's model title arrives. The host cuts its instant title (48 characters) and `preview` (60) inside the 35-character upload prefix, before the photo's name. The chat header does show the name. Contract checked against `scripts/local-hermes` (0.21.5, `ca678285`) with seeded data, plus a read-only `curl` of the live `GET /api/sessions` (keys and types only).

## How it was tested

- Full suite on `a0baca4b` (the Xcode project changed): 3935 passed, 4 skipped. After the review fixes, 13 classes with `--only` (HermesSessionListTests, HermesGatewayTests, BotInboxTests, BotClientTests, HermesChatTurnTests, HermesChatSettingsTests, APIClientSessionListTests, SessionNavigationStateTests and other `profiles.list` callers): 277 passed. BotConversationTests, BotRoomTests, BotChatPresentationTests and HermesAgentFixtureTests: 186 passed, 2 skipped.
- Rebased onto `ec205c2d` (master moved by test and CI changes only): HermesSessionListTests, APIClientSessionListTests, SessionNavigationStateTests, SessionRowAttentionStateTests, BotInboxTests, HermesConversationTests, HermesChatTurnTests, HermesGatewayTests and BotChatPresentationTests, 237 passed.
- Red on the unfixed code. Header: `"[The user attached an image: …]" != "IMG_2041.jpg"`. Load more: "Nothing changed while waiting for: both pages applied". Refusal: `sessionLoadError nil != .outdated`. `.stale`: the reconnect wait timed out. Gateway: `transport` instead of `CancellationError`. The list, REST and decode tests can't compile against the old API.
- String Catalog check passes, with no new strings.

## Checklist

- [x] Local validation with `scripts/test-sim`, recorded above
- [x] New `Codable` models decode tolerantly
- [x] No new third-party dependencies
- [x] No invented endpoints or JSON shapes (pinned upstream source and the local and live servers)

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator. Sign in with `scripts/sim-login <udid> --hermes` to `scripts/local-hermes` with two Profiles and more than 100 sessions in one.
1. iPhone: Inbox + → Sessions, then scroll to the end while an agent streams. Expected: pinned rows come first and untitled rows show their first prompt. "Load more" pages in the rest with no repeats and never stays greyed out.
2. iPhone: Open an older session and send. Go back, tap another row right away, then go back again. Expected: the reply streams in and the row moves to the top. Both dots stay cleared on the host's web dashboard.
3. iPhone: On the dashboard, open another session and then stream a reply in it. Expected: the phone's dot clears. The row shows Working, settles, and moves to the top without pull-to-refresh. Mark as Unread shows a dot on the dashboard.
4. iPhone: Switch Profile from the list, open a row, background the app, return, then go back. Expected: the list and the composer chip show the new Profile, and the list reconnects and refreshes.
5. iPad: Inbox + → Sessions, open a row, then go back. Expected: the chat shows its transcript, and the list is still current.

title: feat(hermes): browse and toggle skills on Hermes
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1069. Part of #705.

## What changed

Skills worked only on webui servers, and its list and detail screens built their own `APIClient`, so a Hermes server could neither list skills nor turn them on or off.

- **Data client.** A `SkillsDataClient` protocol (list, content, toggle, and a `SkillsFeatures` value) now sits under `SkillsViewModel` and both `SkillDetailView` reads. `APIClient` conforms with its existing calls, so webui sends the same requests as before.
- **Hermes client.** `HermesSkillsClient` is bound to one Profile over the server's shared `HermesConnection`: `GET /api/skills?profile=`, `GET /api/skills/content?name=&profile=`, and `PUT /api/skills/toggle` with `{name, enabled, profile}`. New `HermesREST` cases are `setSkill(name:enabled:profile:)` and `skillContent(name:profile:)`. The `enabled`-to-`disabled` decode is shared with `HermesCronClient.cronSkills`, and refusals read the host's `{detail}` through the now-internal `HermesCronClient.accepted`. A 200 that is not an array is a failed read, not an empty list. The content reply's host `path` is never decoded. `SkillsFeatures.hermes` hides linked files until #1070.
- **Toggle failure.** A failed toggle rolls the row back and shows a "Could Not Update Skill" alert with the reason, on Hermes and webui (webui used to roll back silently).
- **Entry.** A temporary "Skills" item in the Hermes home's + menu, after Kanban, behind the same `HermesSessionEntry` gate. It opens on the selected Profile via `openOnSelectedProfile`; the Profile is the subtitle on iOS 26 and part of the title ("Skills · default") before that.
- Docs: "Skills on a Hermes host" in `docs/agents/bots.md`. Two catalog keys with all 17 translations.

Applies the [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1069#issuecomment-6022525992) (decisions 1-3; `fs/read-text` left to #1070). Defaults taken: the content 404 shows the host's own "Skill 'x' not found." in the existing "Could Not Load Skill" state; `HermesCronRefusal` keeps its name. Contract evidence is in a comment below.

## How it was tested

- `git diff --check` is clean.
- `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only` HermesSkillsClientTests (6, new), SkillsViewModelTests (5, 2 new), APIClientSkillEndpointTests, HermesCronClientTests, HermesRequestTests, LocalizationCatalogTests and CronJobEditorConfigurationTests, run as each fix landed (last on 00641449). Rebased onto ec205c2d: the six changed-area classes plus BotChatPresentationTests and ResponseSelectionTests (changed on master): 100 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed on 8ba2e50f. The failure, `BotChatPresentationTests.testSettledTurnHidesItsInterimReplyBehindTheWorkedForRow`, is OCR reading "2h42s" for "2h 42s" since #1090's 1x captures; it fails the same way on master ec205c2d on the same iPhone Air simulator.
- Full suite (the Xcode project changed), in three `--only` chunks over all 262 classes: 3923 passed, 4 skipped, 1 failed. The failure, `ComposerVoiceInputServerRecordingTests.testInterruptedRecordingRetainsClipUntilUnlockedAndTranscribesOnce`, checks the global idle timer that this PR doesn't touch; it passed alone on master and on this branch, and as its whole class (14/14) here.
- Red: the new tests can't compile on the old code ("Cannot find type 'SkillsDataClient' in scope", "Cannot find type 'HermesSkillsClient' in scope"), since today's screens accept only `APIClient`. The non-array test failed on 397fd0b3 with "got 0 skills".
- No screenshots: on both attempts another agent-device session held the lane's simulator (DEVICE_IN_USE), so the Manual test below covers the screens.

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator
1. Sign in with `scripts/sim-login <udid> --hermes` against `scripts/local-hermes`, then + → Skills. Expected: the Profile's skills under uppercase category headers, disabled ones included, with "Skills" over "default". On an iOS 18 simulator the title reads "Skills · default".
2. Turn a skill off, go back, open Skills again. Expected: still off. Open it. Expected: its SKILL.md, with no Linked Files section. Turn it back on.
3. Stop `scripts/local-hermes` and flip a switch. Expected: a "Could Not Update Skill" alert with the reason, and the switch returns to where it was.
4. [A webui server as well] Switch to it and open Skills from the sidebar, then a skill with linked files. Expected: unchanged, linked files listed.
5. iPad Pro 11-inch: + → Skills, open a skill, then go back twice. Expected: both push inside the Hermes home and return to the inbox cleanly.

title: feat(hermes): edit memory and soul on Hermes
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1073 · Part of #705 (slice 5.4).

## What changed

On a Hermes server, Memory had no entry point, and a raw save trips the agent's drift check, after which it refuses to `replace` or `remove` memory entries.

- **Canonicalizer.** `MemoryCanonicalizer` writes MEMORY.md and USER.md in the agent's format: no BOM, LF only, a line trimming to `§` separates, entries trimmed as Python's `str.strip`, empties and repeats dropped, joined by `\n§\n` with no trailing newline. `scalarCount` counts like Python's `len`.
- **Client.** `MemoryDataClient` on the CronDataClient pattern: `APIClient` keeps webui's calls; `HermesMemoryClient` reads the memories folder only from the Profile's `profiles.list` row (never shown, logged or kept) and decodes only `memory` from `/api/config`. A 404 reads as empty; `truncated`/`binary` is read-only. Save: canonicalize, re-read and refuse with `MemoryConflict` if the file changed (unless it already holds the draft, a retry after a lost reply), write, mkdir once on "Parent directory does not exist", read back. Soul: the same check, then `PUT /api/profiles/{name}/soul`.
- **HermesREST.** `fsReadText(path:)` (same case as #1070; `+` sent as `%2B`), `fsWriteText`, `filesMkdir`, `config(profile:)`, `profileSoul`, `setProfileSoul`.
- **Screen**, [design A](https://679ya9gy8i3b.postplan.dev#issue-1073) per the [decision](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1073#issuecomment-6022527723): the count under the editor title beside Save (red "N over", Save off); a "Changed on the host" banner with Reload above the editor; the footer "Edits apply from the agent's next session." Hidden sections, a lock on read-only files (Save off if Reload finds one), no mtimes or project context, the Profile as nav subtitle (iOS 26+).
- **Entry.** "Memory" in the inbox's + menu after Kanban, same DEBUG/Branch gate. Docs: `docs/agents/bots.md` § Memory on a Hermes host. 8 catalog keys, 17 languages. webui Memory is unchanged.

## How it was tested

- `scripts/test-sim <iPhone 18 Pro> --only` MemoryCanonicalizer, HermesMemoryClient, MemoryViewModel, APIClientMemoryEndpoint, HermesRequest, LocalizationCatalog, BotInbox: **97 passed**. After the review fixes, the four Memory classes: **35 passed**; MemoryViewModel + LocalizationCatalog: **19 passed**. `ci/check_string_catalog.py` covers all 2238 keys.
- Red: a stub canonicalizer writing raw text failed 6 of 7 `MemoryCanonicalizerTests` (drift on `"a\n\n§\n\nb\n"`; 👍🏽 counted 1, not 2). `testARetryAfterASaveThatLandedIsNotAConflict` threw `MemoryConflict`, and `testASectionReloadFindsReadOnlyIsNotSent` sent one save, before their fixes. The other new tests can't compile against the old API.
- Contract on `scripts/local-hermes --port 9173` (ca678285, 0.21.5); nothing written to the live host. After a Hermex-format save the agent's own `MemoryStore` replaces and removes entries; today's raw save of the same draft fails with "Refusing to write MEMORY.md … wouldn't round-trip".

## Checklist

- [x] Local validation passes using `scripts/test-sim <assigned-simulator-udid>` with the tests required by `AGENTS.md` § Verifying; the selection and results are recorded above
- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly (optionals for fields the server might add or rename)
- [x] No new third-party dependencies (the list in `AGENTS.md` is locked)
- [x] No invented API endpoints or JSON shapes (verified against upstream source or a running server)

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator
Signed in with `scripts/sim-login <udid> --hermes` against `scripts/local-hermes`.
1. iPhone: + → Memory. Expected: "Memory" with "default" under it; My Notes, User Profile and Agent Soul, no Project Context or "Modified … ago". Add an entry to My Notes and save, then ask the agent to remove it. Expected: it's removed, with no "Refusing to write".
2. iPhone: open My Notes, change MEMORY.md on the host (`hermes` CLI or a second chat), then Save. Expected: the "Changed on the host" banner above the editor with the draft kept; Reload replaces it with the host's text.
3. iPhone: type past 2,200 characters. Expected: "N / 2,200 · M over" in red under the title, and Save disabled.
4. iPhone: edit Agent Soul (no count, the next-session footer), save, then open the Bot's Profile editor. Expected: the same soul text.
5. iPad Pro 11-inch: + → Memory, open My Notes. Expected: the sheet shows the count under the title, the footer note, and after step 2's host edit, the banner with Reload.
