title: bug(chat): MEDIA image stays on the loading tile after /api/media returns 200
body:
### Steps to reproduce

1. On iPhone Hermex, open a Hermes chat against a self-hosted hermes-webui.
2. Ask the agent to generate an image. The assistant reply includes a local `MEDIA:` path to a PNG. In this case the file is a normal PNG, 1024×1344, 1,472,283 bytes.
3. Leave the chat open after the reply text has finished rendering.

### Expected behavior

The inline image thumbnail paints, and tapping it opens the preview.

If the bytes cannot be decoded, the row should leave the loading state and show "Media unavailable" instead of spinning indefinitely.

### Actual behavior

The rest of the assistant message renders, including the text and an ordinary link card. The image stays on the gray rounded loading tile with a spinner.

That tile is `TranscriptMediaThumbnailView.thumbnailContent` while `didAttemptLoad == false` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/TranscriptMediaView.swift`). `didAttemptLoad` is set only after `TranscriptImageCache` returns and the view task has not been cancelled. A failed decode would show "Media unavailable", which did not happen.

hermes-webui logged six finished requests from the phone, all HTTP 200, with a handler time of about 4–8 ms:

`GET /api/media?session_id=<session>&path=<absolute png path>`

Local times (UTC+8) on 2026-10-09: 16:40:47, 16:40:57, 16:43:04, 16:43:09, 16:45:52, 16:46:53.

The query is `session_id` then `path`, matching `Endpoint.media` in `HermesMobile/Networking/Endpoints.swift`. The web page builds `api/media?path=` first, so this caller is the app, not the web UI. The file on disk is a valid PNG, and that is the file `/api/media` serves.

### Impact

Blocks work completely

An agent reply that contains a picture never becomes visible on the phone. Text chat still works.

### App version / commit

Not shown on the phone screenshot (2026-10-09 16:43). Current `master` still has this loading tile and this `/api/media` query shape.

### iOS version and device

iPhone. The exact iOS version was not recorded.

### hermes-webui server version

Deployed commit `c67fd2d` of nesquena/hermes-webui (2026-07-18).

### How the phone reaches the server

Reverse proxy. The webui access log shows a forwarded client, and the immediate peer is loopback.

### Screenshots or screen recordings

The screenshot shows a gray rounded rectangle, about the thumbnail size, with a spinner in the center, directly above the rest of the assistant message. There is no "Media unavailable" chip.

### Not a duplicate

- #70 is closed. That bug was `GET /api/media` without `session_id`, HTTP 403, and the "Media unavailable" chip. This request includes `session_id` and returns 200. The UI is still the loading tile.
- #145 asks for MEDIA rendering in general. The image loader now exists; this report is that loader not finishing after a successful response.
- #1118 is saving or sharing a zero-byte MEDIA file. This PNG is about 1.4 MB.

Hypothesis only: the SwiftUI `.task` is cancelled before it applies the image, which resets `didAttemptLoad` and issues another GET. Repeated 200 responses while the spinner stays up fit that, but this was not confirmed from the device.

title: fix(hermes): declare the hermex session source on create and resume
body:
## Linked issue

Related: NousResearch/hermes-agent#135575 (server-side counterpart: the `hermex` platform hint + reattach source adoption). There was no existing Hermex issue for the capability-guidance mismatch itself; #1118 / #1133 concern already-emitted media.

## What changed

Bot Mode sessions omitted `source`, so the gateway's env fallback stamped them `tui` and the model was told there is no attachment channel and `MEDIA:` tags print as literal text — while Hermex's chat actually parses those tags into artifact rows and downloads them through the authenticated `/api/fs/download` route.

Hermex now declares its own surface, `hermex`, on every session it opens:

- `sessionCreate` (Bot Chat mint) — `source: "hermex"`
- `sessionNew` (plain session) — `source: "hermex"`
- `sessionResume` — `source: "hermex"` (also lets a host with the reattach fix correct a live session left on the wrong surface after a reconnect)

The name matches the platform hint added in the hermes-agent PR above. On hosts without that hint the source is simply recorded and yields an empty hint — no worse than the `tui` mis-tag, and nothing else keys off unknown sources (toolset gating only special-cases `desktop`). Request-shape tests updated; no new dependencies, no new endpoints.

- `HermesRequestTests` / `BotLifecycleTests` param assertions updated to expect `source: "hermex"` on the three calls.

- The server half was verified against a live gateway with Hermex-shaped calls: create/resume with `source: "hermex"` records `hermex`; authenticated `/api/fs/download` returns real file bytes (404 missing/bogus, 401 anonymous).

title: fix(hermes): two Git-write edge cases left from #1115
body:
**Problem:** #1115's third independent review found two rare defects in Hermes Git writes:

1. **Commit Selected misreports its restore when filenames have spaces at either end.** If a tracked ` a.txt` (leading space) is staged and a clean `a.txt` exists, the host reports the staged row as `a.txt`. Restore then stages the clean sibling, leaves ` a.txt` unstaged, and reports success. Only the staged set is affected; no file content is lost.
2. **A stale error alert after a folder change.** When a quick commit fails and the folder changes while its recovery refresh is still pending, the write returns `.failure` instead of `.retired`. The old repo's error alert then appears in the new folder. `ChatView` needs a retirement check after the await.

**Fix:** (2) recheck `isRetired` after the recovery refresh and guard the alert in `ChatView`, with one test. (1) refuse Commit Selected up front when a remembered staged name has spaces at either end or its trimmed form matches another tracked path. At minimum, check the index after restore and report a failed restore. Add one test.

**Origin:** run t3-epic-703-20261009T010352Z-m8odf859. #1115 shipped at its review cap, and Uzair chose to track these here (2026-10-09).

title: feat(hermes): stage, discard, commit and push from a Hermes chat
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1115 · Stacked on #1130

## What changed

**Problem:** a Hermes chat's Git panel was read-only, and the host runs every Git write unguarded: no turn lock, a commit with nothing staged runs `git add -A`, a file-less revert wipes the tree, and push silently does nothing on a detached HEAD.

**Fix:** the Git menu, commit sheet and inline commit button now stage, unstage, discard, commit (all staged or selected, with an AI-suggested message over `llm.oneshot`) and push through `HermesGitClient`, which holds the guards: no write while the chat's turn runs or on cached data, zero-staged commits and conflicted rows refused, push refused on a detached HEAD, and every write re-reads status. Fetch, Pull and the branch picker stay webui-only.

**Decisions applied** ([decision](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1115#issuecomment-6072292450), [ship](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1115#issuecomment-6082060576)): a refused write shows generic copy, never git's stderr; the detached-HEAD refusal is specific. webui is unchanged; the re-read after a failed write and "Commit <sha>" are Hermes-only. Commit Selected refuses up front when a staged file is partly staged, unknown past the 200-file cap, or renamed, and before the first commit.

**Safety:** writes send `file` as `:(literal)<path>`; blank, absolute, `.` and `..` paths are refused; ownership (turn, cached data, folder change) is rechecked at every request. The Git menu and commit sheet share one write lock per repository, so a quick commit (including its message wait) and the sheet's writes never overlap; the other surface's write controls disable meanwhile.

**Known limits**
1. Commit Selected is refused while a staged file is partly staged, unknown past the cap, renamed, or has a blank or duplicated path: the host can put back only whole files.
2. Commit Selected is refused before the first commit (the host's file-less unstage needs a HEAD); the copy points to Commit.
3. A staged rename can't be discarded or unstaged here: the host's row names only its new path.
4. A tracked name with leading/trailing spaces is trimmed by the host; if two rows then share a path, writes to it are refused.
5. If Commit Selected's reply is lost after a write went out, it puts the staged files back first; if that fails too, it says so.

**Known follow-up:** #1135 (Commit Selected restore vs host-trimmed names; an old-folder error alert after a failed quick commit's refresh).

## How it was tested

`scripts/test-sim <udid> --only` APIClientGitTests, GitWorkspaceViewModelTests, HermesRequestTests, HermesChatAttachmentTests, LocalizationCatalogTests, ChatGitControlsVisibilityPolicyTests, HermesGatewayTests: **159 passed, 0 failed** on 007c1e7f; `ci/check_string_catalog.py`: 2301 keys covered; `git diff --check` clean.
On fd8e7b83, +3 tests (the menu/sheet write lock both ways; a selected new file's suggestion before the first commit): APIClientGitTests, GitWorkspaceViewModelTests, HermesChatAttachmentTests, ChatGitControlsVisibilityPolicyTests **131 passed, 0 failed**; all 3 red on 007c1e7f (e.g. the sheet's Commit Selected ran during the quick commit's message wait; "No commit message could be generated.").
Red first: 1 new test red on the base (`supportsWrites` false, no push sent); 19 red before the path/ownership round (e.g. `testAGitWriteNamesOneExactFile`: did not throw); 5 red before the last round (e.g. a lost reset reply sent `[unstage (all)]` with no restore).
Wire shapes verified on `scripts/local-hermes` (ca678285) with a throwaway repo, including `:(literal)*` touching only the file named `*` and push answering `{ok:true}` on a detached HEAD.

## Screenshots

Head 007c1e7f, iPhone 17e, `scripts/local-hermes` with a throwaway repo. Git menu with writes, commit sheet, new-file discard confirmation, Commit Selected refused (p.txt partly staged; index unchanged), "Commit <sha>", Hermes push confirmation, detached-HEAD refusal.

![Git menu](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5386f205-6004-4722-bc1e-ce3018e28439) ![Commit sheet](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/58020806-30c0-4e37-80e9-1096e8706712) ![Discard confirmation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c3bac20b-1d68-412c-9cad-3683c8f4f488) ![Commit Selected refusal](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/45c989eb-03af-4e24-9dec-f65d9d3ab331) ![Commit sha](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9018fa53-fa2d-4dd0-946f-aa9f3fe15ef2) ![Push confirmation](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bbc909b9-ca50-4177-ab54-c9ce8b0279c0) ![Detached HEAD refusal](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ac320093-097f-4352-ad84-999e2ae53cd7)

## Checklist

- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly
- [x] No new third-party dependencies

## Manual test

Device: iPhone simulator, iPad simulator
Setup: `scripts/local-hermes`, a Hermes chat on a throwaway repo with an upstream remote.
1. Edit two files, add one untracked. Git menu → Stage Changes and the Write section show; commit sheet stages, unstages and discards (new-file discard warns it deletes the file).
2. Commit with a suggested message → the sheet shows "Commit <sha>". Edit again, Commit from the Git menu and open Stage Changes while "Generating commit message" shows → Stage, Unstage, Discard and Commit stay disabled until the toast finishes. Push → confirmation names the branch, the remote moves.
3. Partly stage a file, select another, Commit Selected → refusal asking to fully stage or unstage; index unchanged. Then `git checkout --detach`, refresh, Push → "Cannot push from a detached HEAD"; nothing moves.
4. In a new repo with no commits, select a new file in Stage Changes, tap Suggest → a message appears.

title: feat(hermes): switch branches from a Hermes chat
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1116 · Stacked on #1136

## What changed

**Problem:** a Hermes chat hid the composer's branch picker, though the host has branch list and switch routes (`/api/git/branches`, `/api/git/branch/switch`). The host's `git switch` carries a dirty tree across and fails on `origin/<name>`.

**Fix:** `HermesGitClient` gains `branches()` and `checkout(_:)`, behind the same `GitDataClient` protocol webui now uses. The picker shows on Hermes once #1114's repository check passes, lists Local and Remote, and after a switch re-reads status, info and branches.

**Decisions applied** ([decision](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1116#issuecomment-6072292659)): a dirty tree is refused with "Commit or discard first."; the existing picker, no new design; webui unchanged (New branch, stash prompt, #1005's 409 copy); New branch, stash, Fetch and Pull hidden on Hermes (`supportsSync` is webui-only).

**Safety:** a switch needs a fresh `git/status` with `changed == 0`, which counts untracked files and files past the 200-row cap; a missing count refuses too. A branch name the host's `_sanitize_branch` would rewrite is refused before sending, checked per Unicode scalar (the pinned host turned `café` into an existing `cafe`). A remote row switches by its short name only when that name is unique: the list is re-read before the switch, and an ambiguous row (two remotes, or a name that is now local) is refused with the existing write-failure copy. The switch holds #1115's shared write lock, so it never overlaps a commit or push and the chip disables meanwhile. A result that lands after a folder change is retired and shows nothing.

**Composer gate:** the picker is no longer wrapped in `showsSessionControls` (false on Hermes). **Integration note:** #1117 / #1120 edits the adjacent `workspaceSelector` line in `ChatComposerView`; resolve at integration.

## How it was tested

`scripts/test-sim <udid> --only` HermesRequestTests, APIClientGitTests, GitWorkspaceViewModelTests: **126 passed, 0 failed** on f9fb6df8; BotChatPresentationTests 52 passed, 2 skipped on cdab9ad0; `git diff --check` clean.

Wire shapes verified on `scripts/local-hermes` (ca678285) with a throwaway repo: the list, a clean switch, `origin/feature/x` → 400, `feature/x` → 200 with upstream, a dirty switch carrying the edit across.

## Screenshots

Branch chip, picker (Local; Remote with only Reload, no New branch), after switching to origin/feature/x (now local, chip `feature/x`), dirty-tree refusal (repo stayed on feature/x), Git menu without Fetch/Pull. title: fix(hermes): Files stalls on a home-folder chat, and other merge-walk findings
body:
**What the user gets:** Files on a Hermes chat opens fast in any folder, and Save to Files works in a brand-new chat.
**Why it matters:** Found in the epic #703 merge walk. New Hermes chats start in the home folder, so the first Files open fails every folder and freezes the host for ~30 s.
**Cost:** Small; simulator-testable against a real host (no phone needed).

Follow-up to #1119, #1120 and #1137. The owner chose to fix these after the stack merged rather than restack it.

## 1. Home-folder Files stalls the host (main fix)
- Files auto-expands every non-hidden top-level folder on first open (`FileTree.defaultExpandedPaths`), so a home folder fires ~13 `/api/fs/list` calls at once.
- The host answers them one at a time, and macOS-protected folders (Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Movies, Music) each block 6–11 s before returning `{entries: [], error: "Interrupted system call"}`.
- Measured through the tunnel: 13 parallel lists took 28 s; `projects` alone took 0.1 s. The app's 15 s request timeout (`HermesConnection` `timeoutIntervalForRequest`) fails every folder (`-1001`), and the host is busy for the whole time.
- Proposed fix: a Hermes chat's Files opens with folders collapsed and lists a folder only when tapped. Keep the webui default.
- The host blocking on protected folders is upstream hermes-agent behavior; worth a separate upstream report.

## 2. Save to Files fails before the first message
In a new Hermes chat, before any message is sent, Files lists and previews, but Export shows "This file could not be opened…". After one message it works. The download is anchored to a session the host hasn't stored yet.

## 3. Smaller nits
- The Git menu keeps a stale status after changes made outside the app until the next turn ends (reopening the menu doesn't refresh it).
- The branch picker's Remote section shows a bare `origin` row (likely `origin/HEAD`).
- On iPhone 17e with the keyboard up, the branch picker popover is clipped at its search field: later remote rows are unreachable, and tapping search closes the picker. The `GitBranchPickerView` popover is pre-existing (webui shares it).
- Push on a detached HEAD asks "Push HEAD to its upstream remote…?" before refusing; it could refuse up front.
- A 3-line file ending in a newline previews as "4 lines".

title: feat(hermes): show the plan and the turn outcome in every Hermes chat
body:
**What the user gets:** Any Hermes chat shows the agent's plan as "2 of 5 · current step", and a failed turn says why, when a rate limit resets, and offers Retry or the billing page.
**Why it matters:** The regular chat ignores `todo.updated` and shows a failure as one line of error text, while Bot Chat has both. #1127 slice 1.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`.

Part of #1127 in epic #713 · **Blocked by:** none · **Unblocks:** #1140, #1146

## Problem and outcome
- `HermesChatTurnCoordinator.apply` (`Features/Chat/HermesChatTurnCoordinator.swift:863-940`) drops `todo.updated` in `default`; the snapshot's `todo_state` is never read.
- `complete(_:)` (`:957-984`) turns a failure into `streamCoordinatorDidReceiveErrorMessage` text only.
After: the plan pinned above the composer while it has open steps (mock B, https://3vl79i2rkrbv.postplan.dev/v/1), settling into the turn as a row once done, and Bot Chat's outcome row under the failed or warned turn. webui unchanged.

## Contract (pin `ca678285`)

- Plan: `todo.updated` payload and the `session.resume` reply's `todo_state` are `{todos:[{id,content,status}], revision}` (`tui_gateway/tool_progress.py:112-125, 152-157, 320-325`). Emitted for every session, independent of `display.tool_progress`. **An empty `todos` at `revision >= 1` is a real clear** (`:122-124`); Bot Chat's `BotPlan.init` returns nil for it, so the plan sticks today (`BotConversation.swift:675, 725`).
- Outcome: `message.complete` carries `status` (`complete|interrupted|error`), `error`, `recoverable`, `partial`, `error_surface {layer, code, retryable, message?, resets_at?}`, `warning`, `billing`, `failure_reason`, `persisted_turn` (`prompt_turn.py:812-875`). The failed turn is retained in resume's inflight payload.

## Plan
- [ ] **Seam.** A small `HermesChatActivity` (`@MainActor @Observable`, owned by the coordinator) holds `plan` and `outcome`, so the 1.5k-line coordinator only forwards frames. #1140 adds delegated work to it.
- [ ] **Move, don't copy.** `BotPlan` (`Bots/BotActivity.swift:1-35`), `BotPlanRowView` (`Bots/BotActivityViews.swift:25-99`) and `BotTurnOutcomeRow` (`Bots/BotTurnOutcomeRow.swift`) move to `Features/Chat/` with Hermes names; Bot Chat imports them from there until #1148 deletes it.
- [ ] **Plan.** Revision-monotonic from `todo.updated` and the attach's `todo_state`; an empty list at `revision >= 1` clears it (fix the Bot Chat gap in the move). A reset attach drops it.
- [ ] **Outcome.** `HermesTurnOutcome` (`Networking/Hermes/HermesTurnOutcome.swift`) from `message.complete` and resume's inflight failure; Retry resends the host's raw `inflight.user`, once, from a tap (#878, #937, #508). Billing link opens Safari. Cleared by the next accepted prompt.
- [ ] **Pinned strip (mock B).** While the plan has an open step, a one-line glass strip above the composer: checklist icon, "N of M", the current step, a chevron. Tap expands the list upward (`ChatMotion`, instant under Reduce Motion); long-press copies it. VoiceOver: "Plan, 2 of 5, <step>".
- [ ] **Settled row.** When every step is done or cancelled, or the turn ends, the strip leaves and the plan settles as `BotPlanRowView`'s log row at the top of that turn. A clear removes both.
- [ ] **Stacking.** Above the composer, bottom to top: composer, request card (#1141's cards share the slot), plan strip, run-status pill. The `/btw` panel's full-screen cover hides the strip like the rest. The strip hides on a cached/offline view.

## Decisions
- Every Hermes chat, not webui (#1127 decision 1).
- **Mock B (Uzair, 2026-10-09):** the plan pins above the composer while it runs, as in Hermes Desktop, and settles into the turn when done.
- Outcome row is design C from #878, unchanged.
- A plan clear at `revision >= 1` hides the row (host contract), a change from Bot Chat.

## Acceptance
- [ ] A turn that calls `todo` pins "N of M · step" above the composer live and after a reattach; expanding lists every item; once done it settles into the turn as a row.
- [ ] A host clear removes the row; an older revision never replaces a newer one.
- [ ] A rate-limited turn shows title, raw error, reset time and Retry; Retry sends `inflight.user` once.
- [ ] A `warning` shows "Reply shown but not saved" with the host's words.

## Tests
`HermesChatTurnTests` (plan from frame and snapshot, revision order, clear, reset on new runtime; outcome from `message.complete` and inflight, Retry text, no auto-resend). Move `BotActivityTests`' plan cases with the type.

## Validation
`scripts/test-sim <udid> --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotActivityTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotConversationTests`. Simulator: ask for a 4-step todo plan; force a failure with a bad model on `scripts/local-hermes`.

## Non-goals
Delegated work (#1140). Plan in the Live Activity (#706).

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code (T3 Code) during #1127 intake.

title: feat(hermes): follow and interrupt delegated work from any Hermes chat
body:
**What the user gets:** While an agent has workers running, a toolbar button shows how many; it opens a sheet to read each worker's recent output or stop it. When the workers finish, the transcript shows a "2 workers completed" card that opens the report.
**Why it matters:** Only Bot Chat has this today; in a regular chat a delegation finishes as unexplained text. #1127 slice 1.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`.

Part of #1127 · **Blocked by:** #1139 (shares `HermesChatActivity`) · **Unblocks:** #1146

## Contract (pin `ca678285`)

- Delegation: `subagent.start/thinking/tool/progress/complete` emitted for every session, also with tool progress off (`tool_progress.py:443-447`). `subagent.list/interrupt/tail` require the session's own transport (`methods_subagents.py:53-116`, 4001 otherwise). Completion rows are transcript rows with `display_kind: "async_delegation_complete"`; `HermesTranscriptHistory.swift:248-254` already maps them to role `delegation_completion`, but `ChatTranscriptView` draws nothing special for it.

## Plan
- [ ] **Generalize `BotDelegatedWork`** (`Bots/BotDelegatedWork.swift:118-381`) from a `BotConversation` generation to a `HermesConversation` attach: refresh on connect, on a user tap, and on coalesced `subagent.*` lifecycle frames; tails stay opt-in reads (16 KB). Owned by `HermesChatActivity`.
- [ ] **Toolbar entry (mock B).** Its own small glass toolbar button after `ChatView`'s trailing `ChatToolbarActionCluster` (`ChatView.swift:1042-1068`): `person.2` and a plain monochrome count, no badge color, only while `activeCount > 0`. VoiceOver: "Delegated work, N active workers". Sheet is `BotDelegatedWorkView` moved to `Features/Chat/`.
- [ ] **Completion card.** `ChatTranscriptView` draws role `delegation_completion` as `BotDelegationCompletionCard` (moved), with the results sheet. Today it falls through to a plain row.
- [ ] Interrupt confirms first ("Hermex cannot resume it"), as in Bot Chat.

## Decisions
- Toolbar button with a count and a sheet (#1127 decision 1). **Mock B (Uzair, 2026-10-09):** its own glass button beside the cluster, monochrome count.
- No polling: count changes only on lifecycle frames and explicit refresh (performance rule).

## Acceptance
- [ ] Two delegated workers show a count of 2; the sheet lists both; Show tail reads output; Interrupt stops one and the count drops.
- [ ] A finished delegation draws the completion card live and after reload.
- [ ] The button hides when no worker is active, and on a cached/offline view.

## Tests
`BotDelegatedWorkTests` moved and pointed at a `HermesConversation` double (refresh triggers, 4001 handling, stale generation drops a late reply). `HermesTranscriptPagingTests` or a transcript presentation test: a `delegation_completion` row maps to the card.

## Validation
`--only HermesMobileTests/BotDelegatedWorkTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests`. Simulator: prompt `scripts/local-hermes` to delegate two tasks; open the sheet; interrupt one.

## Non-goals
Steering a worker (`subagent.steer`). Worker progress in the Live Activity.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code (T3 Code) during #1127 intake.

title: feat(hermes): desktop-task and app-connection cards and Update sign-in in Hermes chats
body:
**What the user gets:** When Hermes Desktop is handling something, the chat says so and offers Stop instead of a bare "Waiting for you". When the agent asks to connect an app, the user can connect, skip, or continue without it from the phone. A refused password shows "Update sign-in" and never resends.
**Why it matters:** Regular Hermes chats refuse connection requests (`HermesChatRequests.swift:94-98`) and show only a waiting pill for Desktop tasks; Bot Chat handles both (#786, #884, #942). #1127 slice 1.
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator against `scripts/local-hermes`.

Part of #1127 · **Blocked by:** none · **Unblocks:** #1145, #1146

## Contract (pin `ca678285`)

- Requests: `connection.request` is a session event, `connection.update` session or global, answered by `connection.respond` (`agent_callbacks.py:154`, `methods_connectors.py:346-435`); resume carries `pending_connection` (`server.py:743, 2912`). Desktop tasks are server requests the phone never answers.

## Plan
- [ ] **`HermesChatRequests`**: `.desktopTask` and `.connection` become shown requests (`isAnsweredHere` stays false for desktop tasks: shown, never answered). `connection.respond` goes through the engine's guarded `answer`, once per tap. `connection.update` (session and global) updates the card; resume's `pending_connection` restores it.
- [ ] **Cards** above the composer in the existing request slot (`ChatView.swift:1705-1730`, #1127 decision 4), using `BotPendingRequestCard`'s desktop-task and connection bodies, moved to `Features/Chat/`. Copy says "Hermes" where Bot Chat says "This bot" (see mock).
- [ ] **Stop** on the desktop-task card is the chat's Stop (asks only when something would be lost).
- [ ] **Update sign-in**: a refused password (`BotFailure` auth) sets `needsSignIn`, holds a composer pill, and suppresses `recover()` (#884, #942). Tapping opens the same Hermes sign-in form the Bots inbox opens (`BotsInboxView.swift:332-335`); the chat's owner passes the callback.
- [ ] **Busy:** confirm the send gate treats `auto_continue`, `queued` and `pending_connection` as busy, as Bot Chat did.

## Decisions
- Vault prompts stay unanswered here (#1127 decision 5).
- Request cards sit above the composer (decision 4).

## Acceptance
- [ ] A desktop-task request shows the card with Stop; nothing is sent in reply to it.
- [ ] A `manage_connections` request shows one row per app with only the host's allowed moves; Continue without releases the turn.
- [ ] A refused password shows Update sign-in; backgrounding and returning sends nothing; signing in again recovers.

## Tests
`HermesChatRequestTests` (desktop task shown not answered; connection request/update/respond once; `pending_connection` restore; withdrawal note). `BotPendingRequestTests` move with the types. A `needsSignIn` test that `recover()` does not run.

## Validation
`--only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatRequestTests --only HermesMobileTests/BotPendingRequestTests --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatTurnTests`. Simulator: a connector request on `scripts/local-hermes`; a wrong saved password.

Prepared by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code (T3 Code) during #1127 intake.

title: feat(bots): keep a bot's chat in the offline cache
body:
**What the user gets:** Opening a bot's chat in the regular chat shows its last transcript at once, and offline, before the host answers.
**Why it matters:** The Hermes offline cache skips Bot Chat rows (`Persistence/CacheStore+Hermes.swift:70`); Bot Chat has its own `BotHistoryCache`. Without this, moving a bot's chat to `ChatView` would regress #628. #1127 decision 1.
**Cost:** Small to Medium. One PR. Simulator.

Part of #1127 · **Blocked by:** none · **Unblocks:** #1146

## Contract (pin `ca678285`)

- No new wire calls. Transcript pages and coverage as in #1047/#1054; the canonical root comes from `identify`'s `session.list` lookup by exact title (`HermesCall.swift:353`).

## Plan
- [ ] Cache the canonical chat's transcript in the Hermes cache under server + connection + Profile + canonical root (its stored key can move on compaction; the root does not).
- [ ] `ChatView(hermesSession: .canonicalChat)` reads it before the attach, shows the cached-view state, and replaces it on the first newest read (#1054 coverage rules).
- [ ] Bot Chat rows stay out of the Sessions list cache; only the transcript cache admits them.

## Decisions

Approved under [#1127's split and owner answers](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/713#issuecomment-6088507479):

- Cache the bot's canonical transcript under its server, connection, Profile and canonical root; compaction may move the stored key without moving that root.
- Keep Bot Chat rows out of the Sessions list cache. Opening the chat shows its cached transcript before the attach replaces it.
- Room history and search remain separate; the old Bot Chat cache is retired only with #1148.

## Acceptance
- [ ] An archived Bot Chat (which already opens in `ChatView`) shows its cached transcript in airplane mode.
- [ ] Two servers never share a bot chat's cache.

## Tests
`HermesOfflineCacheTests` (Bot Chat transcript stored and read by root, list cache unchanged, server isolation).

## Validation
`--only HermesMobileTests/HermesOfflineCacheTests`.

## Non-goals
Dropping `BotHistoryCache`'s Bot Chat half (#1148).

title: feat(bots): give a bot's chat its pill, rules and mentions in the regular chat
body:
**What the user gets:** A bot's chat opened in the regular chat looks and behaves like that bot's chat: its avatar pill with its working, waiting and failed face, `@`bot mentions, the commands that make sense there, and a return to the inbox if the chat was replaced.
**Why it matters:** #1127 slice 2. Prepares `ChatView` before any entry point moves (#1146).
**Cost:** Medium. One PR. Simulator (Archived Bot Chat opens in `ChatView` today).

Part of #1127 · **Blocked by:** #1141 (Update sign-in) · **Unblocks:** #1146

## Contract (pin `ca678285`)

- No new methods. `session.info`'s `stored_session_id` after a legacy compaction (#1050). Mentions are delivered only in the canonical Bot Chat (`tools/bot_mode_dm.py:122-131`).
- Sending into a room session fails with 4122 (`tui_gateway/methods_prompt.py:206-238`).

## Plan
- [ ] **Pill.** On `.canonicalChat`, the toolbar's leading item is the bot pill (avatar from `BotAvatarStore`, face from turn state, still after a short beat (#776), Reduce Motion). Tap opens `BotProfileEditorView`; closing it re-reads the Profile.
- [ ] **Rules** (#1127 decision 3): refuse `/new /reset /resume /sessions /branch /fork /title`, Fork from here, rename and archive; Profile chip can't start a new chat; `/clear` refused with a `/compress` hint; Edit, Regenerate, `/undo`, `/retry` hidden; `/btw /background /goal /yolo /compress` allowed. One `HermesChatPolicy` (or a target check) consulted by `HermesSlashCommands`, the message menu and the composer.
- [ ] **Compaction.** `HermesConversation.adoptStoredKey` (`Features/Hermes/HermesConversation.swift:235-239`) follows the new stored key for `.canonicalChat` too, so `/compress` keeps the chat writable; `identify`'s root/tip rule is unchanged.
- [ ] **Mentions.** `BotMentionAutocompleteView` and `BotMentions` in the composer, only on `.canonicalChat` (host delivers them only there, `tools/bot_mode_dm.py:122-131`).
- [ ] **Callbacks.** `ChatView(hermesSession:onChatReplaced:onUpdateSignIn:)`; a replaced root calls back with a toast (#554).
- [ ] **Live Activity identity** stays the Bot scheme (`AgentRunActivityBot`, `BotLiveActivityFeed.swift:36-42`), not `hermes:` session ids (#709 decision; #706 carries both).

## Decisions

Approved under [#1127's split and owner answers](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/713#issuecomment-6088507479):

- The bot's canonical chat keeps its avatar pill, mentions, fresh Profile read, chat-replaced callback and Bot Live Activity identity.
- Preserve #1127's command restrictions: refuse /new, /reset, /resume, /sessions, /branch, /fork, /title and /clear; hide Edit, Regenerate, /undo and /retry. Allow /compress, /btw, /background, /goal and /yolo.
- Follow the canonical chat's new stored key after compaction, and preserve server-scoped drafts, cache and identity. Rooms stay outside ChatView.

## Acceptance
- [ ] From Archived, a Bot Chat shows its pill and face, refuses `/new` with copy, hides Edit/Regenerate, allows `/compress` and keeps sending after it.
- [ ] `@` lists the other bots; a mention reaches the named bot.
- [ ] A turn's Live Activity tap opens the bot's chat.

## Tests
`HermesSlashCommandTests` (bot-chat refusals), `HermesCompressClearTests` (canonical key follow), `BotMentionTests` moved, `HermesChatLiveActivityTests` (bot identity on `.canonicalChat`), `BotFaceMotionTests` unchanged.

## Validation

title: [Bug] BotConnection setup: "Install the plugin" step fails with HTTP 400 even when the plugin is already installed
body: ### Steps to reproduce 1. Hermes host side: hermes-agent 0.21.5, native web dashboard running via launchd (`ai.hermes.dashboard`) on a Tailscale address, port 9119, basic-auth enabled (username + scrypt password hash in `~/.hermes/.env`). `hermex-push` plugin v0.4.0 installed and enabled; `HERMEX_PUSH_RELAY_URL` is set. Verified via `/api/status`: `auth_required: true`, `auth_providers: ["basic"]`, gateway connected as platform `hermex`. 2. On the iPhone (iOS 26), open Hermex, add the dashboard connection using that address + dashboard username/password. 3. Password sign-in succeeds - the host's `dashboard-auth.log` records repeated `login_success` from the phone's Tailscale IP at the same minute as the failures. 4. On the "Turn on notifications..." setup screen, tap through the checklist. Step 2, "Install the plugin," fails every time with the banner: "This Hermes host refused the step (HTTP 400). Check the host's logs, then try again." 5. Retrying does not change the result; step 1 (relay address) already shows a green checkmark. ### Expected behavior After a successful password login, the "Install the plugin" step should POST the install request to `/api/dashboard/agent-plugins/install` with the signed session cookie the app just obtained, and the dashboard should accept it. (The plugin was already installed on the host, so the request may well return "already exists"; the app should treat that as success and move the checklist forward.) ### Actual behavior The app reports: "This Hermes host refused the step (HTTP 400). Check the host's logs, then try again." Server-side evidence (macOS 27.0.1, hermes-agent v0.21.5+4627.gebf1be6): - The dashboard's own auth log shows: `{"event":"session_rejected","reason":"no_cookie","path":"/api/dashboard/agent-plugins/install","ip":"192.168.17.80"}` - i.e. the install POST reached the dashboard with no session cookie, so the auth middleware rejected it before the install logic even ran. - Other API calls in the same session (password login, `/api/status`) authenticate fine, so credentials are correct and the app holds a working session for some requests - the install POST specifically is going out without the Cookie header. - Net effect: the checklist's "Install the plugin" step can never complete from inside Hermex, even though the plugin is verifiably installed, current, and enabled on the host (`hermes plugins list` shows hermex-push v0.4.0 enabled). ### Impact Major degradation ### App version / commit 1.4.0 (App Store) ### iOS version and device iOS 26.0 on iPhone ### hermes-webui server version n/a - native Hermes web dashboard (hermes-agent v0.21.5), not hermes-webui ### How the phone reaches the server Tailscale ### Screenshots or screen recordings

title: feat(hermes): fast mode and loop and heartbeat controls in Hermes chats
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1142
Part of epic #1127

## What changed

Fast mode and loop/heartbeat controls existed only in Bot Chat. Hermes chats now get both:
- **Fast chip** in the composer (after Profile), shown only when the active model allows it. A tap writes one `config.set fast` with `scope=session`; the chip changes only on a matching `{key: "fast", value}` reply, a refusal keeps the mode and shows the host's message, and stale taps after a reconnect stay inert. Fast and effort now survive a reattach.
- **Loop and heartbeat** sit beside the goal in the existing goal menu: one section each (`Heartbeat · Active` over Pause/Resume), behind one confirmation, writing `session.control`. The menu follows `session.control.update`; a stale reply snapshot never replaces a newer update, and a Pause is dropped at dispatch if its automation was replaced. Pause/Resume shows only when the host offers `session.control`.

Decisions applied ([decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1142#issuecomment-6090058370)): merged into the existing goal menu (#1127 decision 1); Preserve (#508) acknowledgement, stale-action discard, `scope=session`, host-gated controls.

**Decisions made overnight**
- Fast survives reattach by feeding the `session.resume` info to `HermesChatSettings` (alt: change `BotChatControls.connect`, which also changes Bot Chat).
- Menu sections built from already-localized halves, no new strings (alt: a new `%@ · %@` key with 17 translations).
- Goal menu also shows for a loop/heartbeat-only session (alt: keep it gated on a goal).

## How it was tested

title: feat(bots): keep a bot's chat in the offline cache
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1144 (part of #1127; applies [the approved decision](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1144#issuecomment-6090058849)).

## What changed

The Hermes offline cache skipped Bot Chat rows, so moving a bot's chat into `ChatView` (#1146) would lose #628's instant, offline transcript.

- A Bot Chat caches under `hermes-bot|<connection>|<Profile>|<canonical root>`. `ChatView(.canonicalChat)` shows it read-only before the attach; the first newest read replaces it (#1054 rules). A new canonical root discards the old preview and rows.
- An archived Bot Chat (including a legacy `Bot Chat (continued)` tip) caches under its own `hermes-bot-archive|…|<root>` scope and falls back to its bot's copy of the same root. It never becomes the bot's preview or gets swept by the bot's attach, An authoritative newest read on either side drops rows the host cut from the other's copy of the same root (deletion only).
- A per-server epoch, advanced by `clearCache(for:)` and Profile/connection removal, stops late writers until the next attach. Bot delete and connection replace/remove purge both scopes. Session and webui keys are unchanged.

**Decisions made overnight**
- Separate `hermes-bot|<connection>|…` scope. Alt: put the connection inside `hermes|`, risking a Profile-name collision.
- Archived Bot Chats carry `botChatRoot` and use `hermes-bot-archive|`, reading their own copy first, then the bot's. Alt: one shared scope with a persisted canonical-root pointer, or the newer `cachedAt` wins.
- Roster invalidation covers what `BotInbox.forget` sees. Alt: reconcile cached Profiles on every roster read (#1152).
- One writer epoch per server, sessions included. Alt: per-scope owner tokens.
- `Bot Chat (continued)` counts only for the cache bridge, by exact title, hidden, with `_lineage_root_id`. Alt: widen `isBotChat`, or bridge any cached hidden chain.
- At the review limit, fixed the remaining findings once more and shipped for bots/CI. Alt: hold for another review.
- Follow-ups: #1152, #1153.

## How it was tested

- Red first: 3 initial tests and 6 round-1 tests failed on unchanged code; the continued-row test failed at 644313bf. `testAnOlderArchivedBotChatNeitherPreviewsForNorGoesWithItsBot` failed at 41c16e66 (canonical previewed `Old question`; archive showed `[]` after the bot's attach). `testAnArchivedBotChatsEmptyReadDropsItsBotsCopyOfTheUndoneRows` failed at b62cf213 and `testABotChatsEmptyReadDropsAnArchivesCopyOfTheUndoneRows` at 931d4009 (undone `Hi`/`Hello.` came back offline).
- Green at 2b58731c with `scripts/test-sim <udid> --only` HermesOfflineCacheTests, CacheStoreTests, BotLifecycleTests, HermesTranscriptPagingTests, HermesChatTurnTests, HermesConversationTests, HermesSessionListTests: 151 passed, 0 failed (plus BotConnectionVersion/Setup at b62cf213: 173 passed). Earlier rounds: 251 + 251 passed.

title: fix(bots): invalidate Bot Chat rows when a fresh roster observes an external Profile deletion
body:
Found in review of #1151 (#1144); deferred at the review limit.

**Where:** `HermesMobile/Features/Bots/BotInbox.swift:453` (at 41c16e66)

**Evidence:** Cache Profile P's canonical Bot Chat transcript, delete P from another client, then refresh this inbox so `profiles.list` omits P. The SwiftData purge added in #1151 runs only inside `forget` (lines 447-455). `reload` replaces `profiles` (line 548) and drops missing Profiles from `historyCache.recent` (lines 549-554), but calls `forget` only for `uncertainDeletions` (lines 565-569); an external deletion never enters that set. So `cachedHermesBotChatRoot` and `cachedHermesMessages` still return P's rows after the phone has seen P is gone. Recreating P under the same name can show its predecessor's preview before the attach, especially offline. #628 requires roster changes to invalidate the matching scope; the deletion test in #1151 covers only `inbox.delete`.

**Suggested fix:** Reconcile the connection's cached Bot Chat Profile scopes against every successful authoritative roster (or keep enough scope identity to remove absent Profiles), and revoke their pending writers. Keep present Profiles, other connections and other servers. Add a test that caches P, refreshes a roster omitting P without calling `inbox.delete`, and checks that neither the cached read nor a late writer brings P's transcript back.

title: fix(bots): clear the Bot Chat cache scope after deleting an archived Bot Chat
body:
Found in review of #1151 (#1144); deferred at the review limit.

**Where:** `HermesMobile/Features/Chat/ChatViewModel.swift:7865` (at 41c16e66)

**Evidence:** Open an archived hidden Bot Chat online, go back to Archived Sessions, and delete it with the row's Delete action. Since #1151 that chat reads and writes its transcript under `hermes-bot|<connection>|<Profile>|<root>`. `ArchivedSessionsView` offers Delete for these rows (lines 184-190) and passes `modelContext` to `ArchivedSessionsViewModel.delete` (lines 229-231). After the host confirms the delete, the view model calls only `CacheStore.removeHermesSession` (`ArchivedSessionsViewModel.swift:204-205`), whose predicates remove `hermes|<Profile>|<root>` rows, never the `hermes-bot` scope (`CacheStore+Hermes.swift:114-122`). The deleted transcript stays readable through `cachedHermesBotChatRoot`/`cachedHermesMessages` until TTL, eviction or a clear, and no writer epoch is revoked. A later canonical open can show it before the attach fails with `missingChat`. Upstream's pinned `session.delete` (hermes-agent ca678285, `tui_gateway/methods_session.py:1033-1052`) allows deleting an idle stored Bot Chat.

**Suggested fix:** On a confirmed archived Bot Chat delete, remove that exact server/connection/Profile/canonical-root transcript and revoke pending writes for it, keeping other roots and Profiles. Leave ordinary session cleanup as is. Add a focused test that fills the Bot Chat scope, deletes the archived row, and checks that its root and messages are gone.

## Linked issue

Fixes #1143 · Part of #1127

## What changed

In a Hermes chat, an audio attachment on a message row showed as a plain file cell: `ChatView` passed no loader on Hermes chats, and `attachmentRawData` only knew webui's media API, which needs a webui session ID a Hermes host doesn't have. Transcript `MEDIA:` images and audio already load from the host (#1112/#1119), so per the [decision](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1143#issuecomment-6090058632) this fix covers only that gap.

- `attachmentRawData` on a Hermes chat downloads through `HermesChatTurnCoordinator.attachmentData(path:)` (Profile + stored session key, 25 MB preview cap, stale-attach results dropped). The player's load is keyed to the chat's attach generation, so a Hermes player opened while detached shows the existing loading state (it used to show "Couldn't play this audio") and downloads once the chat attaches; it never calls webui.

title: perf(hermes): defer offscreen attachment-audio downloads in Hermes chats
body:
Found in review of #1154 (Part of #1143), shipped at the review limit as a small finding.

**Problem:** Reopening a Hermes chat downloads every earlier audio attachment, even ones far offscreen. Before #1154 those attachments were file cells and made no requests. Now each one with a host path renders as `InlineAudioPlayerView` (`MessageBubbleView.swift:450-473`). The transcript is a plain `VStack` + `ForEach` over every message, not lazy (`ChatTranscriptView.swift:169-174,309-320`), and each player starts `loadIfNeeded` in `.task` (`InlineAudioPlayerView.swift:58-59`). That downloads the file and prepares an `AVAudioPlayer` (`:198-235`), with no viewport or play-tap guard. Each file can be up to the 25 MB preview cap.

**Suggested fix:** Keep webui unchanged. On Hermes chats, start the attachment-audio load only when the row becomes visible or the user taps Play. Keep the Open action available before loading, and keep the cancellation and stale-attach checks. Add a focused test: opening the latest messages doesn't download offscreen audio, and bringing an attachment into view (or pressing Play) loads its own host path.

title: test(hermes): remove the unexercised no-download assertion in HermesChatAttachmentTests
body:
Found in review of #1154 (Part of #1143), shipped at the review limit as a small finding.

**Problem:** `testAHermesAudioChipPlaysInlineOnlyFromItsHostPath` (`HermesChatAttachmentTests.swift:432-440`) builds a `loaded` spy and a loader closure, but only calls the synchronous `playsInline` policy. It never renders `MessageBubbleView`/`InlineAudioPlayerView` or invokes the closure, so `XCTAssertEqual(loaded, [])` always passes. Removing the `playsInline` gate from `MessageBubbleView`'s audio selection would bring back the pathless display-name download and this test would stay green. The policy assertions themselves are useful.

**Suggested fix:** Delete the unused spy and its empty-array assertion, and describe the test as a send-to-policy test. To keep a "no request" claim, exercise the real row loading path and assert the actual request path and count.

title: feat(hermes): show the plan and the turn outcome in every Hermes chat
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1139 (Part of #1127)

## What changed

**Problem:** the regular Hermes chat dropped `todo.updated` and the snapshot's `todo_state`, and showed a failed turn as one line of error text. Bot Chat had both.

**Fix:** a new `HermesChatActivity` seam, fed by `HermesChatTurnCoordinator`, holds the plan and the turn outcome. While a turn runs with an open step, the plan pins above the composer as a one-line glass strip ("2 of 5 · step"; tap expands, long-press copies). Once done it settles as the plan row under that turn's prompt. The plan is revision-monotonic; an empty list at revision ≥ 1 clears it (also fixes Bot Chat); a new runtime drops it. A failed turn shows the #878 outcome row instead of the error line; Retry resends the host's raw `inflight.user` once, from a tap. `BotPlan`, `BotPlanRowView` and `BotTurnOutcomeRow` moved to `Features/Chat/` with Hermes names. Decisions applied: [decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1139#issuecomment-6090057541), including every Preserve (#503, #937, #584) line.

**Decisions made overnight**
- Retry's raw prompt comes from one `session.resume` read after the failed turn settles; alt: resend this chat's own text.
- Settled plan anchors by the turn's prompt row, never drawn under a different prompt; alt: draw at the transcript tail.
- Only a new runtime drops the plan; alt: drop it on any reset replay.
- A failed `message.complete` or reattach failure shows the outcome row only, no error line; alt: keep both.
- The plan strip reuses the log row's localized accessibility hints; alt: new strip-specific strings.
- A plan restored from a snapshot (reopen, new runtime) is kept for ordering but not drawn until a live `todo.updated` claims it; alt: recover its owner from history.
- Retry's cut row always comes from history dated from the snapshot's `inflight.started_at`, not the receipt; alt: use the receipt row when start times match.
- Retry is offered only when the newest prompt is at/after that start and the one before predates it; alt: a second `session.resume` to compare.
- A cold attach to a running turn pins its plan only after that turn's next live `todo.updated`; alt: infer it from the truncated replay.
- The review limit was reached with findings left: fixed them once more and shipped for bots and CI; alt: hold for another review.
- A remaining Retry gap with a second client's pre-start failure is filed as #1158 (hide Retry on an unseen `message.complete`); alt: one more repair pass.

title: fix(hermes): Retry can cut another client's pre-start failure
body:
**Problem:** In a Hermes chat, after turn A fails and its failure read sets A's Retry target, another client's turn B can fail before it starts (a `message.complete` with an error and no `message.start`). `HermesChatTurnCoordinator.complete(_:)` ignores a completion while no turn is active, so B's failure never reaches the activity and A's Retry stays on screen. Tapping it cuts the transcript at A's prompt, which now also removes B.

**Evidence:** reported by the final fix stage of #1139 as a remaining gap (left out to keep that stage narrow). It needs a second client failing before `message.start` right after a failure in this chat.

**Suggested fix:** treat a `message.complete` this chat did not see start as a new turn for Retry purposes: hide Retry (or reread the failed turn) instead of ignoring it. Add a `HermesChatTurnTests` case: A fails → Retry offered → an unseen failing `message.complete` arrives → Retry is gone.

Found in https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/1157 (#1139).

title: feat(hermes): follow and interrupt delegated work from any Hermes chat
body:
Fixes #1140 · Stacked on #1157

## What changed

Only Bot Chat followed an agent's delegated workers; in a regular Hermes chat a delegation ran invisibly and finished as unexplained text. Now `HermesChatActivity` owns a `HermesDelegatedWork` on the chat's own socket and attach. title: ComposerVoiceInputServerRecordingTests depends on the simulator's real speech recognizer
body:
`ComposerVoiceInputServerRecordingTests.testServerFirstFallsBackOnDeviceAfterTheHostRefuses` failed on CI twice:

- https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/actions/runs/38009219850
- https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/actions/runs/38014325308

It passed 30/30 locally (`scripts/test-sim --repeat 30`) on both the #1162 stack and master. The CI xcresult shows `STT is disabled` instead of the speech-permission message, and authorizations `0` vs `1`. So `onDeviceSpeechRecognizerForRecording()` found no on-device recognizer through the live `SFSpeechRecognizer.supportedLocales()`, `SFSpeechRecognizer(locale:)` and `supportsOnDeviceRecognition` calls, and the fallback was skipped. Those are real system calls with no test seam, so the test depends on the CI simulator's speech service.

**Suggested fix:** inject those lookups through `ComposerVoiceInputController`'s existing `speechRecognizerFactory` seam, so the test controls whether an on-device recognizer exists.

Found while shipping #1162.

title: feat(bots): give a bot's chat its pill, rules and mentions in the regular chat
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1145 · Stacked on #1162 · Part of #1127 · Integrated in stack (bottom-first): #1150 #1154 #1151 #1159 #1157 #1160 #1162 #1164 #1166

## What changed

**Problem:** a bot's Bot Chat opened in the regular `ChatView` (today: from Archived) looked and behaved like any session: no avatar pill, `/new` and Edit could fork or rewind the bot's one chat, `/compress` left it unwritable, and `@` didn't know the other bots.

**Fix:** one `HermesChatPolicy` (`.session` / `.botChat`), read by slash commands, the message menu and the composer. A Bot Chat gets the bot's avatar pill with its working, waiting and failed face (tap opens the Profile editor; closing it re-reads the Profile), refusals with copy for `/new /reset /clear /resume /sessions /branch /fork /title`, no Edit, Regenerate, `/undo` or `/retry`, `@` mentions of this connection's other bots, and a callback when the chat was replaced. `.canonicalChat` turns drive the Bot Live Activity, which keeps Bot Chat's "Plan N of M" and "N workers" chips (#584): the coordinator writes them on plan and roster changes, after each snapshot read, and on start or reattach, only while it drives that bot's activity. The chip format is one shared `BotLiveActivitySnapshot.countChips`.

Decisions applied ([#1145 decision](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1145#issuecomment-6090059034), [#1127 split](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/713#issuecomment-6088507479)): #1127's command rules; **Deliberate:** the canonical chat follows its new stored key after compaction, reversing #1099's "never for a Bot Chat", so `/compress` keeps it writable; #523 mention, #517/#776/#778 face rules and #584 count chips preserved.

**Decisions made overnight**
- Archived Bot Chat rows, and their hidden "Bot Chat (continued)" tips, open by stored key with Bot Chat's rules. Alt: open as `.canonicalChat`, which makes deliberately archived chats unopenable; session rules for continued tips.
- Update sign-in reuses #1141's `HermesUpdateSignInAction`; the pill re-reads the Profile when the editor closes. Alt: a new parameter; re-read on each save.
- Refusal copy names the constraint per command, in all 17 languages as needs_review; `/undo` and `/retry` are hidden and refused, other host commands run. Alt: one generic line; also refuse `/rollback`.
- An Archived Bot Chat keeps the session activity `hermes:<profile>:<key>` until #706 (follow-up #1165). Alt: carry the key in the Bot URL now.
- Integration: one `botChatRoot` (the row's recognized Bot Chat root) drives both the rules and #1144's cache scope; the repair merged the separate `botChatCacheRoot`, which always held the same value. Alt: keep two fields set from one value.
- Integration: the bot activity restores plan and worker chips only, not "N tools". Alt: count `tool.start` per turn in the coordinator.
- Review limit reached with serious findings: fixed once more and shipped for bots and CI. Alt: hold for another review.

## How it was tested

Continued-tip fix (070dc08d): HermesSlashCommandTests, HermesOfflineCacheTests, HermesChatLiveActivityTests, HermesSessionListTests, BotMentionTests **96 passed**; stack top full suite **4266 passed, 0 failed, 4 skipped**. Picture fix (79a9358d): HermesChatLiveActivityTests, BotMentionTests, HermesChatSettingsTests, BotAvatarTests and BotLiveActivityTests: **95 passed**. title: Live Activity tap can't reopen a Bot Chat opened from Archived
body:
A Bot Chat opened from Archived by its stored key uses the session Live Activity (`hermes:<profile>:<key>`), which has no tap destination until #706, so a tap opens the app as it is instead of the bot's chat.

The canonical Bot route can't reopen deliberately archived chats, because upstream's title lookup (`session.list` by title, `tui_gateway/methods_session.py` `_session_list_by_title`) excludes them. That is why #1145 keeps those chats on the session activity rather than the Bot identity.

**Suggested fix:** carry the key in the Bot URL and route it to `ChatView(hermesSession: .session(profile, key))`, along with #1146 or #706.

Recorded as an acceptance exception in #1164 (Fixes #1145).

title: feat(bots): open a bot's chat in the regular chat from every entry point
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1146. Stacked on #1164. Integrated in stack (bottom-first): #1150 #1154 #1151 #1159 #1157 #1160 #1162 #1164 #1166

## What changed

**Problem:** A bot's chat opened in the separate `BotChatView` from the inbox, tiles, search, deep links, push and Live Activity taps, Sessions search and Archived, instead of the regular chat used by Sessions.

**Fix:** `BotInboxSelection.chat` now opens `ChatView` on the bot's `.canonicalChat`, with the inbox's replaced-chat toast, Update sign-in, `.id` and seen/return hooks. Every entry point already converged on that destination, so the routes stay and `BotChatView` is now unreferenced (#1148 deletes it). Archived Bot Chat rows go through the bot deep link, the same as a Sessions search hit. Inbox search reads each Profile's Bot Chat on the host (`HermesREST.sessionSearch`, asking for the host maximum of 100), and the local index covers rooms only. Saved room hits show as soon as the cache answers, and bot hits follow. Room sessions (`Group: …`) are dropped from search and Archived. Archived keeps reading pages until a row shows up, and an ID-only search hit shows as the bot itself.

Decisions applied ([decision comment](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/issues/1146#issuecomment-6090059383)): Entry routes, Search, and the #506/#571/#583/#584/#1101 Preserve lines.

**Decisions made overnight**

- An Archived Bot Chat row opens the bot's current chat, and Unarchive restores the archived one. Alternative: carry the row's key in the bot URL (#1165's suggestion).
- A room is any hidden session titled `Group: …`, and search drops that prefix. Alternative: `exclude_sources=bot_room`, which misses Desktop's legacy rooms.
- A failed bot search shows the existing localized `BotFailure` text. Alternative: a new string with 17 translations.
- The pinned host search has no offset or session filter, so bot search asks for the host maximum (`limit=100`). Sessions and `/resume` keep 50. Alternative: retry at 100 only when a full 50-row page had no Bot Chat, or ask upstream for a filter or offset.

**Follow-ups:** #1167 (a Bot Chat behind more than 100 other matches is still missed; needs an upstream filter or offset).

**Integration:** this layer now sits on #1144's offline cache, so every bot route reads the bot's cached chat offline (#628). #1144's own `HermesSessionChat.botChatRoot` is renamed `botChatCacheRoot` (in #1164) so it doesn't collide with #1145's Bot Chat rules field; alt: one field, which would give continued legacy tips Bot Chat rules. #1165's Archived case no longer applies, because Archived rows now open the bot's canonical chat.

The other new tests could not compile against the old API.
- Integration (`9115aeed`): new `HermesOfflineCacheTests.testEveryBotRouteShowsItsBotChatsCachedTranscriptOffline` (#1144 cache × #1146 routes): an inbox row and a link to the cached root show the cache offline; a link to a replaced root shows nothing. title: Bot search can miss a Bot Chat behind 100 other matching sessions
body:
Found while repairing #1166 (Greptile finding [Matching bot chats disappear](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/1166#discussion_r4236351073)).

**Problem:** Bots message search finds each Profile's Bot Chat through the host's `GET /api/sessions/search`. In the pinned hermes-agent (`ca678285`, `hermes_cli/web_routers/sessions.py`), that endpoint takes only `q`, `limit` (clamped to 1–100), `profile`, `source`, `sources` and `exclude_sources`. It has no offset and no session or title filter. The Bot Chat has the default source, the same as ordinary sessions, so `source` can't isolate it either.

#1166 has `BotInbox.searchBotChats` ask for the host maximum of 100. A Bot Chat that sits behind more than 100 other matching sessions in its Profile is still missed, and that bot drops out of message search even though its chat contains the query.

**Evidence:** `BotInboxTests.testMessageSearchFindsABotChatBehindFiftyOtherMatches` covers the 50-match case that #1166 fixed. With 101 or more matches ahead of the Bot Chat, the same setup returns no hit.

**Suggested fix:** This needs an upstream change: either a session (or title) filter on `/api/sessions/search`, which would let the app ask for the Bot Chat directly, or an `offset` so the app can page until it finds the Bot Chat or runs out of matches. No upstream issue exists yet (searched NousResearch/hermes-agent). File one there and link it here, then adopt it once the pin moves past it.

Related: #1166, #1146.

title: fix(bots): show the tool count chip on a bot's Live Activity in ChatView
body:

**Why it matters:** The old Bot Chat screen showed three count chips (plan, workers, tools). Since #1146 opens a bot's chat in `ChatView`, `HermesChatTurnCoordinator.syncBotWorkSummary()` restores only the plan and worker chips (integration fix in #1164, commit `760ec218`). `tools` stays 0 because the coordinator doesn't count the turn's `tool.start` frames. The status line still shows the running tool.

Greptile finding: https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/1164#discussion_r4236569194

**Suggested fix:** Count the turn's `tool.start` frames in the coordinator (reset per turn; rebuilt from the snapshot on reattach) and pass `tools:` to `BotLiveActivitySnapshot.countChips`. Add a `HermesChatLiveActivityTests` case.

Follow-up to #1142 ([#1150](https://github.com/uzairansaruzi/hermex/pull/1150)), found during the epic #1127 merge walk. No separate issue.

## What changed

On iPad, the "Change session control?" confirmation for a loop or heartbeat Pause/Resume popped up over the middle of the chat instead of from the Goal toolbar button. The dialog was attached to the whole `ChatView` body. It now sits on the goal menu, the same way Bot Chat's `BotSessionControlMenu` attaches its copy. iPhone is unchanged (the dialog is an action sheet there).

## How it was tested

- `scripts/test-sim 591F664C-… --only HermesMobileTests/HermesChatSideTaskTests` on iPad Pro 11-inch (M5): 25 passed, 0 failed.
- Not exercised in the UI: showing the dialog needs a session with an active loop or heartbeat on a live host.

Manual test

Device: iPad simulator
1. In a Hermes chat with a heartbeat (`scripts/local-hermes`, `/heartbeat 30m tidy the inbox`), open the goal menu and tap Pause. The confirmation pops up anchored to the Goal button. Confirm: it shows `Heartbeat · Paused`.

title: fix(chat): keep a settled reply's header and footer clear of its text
body:
**What the user gets:** a long reply's footer (Copy, "…", time) always sits below its last line, and the "Worked for" header leaves the same room above the reply that the footer leaves below it.
**Why it matters:** Uzair hits this on his iPhone on long Hermes replies. The footer covers the reply's last words and the header crowds its first heading, so a finished reply looks broken.
**Cost:** Small to Medium. The final check needs Uzair's iPhone, because the overlap only shows on some replies.

## Current behavior

On a settled assistant reply, on iPhone and iPad:

1. **The footer overlaps the last line.** Copy and the time draw on top of the reply's last paragraph instead of below it. It is still overlapping 23 minutes after the reply finished (reply 4:18 PM, screenshot 4:41 PM), so this is not a flash at the end of streaming.
2. **The header crowds the first block.** "Worked for 44s" sits directly on the reply's first block, an H1, with no visible gap.
3. **The gaps don't match.** The header-to-reply, reply-to-footer and inner gaps are all different.

Seen on a physical iPhone (iOS 27) and the iPad Pro 11-inch simulator, in the Hermes session "Write a long story #2": long replies with headings, code blocks and tables. Not every reply shows it.

![iPhone: footer overlapping the last line](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2489f2cb-da77-4944-8961-e77328230617)
![iPhone: "Worked for" header crowding the first heading](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2d235955-1cce-4fff-99ab-e4d01a76506d)
![iPad: footer overlapping the last line](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/be914b10-cfab-4f15-b035-5389018cd79c)

## Expected behavior

- The footer always sits below the reply's last line, on first layout and after late content changes such as code highlighting, block margins and images.
- One gap between the "Worked for" header and the reply, the same gap between the reply and its footer, matching the transcript's existing spacing. A heading that is the reply's first block adds no extra top margin under the header.
- Streaming replies are unchanged.

## Likely cause (from reading the code, not reproduced)

- **Footer:** settled replies are wrapped in `ResponseTextSelection` (`HermesMobile/Features/Chat/MessageBubbleView.swift:212`), a `UIViewControllerRepresentable` that hosts the reply in a `UIHostingController`. Its `sizeThatFits` (`ResponseTextSelection.swift:31-34`) measures `host.sizeThatFits` when SwiftUI asks. When the hosted content grows afterwards, nothing tells SwiftUI to measure again: MarkdownUI applies block margins from `@State` set by `onPreferenceChange` after the first pass, and code highlighting is async (`MarkdownRenderer.swift:256,321`). The row keeps the stale, shorter height, and the reply draws under the footer (`ChatMessageMeta.swift:47-92`, the next child in `ChatTranscriptView.swift:906-918`). Streaming replies skip the wrapper (`MessageBubbleView.swift:209-210`), which fits "settled replies only".
- **Header gap:** MarkdownUI's `BlockSequence` drops the first block's top margin, so the H1's `markdownMargin(top: 24)` (`MarkdownRenderer.swift:1348`) never applies under the header. The fold row (`TranscriptTurnFolding.swift:233-271`) has no vertical padding. The surrounding stacks use 8 (`ChatView.swift:256`), 4 (`ChatTranscriptView.swift:906`) and 6 (`MessageBubbleView.swift:204`).
- Paragraph bottom margins are set twice, 16 in the theme (`MarkdownRenderer.swift:1155`) and 8 in `markdownBlockStyle(\.paragraph)` (`:214-219`). Worth settling while here.

Confirm the cause before fixing. If the footer and header turn out to have unrelated fixes, keep them in one PR anyway: they share the screen and the validation pass.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] On a settled long reply with headings, code blocks and a table, the footer's top is at or below the reply's bottom after highlighting and margins settle, on iPhone and iPad widths.
- [ ] The header-to-reply gap equals the reply-to-footer gap, including when the first block is an H1 or H2.
- [ ] Text selection, Copy and "Ask Hermex" on settled replies still work.
- [ ] Streaming replies and the streaming-to-settled handoff look the same as today: no jump beyond the settle itself.
- [ ] No new per-frame work while scrolling a long transcript.

## Validation plan

- A focused test that lays out a long settled reply in `ResponseTextSelection`, lets async highlighting finish, and asserts the footer frame starts at or below the reply's bottom. Hosted UI test if a model-level assertion can't see it.
- Before/after screenshots in the PR of the same reply on iPhone and iPad simulators.
- Final check on Uzair's iPhone, via Branch TestFlight or the 2.0 RC: open "Write a long story #2" and scroll the long replies.

## Non-goals

- Redesigning the footer or the "Worked for" row.
- Changing MarkdownUI itself. Fix it in our wrapper or theme.

title: fix(chat): show agent replies from server-initiated turns in WebUI chats (async delegation reports never appear)
body:
**What happens:** In a WebUI chat, when the agent delegates work with `delegate_task(background=true)` and ends its turn, the WebUI server later starts a new turn on its own when the worker finishes and the agent writes its report. Hermex never shows that report: not live, and not when the app comes back to the foreground. The user only sees it after sending another message ("so?").

**Why it matters:** Background delegation is now the normal pattern for long coding tasks. The user thinks the agent "delegates and stops", and has to keep polling by hand.

## Evidence (WebUI `c296673e`, Hermex code checked at `8001c21`, 2026-10-10)

Same session, times local:

| Time | Server | Hermex requests (WebUI access log) |
|---|---|---|
| 20:30:21 | async delegation completes, WebUI starts a server-initiated turn | none |
| 20:30:32 | assistant report saved to the session ("lot 4 done, OK to publish?") | none |
| 20:49:44 | | `/api/sessions`, `/api/projects`, `/api/profiles` (app reopened) |
| 20:50:29 | | `POST /api/chat/start` "is it OK?" — the 20:30 report was never displayed |

It happened again at 20:56:51 (report "PR opened, CI green") with no request from the app.

Over 2 days of logs, Hermex made **0** requests to `/api/session/stream`.

## Root cause

WebUI chats only listen to the per-turn `/api/chat/stream?stream_id=…`, which closes at the end of each turn. A server-initiated turn (async delegation, `notify_on_complete`, cron/self-wake) gets a new `stream_id` that the app never learns about.

- `Endpoints.swift` has no route for `/api/session/stream` (or `/api/session/status`).
- On `.active`, `ChatView.handleScenePhaseChange` → `reconnectStreamIfNeeded` only resumes a stream the app already had locally. If there was none, it does not check the server for a newer turn or newer messages.

The WebUI web client already handles this (`static/messages.js`, "Long-lived EventSource bound to /api/session/stream", ~line 8204).

## Proposed fix

1. **Subscribe while a WebUI chat is on screen and the app is active.** `GET /api/session/stream?session_id=<sid>` (SSE), closed on session switch / background (same budget rule as the web client).
   - `server_turn_started` `{session_id, stream_id, pending_started_at?, recovered?}` → attach the existing `ChatStreamCoordinator` to `/api/chat/stream?stream_id=<id>` exactly like a user-started turn. If `recovered` is true, use the replay/reconnect path (the turn is already mid-flight). Ignore it if already attached to that `stream_id`.
   - `session-updated` `{session_id, message_count}` while idle → reload the transcript if `message_count` is higher than the local count.
   - `bg_task_complete` → same idle transcript refresh (the web client de-dupes by `session_id|event_id`).
2. **Catch up on foreground.** On `.active` with no local active stream, call `GET /api/session/status?session_id=<sid>`. If it reports an active stream, attach with replay. Otherwise reload the transcript when the message count changed. This covers turns that started and finished while the app was suspended (iOS kills the SSE in the background).
3. **Optional, later:** a local notification when a server-initiated turn finishes while the app is in the background, like user-started turns already get (#862).

## Acceptance

- [ ] Agent delegates in the background and ends its turn; the worker finishes while the chat is open → the report streams in live, with no user message.
- [ ] Same, with the app in the background during completion → on return, the report is visible without sending a message.
- [ ] A server-initiated turn still running on return → attaches mid-flight and renders the full turn (replay), with no duplicated or truncated message.
- [ ] No extra held connection for chats that are not on screen.

## Non-goals

Gateway / direct-Hermes chats (covered by #1140 for delegated-work UI). Server changes: the WebUI API already exposes everything needed.

title: refactor(bots): delete Bot Chat's screen and keep rooms' shared pieces
body:
## Linked issue

Fixes #1148 · Part of #1127

## What changed

Bot Chat had a second chat screen (about 6k lines) that nothing opens any more: since #1146 every bot route opens the bot's chat in the regular chat. This PR deletes that screen and keeps only the pieces rooms use. Users see no change.

- **Deleted:** `BotChatView`, `BotConversation`, `BotChatComposerView`, `BotArtifactMessageView`, `BotCachedHistoryView`, plus helpers only they used: the activity blocks, attachment picker, control menus, slash panel, `BotActivity`'s reducer and projection, and the `BotAttachmentDraft` class. The 250 ms snapshot loop and 50-row window went with them.
- **Kept for rooms:** `BotComposerPill`/`BotComposerPillView` moved into `BotRoomComposerView.swift`, trimmed to the cases rooms and Update sign-in use. `BotMessageActions` is cut to Copy. The room footer is `ChatMessageMetaRow`. The room composer stays text-only.
- **Shared types now standalone:** `BotTurnState` and `BotTitleFace` (the pill's face). The tool-result preview is now `BotJSON.toolResultPreview`, the turn-boundary check is `HermesTranscriptProjection.isTurnBoundary`, and the image prep and limits live on `BotAttachmentUpload`.
- **Vault prompts (#943 reversed):** no longer parsed or answered. They block with no card, like any unknown method.
- **`BotHistoryCache`:** now holds rooms only. Bot Chat entries left over on disk are dropped the first time the cache loads. Room search is unchanged.
- **Dead code removed with the screen:**
  - The engine's full-transcript resume and two owner hooks only Bot Chat used.
  - `BotChatControls`' workspace, session-control and usage paths (the regular chat never used them).
  - The local-file-link parse mode in `TranscriptMediaParser`.
  - `BotSlashTrigger` and `busyChoices`.
  - `BotLiveActivityFeed`'s snapshot-diffing path. A bot's chat drives the manager itself, so only `BotLiveActivity.countChips` and `writeAvatar` remain.
- `docs/agents/bots.md`, `CONTEXT.md` and the Xcode project are updated.

**Tests.** Cases for behavior that is still alive moved to the Hermes suites:
- `HermesConversationTests`: canonical-chat identity, reconnect backoff and stop rules, resume refusals, held frames.
- `HermesChatRequestTests`: batch, expiry, ordering, a lost answer, a stale action, cancel matching.
- Smaller moves: mentions with attachments, the tool-result preview, turn boundaries, prompt acknowledgments, title faces.
- `BotHistoryCacheTests` now covers rooms only, including a test that legacy entries are dropped.

Bot-Chat-only cases were deleted. Shared fixtures now live in `BotTestFixtures.swift` (renamed from `BotConversationTests.swift`).

## How it was tested

- Full suite: `scripts/test-sim <iPhone 17e>` gave 4040 passed, 3 failed. Two failures were in my new tests (a wrong assertion and a wrong setup time); both are fixed and rerun green. The third, `ChatTranscriptEnvironmentStabilityTests.testLinkReadersSkipOwnerPassesWhileTheKeyboardIsUp`, timed out waiting for the keyboard and passed on rerun.
- Focused reruns after the last changes: `BotHistoryCacheTests`, `BotRecentTranscriptTests`, `BotRoomTests`, `BotChatPresentationTests`, `HermesAgentFixtureTests`, the transcript media suites and `HermesChatAttachmentTests`. All green.
- `ci/check_string_catalog.py` passes.
- Owner check on the simulator: open a room, reply, long-press Copy.

## Checklist

- [x] Local validation passes using `scripts/test-sim <assigned-simulator-udid>`; selection and results above
- [x] New/changed `Codable` models decode tolerantly (the cache snapshot drops fields; old files still decode)
- [x] No new third-party dependencies
- [x] No invented API endpoints or JSON shapes (client-only deletion)

Model and harness: Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code (T3 Code).
